name: Morning preparation and getting up
description: On the morning of New Year's Day, Feng Haoran was naturally awakened by his biological clock. The weather was cloudy with a north wind of force 2, feeling slightly cool but with crisp air. He quickly got up, washed up, changed into a quick-drying long-sleeve shirt, windbreaker, and running shoes, checked his sports watch and Bluetooth earphones, and grabbed the camera bag and small crossbody bag prepared the night before, getting ready for the first run of the new year.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Morning energy boost and subway commute.
description: Feng Haoran walked about 4 minutes to the Meilin Yingu International Community convenience store outside the residential area, bought a whole wheat sandwich and a carton of pure milk, and quickly ate them while walking to replenish energy. Then he walked about 2 minutes to the entrance of Jinxing Road Metro Station, swiped his card to enter, and took Metro Line 2 to Orange Isle. The train car already had many citizens in sportswear, and the festive atmosphere was strong. He put on his earphones and played a high-tempo playlist to mentally prepare for the upcoming 10km run.
location: From the Jinxing Residential Community at No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, passing the Meilin Yingu International Community convenience store at No. 344 Yinshuang Road, to Jinxing Road Subway Station (Line 2), and taking the subway to Orange Isle Station.

name: Orange Isle New Year First Run
description: At exactly 7:00, Feng Haoran and his arranged running partner Gao Yunfei met at the starting point of Orange Isle and started running together. The two maintained a pace of about 7 minutes per kilometer and advanced steadily. On the way, they encountered fellow runners Liu Yang and Chen Tao. The four had similar rhythms, naturally forming a small pack, encouraging each other and crossing the finish line with laughter and joy. The finishing time was about 1 hour and 10 minutes.
location: Within the Orange Isle Scenic Area, Juzizhou (Orange Isle), Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan.

name: Post-run Exchange and Weekend Long Run Plan
description: After the race, the four sat on the ground to drink water and stretch. Liu Yang shared his training schedule for systematically preparing for a half marathon, which inspired Feng Haoran, who had been wanting to break through. He took the initiative to suggest going to Yuelu Mountain together on the weekend for training, and Gao Yunfei immediately responded and volunteered to plan a trail running route. The four added each other on WeChat and agreed to meet at the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain at 7 am on Saturday.
location: Hunan Province, Changsha City, Yuelu District, Juzizhou (Orange Isle) Finish Leisure Area

name: Return home, rest, and breakfast preparation
description: After saying goodbye to his running buddies, Feng Haoran took Metro Line 2 back to Jinxing Road Station and walked about 30 minutes home to the Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community. He immediately took off his sweaty clothes and enjoyed a hot shower to wash away fatigue. After bathing, he reheated the leftover sandwich and milk from the morning and washed some cherry tomatoes as breakfast. While eating, he checked the camera battery and memory cards, and after confirming everything was fine, packed the camera, a spare lens, and a can of insulated caramel latte into his camera bag, fully prepared for the street photography later.
location: From Juzizhou Station, Metro Line 2, Changsha, to Jinxing Road Station, then walk to home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: New Year's Day Street Photography: Light and Shadow on the Xiangjiang River
description: Feng Haoran drove about 10 minutes to the riverside scenic belt on Xiangjiang Middle Road and did street photography themed on the moment when 'river, city, and people' converge on New Year's Day. He walked along the scenic belt, using his camera to capture the elderly flying kites by the river, cargo ships going downstream, the five-star red flag fluttering on the bridge, and the contrast between modern buildings and the traditional river view. He also tried a few slow-shutter shots, which turned out well.
location: Riverside scenic belt along Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Lunch: Authentic Hunan flavor
description: After the street photography session, Feng Haoran drove about 10 minutes to his familiar Manlao Shixiangli Local Restaurant, ordered the signature stir-fried chicken with green peppers, a seasonal vegetable, and a small bowl of rice. While eating, he quickly looked through the photos on his camera and felt satisfied with the morning's results.
location: Manlaoshi Xiangli Local Cuisine Restaurant, Property Management Building, Jianxin Resettlement Community, Second Management Area, Xihu Street, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Afternoon rest and initial photo screening.
description: After lunch, Feng Haoran walked about 3 minutes home. He drew the curtains and took a half-hour nap on the sofa. After waking up, he imported the morning's photos into his tablet, skimmed through them, deleted obvious bad shots, and five-starred a few favorites for later fine editing.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Coffee time and writing New Year's resolutions.
description: Feng Haoran drove about 13 minutes to Shangyin Coffee on Chaozong Street and sat down in his usual seat by the window. The owner, Shen Xinyi, wished him a happy New Year. He ordered a cup of Ethiopian Geisha pour-over coffee, opened the note-taking app on his iPad, and began to seriously write down his 2025 goals: the core goal was to be promoted to investment director, with key results including systematically preparing for and completing a half marathon, starting CFA Level II study, and making a quarterly plan. While drinking his coffee, he also took a picture of the coffee cup and his notebook and posted it in his Moments: 'New year, new coordinates.'
location: Shangyin Coffee Chaozong Street Branch, No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Winter physical conditioning: gym training
description: After leaving the coffee shop, Feng Haoran drove about 15 minutes to the Aoshiguang Gym near his home. No high-intensity training was scheduled today. He first walked slowly on the treadmill for 10 minutes to relax, then did 30 minutes of strength training focused on the core and upper body, to make up for the areas neglected during running.
location: Aoshiguang Gym, 80 meters southwest of the intersection of Jinxing Middle Road service road and Xiangjun Street, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Home dinner and evening preparation
description: After returning home, Feng Haoran changed into loose loungewear and made himself a light and healthy dinner: pan-seared chicken breast, boiled broccoli, and brown rice. While eating, he imported the RAW-format photos taken during the day into his computer to prepare for post-processing in the evening.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Photography post-processing
description: Feng Haoran opened Lightroom and started color correcting and cropping today's street photos. He particularly adjusted the dehaze and texture parameters patiently for that slow-shutter river photo, and was extremely satisfied with the final result.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Video call with parents
description: At around 8 p.m., Feng Haoran called his father Feng Jianguo on video as scheduled. On the screen, his parents looked hale and hearty. He excitedly shared the experience of the first run of the new year and the new running friends he had met, and mentioned his plan to seriously prepare for a half marathon. His father, as usual, reminded him to warm up properly, while his mother, Li Xiuying, worried about his stomach and told him to watch his diet.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Record New Year's vision and prepare for post-holiday work
description: After hanging up the video call, Feng Haoran was in a good mood. He fine-tuned the photos of the notebook taken today at Shangyin Coffee, and added the caption: 'The first goal of 2025 is to reach every destination more firmly.' Then he opened the company intranet, quickly browsed the major global market news during the New Year's Day holiday, mentally calculated the key points for communicating with clients after the holiday, and used his memo to write down the top three priorities for the next day's work.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Feng Haoran dimmed the lights, turned off all electronic devices, picked up the bedside book The Alchemy of Finance and read for over ten minutes, gradually relaxing his body and mind. He then turned off the light, pulled up the quilt, and soon fell asleep after a fulfilling and calm day, storing up energy for the coming new year.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Recovery morning run
description: Got up five minutes after the alarm went off. Outside the window was overcast with occasional drizzle, and it felt damp and cold. Put on a waterproof and windproof jacket and went out, jogged 4 kilometers along Lushan South Road at a pace of 6 minutes per kilometer. The leg muscles were gently stretched after the New Year's Day long run. The roadside breakfast stalls had just turned on their lights, and a slight smell of cooking oil wafted through the air.
location: Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Washing up, changing clothes, and making breakfast
description: After entering, he measured his weight at 75.1 kg on the body fat scale and felt good. He took a hot shower to relax his calf muscles. The New Year's Day finisher medal hanging on the bathroom mirror reminded him that his next goal is a half marathon. He changed into an ironed white shirt, dark gray suit pants, and a dark blue tie; his leather shoes were already polished. Breakfast was whole wheat toast toasted until crispy, paired with instant black coffee with milk—simple and efficient.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Metro commute and morning financial information preparation
description: He picked up his briefcase and folding umbrella, walked to Jinxing Road Metro Station. During the morning rush hour, the carriage was crowded. He put on Bluetooth earphones, opened the Wallstreetcn app, browsed the overnight movements in U.S. stock futures, U.S. Treasury yields, and global energy prices to warm up for the morning client portfolio assessment. He got off at Furong Square Station, bought a hot Americano at a convenience store at the exit for refreshment, and walked 3 minutes to the company.
location: Jinxing Road Station to Furong Square Station, Changsha Metro Line 2, Hunan Province

name: Arriving at work and warming up for the day
description: Walked into the office and nodded greetings to colleagues. Got a cup of water, returned to the desk, turned on the computer, logged into the internal system and the Bloomberg terminal, setting the hot Americano aside for now. Wrote down the list of three clients to handle in the morning on a sticky note: Huang Siqi, Lin Zhihao, and a private banking client surnamed Chen, and browsed unread client emails and market reports from the holiday.
location: Investment Advisor Office, 9th Floor, Huatai Securities Building, 111 Section 1, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Handle post-holiday client portfolio volatility evaluation
description: Fully focused on work. Downloaded the asset statements of three high-net-worth clients as of December 31, 2024, and calculated the beta, volatility, and maximum drawdown of each portfolio. Huang Siqi's account tilts toward technology growth, while Lin Zhihao's is balanced between cyclical and consumer. I analyzed the correlation of holdings and assessed whether rebalancing was needed. During this time, my phone vibrated three times; Huang Siqi sent a voice message asking for my view on the market. I replied that I was doing in-depth analysis and would provide a report later. The morning was immersed in data and charts.
location: Investment Advisor Office, 9th Floor, Huatai Securities Building, 111 Section 1, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Internal communication and ticket booking for Shenzhen summit
description: Got up to stretch my neck, walked to Zheng Wenbo's workstation to ask about the Shenzhen summit time, and the two chatted for ten minutes. Zheng Wenbo reminded me that it was initially scheduled for mid-January and suggested booking tickets early to avoid the Spring Festival travel rush. Back at my seat, I browsed high-speed rail schedules from Changsha to Shenzhen on the Ctrip app, favorited 2 suitable trains, and planned to pay after the meeting process was confirmed. Then I saved the draft evaluation report generated in the morning into an encrypted folder.
location: Investment Advisor Office, 9th Floor, Huatai Securities Building, 111 Section 1, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Lunch (xiaolongbao at Wanda Plaza)
description: He invited colleague Zheng Wenbo to go eat together. The two took the elevator downstairs, walked through the office lobby, and were hit by the cold air. Wanda Plaza was right across the street, reachable by crossing the road. Instead of the usual Hunan restaurant, they went to the newly opened Lao Sheng Chang Soup Bun Shop. They ordered two baskets of signature fresh pork soup dumplings, a bowl of hot and sour soup, and a bowl of congee. As they ate, they chatted about market trends, the company's year-end double salary, and next year's bonus structure, in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Lao Shengchang Soup Bun Restaurant, B1, Wanda Plaza, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Midday rest and review of strategy meeting materials.
description: After the meal, he went to the pantry and made an instant coffee. Holding the coffee, he walked to the floor-to-ceiling window and briefly zoned out watching the street below. Back at his desk, he opened the electronic materials for the 2 p.m. strategy meeting and quickly scanned the core topics: 2025 key product lines, customer growth targets, and new compliance regulations. He wrote a simple framework in his notebook and outlined key points for his proposed online customer acquisition idea.
location: Break area and workstation on the 9th floor of Huatai Securities Building, 111 Furong Middle Road Section 1, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Attended the department's annual strategy meeting
description: At 2 p.m., he walked into the large conference room on the 17th floor with colleagues and put his phone on silent. Investment Director Qian Yongqiang chaired the meeting, reviewed the gains and losses of 2024, and emphasized that this year's focus is to improve customer growth. Feng Ming carefully took notes on key points: adjusting the product line toward multi-asset allocation, and optimizing service processes under the new compliance requirements. When Director Qian asked for new ideas on business growth, he raised his hand and spoke, offering ideas from the perspectives of new media operations, online customer acquisition channels, and young client conversion. Director Qian nodded, saying the ideas were good and that a preliminary plan could be discussed after the meeting. The meeting lasted 2 hours, and his thinking was fully stretched.
location: Large Conference Room, 17F, Huatai Securities Building, No. 111, Section 1, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan

name: Post-meeting organization and quarterly work planning
description: Immediately after the meeting, I returned to my desk and seized the moment to organize my notes, transcribing the key points emphasized by Mr. Qian and the cases shared by colleagues into the work log. Then I planned my personal quarterly work plan, making the online client acquisition plan a key task, listed the steps for collecting materials and asking the IT department, and arranged phone calls with Huang Siqi and Lin Zhihao next week, confirming to write market opinions every Wednesday afternoon. Outside the window, the sky had already darkened.
location: Investment Advisor Office, 9th Floor, Huatai Securities Building, 111 Section 1, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: After-work commute
description: At 5:40, I tidied up my desk, shut down my computer, put on my coat and backpack, and said goodbye to my colleagues. I walked to Furong Square Station and took Metro Line 2 back to Jinxing Road Station. The evening rush hour was lighter than the morning, and I got a seat. I stared absentmindedly at the tunnel walls outside the window, digesting the afternoon meeting content. Thirty minutes later, I arrived at the station and walked five minutes back to the residential area.
location: From Furong Square Station to Jinxing Road Station on Metro Line 2, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening indoor yoga stretching.
description: Back home, I changed into loose sportswear and laid out the yoga mat in the living room. The weather was damp and cold, with light rain outside, so it was perfect for indoor stretching. I opened the Keep app and followed a 40-minute full-body stretching and yoga class, from Child's Pose to Downward-Facing Dog. The muscles on the back of my thighs and calves were gently stretched. Focusing on movement and breath, my body and mind relaxed.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, living room

name: Draft the weekend half-marathon training framework and contact running friends.
description: After yoga, instead of showering immediately, sat at the desk in the study. In the phone memo app, entered 'weekend half marathon training plan'. Based on the feeling of the 10K run on New Year's Day, designed an initial 4-week framework: Tuesday tempo run 5k at 5:30/km pace, Thursday interval run 400m x 8 at 4:50/km pace, Saturday long run 15k at 6:00/km pace, followed by strength training. Screenshotted the framework and sent it to running buddy Gao Yunfei, with a message asking about training together on the weekend. He replied immediately and agreed.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Cooking a simple dinner
description: I took out eggs, greens, tomatoes, and dried noodles from the fridge. I heated the wok with cold oil and fried the eggs until the edges were lightly browned, while boiling water for the noodles. When the noodles were about 70% cooked, I added the greens and simmered. I scooped the noodles and greens into a bowl, poured over the tomato-egg soup base, topped with the fried egg, and added two drops of sesame oil. It tasted light and delicious.
location: Kitchen, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Reading “Strategic Management” and MBA preview.
description: After the meal, I cleared the dishes, made a cup of hot tea, and opened Chapter 1 of the Strategic Management textbook in the study to preview for my MBA. With a highlighter, I marked key concepts: Five Forces Model, core competence, and Blue Ocean Strategy. I also tried to use the theories in the book to analyze a new energy company case, jotting down my thoughts in a notebook, occasionally glancing at the time on my phone.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Leisure and organizing street snapshots.
description: After reading for more than an hour, I decided to relax. I imported the photos taken by the Xiangjiang River on New Year's Day from the camera into my laptop, used Lightroom to quickly browse and select a few with good composition and lighting, adjusted the exposure and contrast simply, and planned to go out to take photos on the weekend if the weather is good.
location: Study and living room, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening preparation for bed and falling asleep
description: Put down the camera and went to the bathroom to wash up: washed face carefully with warm water and facial cleanser, brushed teeth, applied night moisturizer, and changed into pajamas. Before bed, checked the phone alarm, browsed WeChat messages, and replied a few lines in the Yuelu Running Group, then turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. Lying in bed, briefly reviewed the day: work progressed as planned, exercise was on point, learning made progress, and felt fulfilled. Closed eyes and took a few deep breaths, mind relaxed, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Early Rise and Morning Run Preparation
description: Woke up at 6:30 a.m. by the alarm, realized today is Friday, and tomorrow I will practice with Gao Yunfei at Yuelu Mountain. Weighed in at 74.9 kg, drank a glass of warm water, changed into a windbreaker, compression pants, and running shoes, opened the curtains to confirm it was cloudy and felt cold, then prepared for the morning run.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning run on Lushan South Road
description: After leaving, jog along Lushan South Road to Dongfanghong Square and turn back, completing a 5 km easy run at a pace of 5:30 per km as a tune-up before high-intensity training. Pay special attention to the left knee; no discomfort. On a winter morning run, exhale white mist and savor the unique charm.
location: Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Post-run rest, shower, and breakfast
description: After getting home, stretched on a yoga mat for 10 minutes to relax calves and hip flexors, then took a hot shower and changed into a shirt and trousers. Made hand-brewed Colombian Huila drip-bag coffee, toasted whole wheat bread, and fried a runny-yolk egg. While eating breakfast, browsed global financial news on the phone, focusing on the U.S. new energy sector, preparing for the upcoming meeting with Lin Zhihao. At the same time, put the running backpack and water bottle for tomorrow by the entryway.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Commute by car
description: Drove to the company, playing a financial podcast in the car discussing New Year A-share investment strategies, and mentally rehearsed the meeting process with Lin Zhihao while listening.
location: On the way to Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Arrive at the company and prepare client materials.
description: Arrived at Huatai Securities Building, first refilled a cup of American coffee, briefly confirmed with colleague Zheng Wenbo that the private room at Xiangyue House for lunch was booked. Then entered the small meeting room, printed the '2024 Q4 Investment Portfolio Review and 2025 Allocation Plan', checked the comparison charts of REITs and the new energy sector, and highlighted the key points of the presentation logic with a red pen, ensuring an efficient and precise meeting.
location: Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Client meeting.
description: Client Lin Zhihao arrived on time. Feng Haoran calmly reviewed last quarter's performance, explained that real estate trusts were affected by interest rate fluctuations, and presented a new allocation plan increasing the solar and energy storage sectors. Lin Zhihao shared a friend's successful case in the new energy field and expressed willingness to try it. Both agreed to refine the plan next week; the meeting atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Small Meeting Room, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Midday work: handle reimbursements and afternoon work
description: Back at my workstation, I immediately processed the backlogged travel and client entertainment reimbursements in the OA system, verified the e-invoices from the mid-December Shenzhen business trip, and submitted them. After lunch, I wrote a WeChat message to supervisor Qian Yongqiang asking to leave one hour early and got approval. Then I organized the morning meeting minutes, emailed the relevant people about next week's client interview schedule, and flipped through 5 pages of the Strategic Management e-book to prepare for the evening discussion.
location: Workstation at Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Team lunch
description: Walked with colleagues Zheng Wenbo and director Qian Yongqiang to Xiangyue Tower for lunch. Qian Yongqiang talked about inviting guests to the Shenzhen summit, Zheng Wenbo shared the internal promotion assessment timeline, and Feng Haoran listened carefully and secretly planned to tighten his diet control after the Spring Festival.
location: Xiangyue Building, near Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Commuting to Changsha Library
description: At 14:25, I shut down the computer, walked to the subway station, and took Line 4 to Binjiang Cultural Park in Kaifu District. On the subway, I quickly browsed the preview of Daniels' Running Formula on Kindle, focusing on the interval training theory chapter.
location: Near Metro Line 4 and Binjiang Cultural Park, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Looked up running materials in the library
description: Found Daniels' Running Formula and Advanced Marathoning in the sports reading area of Changsha Library, and used his phone memo to excerpt key information on threshold run pace and lactate threshold. During this time, a college student asked about getting started with running; Feng Haoran recommended Injury-Free Running based on his own experience and shared the benefits of morning running.
location: Sports Reading Area, Changsha Library, Binjiang Cultural Park, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Buy professional running socks.
description: After leaving the library, took Metro Line 2 back to Yuelu District, got off at Yingwanzhen Station, walked to a sports brand store in Wanda Plaza, bought two pairs of professional five-toe running socks, and prepared to try them out during tomorrow's joint training.
location: Sports brand store, Wanda Plaza, Yingwan Town, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Buying groceries on the way and arriving home
description: Walked home from Wanda Plaza, stopped by the convenience store in Meilin Yingu International Community on the way to buy tomatoes, eggs, baby bok choy, and dried noodles, then carried the groceries back to the neighborhood, switching from work mode to a relaxed state of mind and body.
location: From the convenience store at Meilin Yingu International Community, No. 344 Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province to Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community

name: Returned home, tidied up, and cooked dinner.
description: Transcribed the day's running notes from the library into the training log, put the new running socks and running backpack together, and did 10 minutes of office stretching to relax the shoulders and neck. Then used the purchased ingredients to cook a bowl of light and nutritious tomato, egg, and vegetable noodles as dinner, quickly cleaned up the kitchen, and brewed a pot of hot tea.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Online MBA exchange.
description: Punctually connected with university classmate Zhou Yuwei on Tencent Meeting. Zhou Yuwei reminded that the 'Strategic Management' course is strictly graded, suggested reading the cases in advance and forming a study group after the semester starts, and also shared tips for preparing for the CFA Level III exam. Feng Haoran carefully noted all the suggestions, feeling both pressure and motivation.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: MBA self-study
description: After ending the call, I opened the first chapter of the Strategic Management textbook and, following Zhou Yuwei's suggestion, studied the application cases of Porter's Five Forces model in advance, highlighting the core points with a marker. Although it was a bit challenging, I persisted and finished.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Video call with father.
description: Dialed father Feng Jianguo's WeChat video, chatted about weekend plans, told him that tomorrow morning I would go to Yuelu Mountain with Gao Yunfei for a joint training session. Father reminded me to watch the weather and not overdo it. The two of us also briefly talked about recent work, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening personal time: hobbies, reading, and review
description: After finishing the video, I imported the New Year's Day street snapshots into the computer for simple editing, logged into the stamp forum to check the market for Shenzhou spacecraft commemorative stamps, and interacted with fellow collector Luo Zhenyu. Before washing up, I leaned against the headboard and read 10 pages of "The Alchemy of Finance", then wrote today's review in my notebook: client meeting went smoothly, reimbursement processed, efficiently completed data research and equipment purchase, communication with Zhou Yuwei was rewarding but MBA pressure is beginning to show; self-rating 8.5.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Set the alarm for 6:00 tomorrow morning, checked the running backpack and energy gels at the entrance again, lay in bed, briefly reviewed the knowledge points discussed with Zhou Yuwei, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning preparation and departure to the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain.
description: The alarm rang on time. Feng Haoran rolled out of bed, drank a glass of room-temperature water, quickly washed up, put on running shoes and compression clothes, checked that his sports watch was fully charged, and stuffed an energy gel and a bottle of mineral water into his waist pack. Before leaving, he confirmed that his phone and keys were in his pockets, then set off from Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, turned right along Shuangtang Road onto Lushan South Road, and walked briskly toward the east gate of Yuelu Mountain. On the early morning street, there were only a few morning exercisers and the lights of a few steamed bun shops. The air was cool and fresh. As he walked, he adjusted his breathing to prepare for the upcoming training.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Meeting and training route confirmation
description: Feng Haoran arrived at the East Gate Square of Yuelu Mountain five minutes early, and his running partner Gao Yunfei was already stretching there. After a brief greeting, they reconfirmed today's 15-kilometer route: from the East Gate along Lushan South Road to Aiwan Pavilion, then up to the sightseeing cable car station and back. Feng Haoran synced the route on his watch and pulled up the heart rate monitoring interface.
location: East Gate Square, Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, No. 58 Denggao Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: 15 km long-distance training
description: At 6:15 they started running on time. Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei maintained the planned pace of 5:30 per kilometer along the roads of Yuelu Mountain. On uphill sections, he deliberately increased his arm swing and adjusted his breathing rhythm; at the 8 km mark, when passing Aiwan Pavilion, they stopped for 90 seconds to hydrate; on downhill sections, he controlled his cadence to reduce impact on his knees. They finished the full distance in 2 hours and 15 minutes, with heart rate stable at 140-155 beats per minute. Along the way, the sunrise dyed the sky red, and Gao Yunfei exclaimed: 'This is a runner's privilege.'
location: Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Post-training stretching and review, and finalizing next week's training schedule
description: After returning to the East Gate Square of Yuelu Mountain, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei sat down for a 15-minute static stretch, focusing on relaxing the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. Gao Yunfei praised Feng Haoran for his endurance, and Feng Haoran mentioned a slight tightness in his right hip. The two checked their pace and heart rate data on their watches and agreed that the current pace is suitable for building a foundation. Then they sat on a roadside stone bench and used their phone memos to draft next week's joint training plan: Tuesday morning Feng Haoran runs an 8-10 km tempo run alone; Thursday early morning joint tempo run of 8-10 km; Saturday morning joint long run of 16 km with progressive increase. Feng Haoran proactively suggested sending a weekly reminder in the group every Friday, and Gao Yunfei joked that this is "managing training with an investor's risk-control mindset."
location: East Gate Square, Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, No. 58 Denggao Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Walked home and took a shower to recover
description: After saying goodbye to Gao Yunfei, Feng Haoran walked home along Lushan South Road. The morning breeze blew against his slightly damp running clothes, bringing a hint of chill, but he felt energetic and happy. When he got home, he took off his running clothes, took a warm shower to relax his muscles, and especially ran hot water over his right hip that felt tight. After washing, he changed into comfortable loungewear.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Hearty breakfast and energy replenishment
description: In the dining room, Feng Haoran prepared a high-protein breakfast for himself: two fried eggs, two slices of whole wheat toast, a glass of hot milk, plus a small handful of nuts. While eating, he browsed a few financial news briefs he had missed last night on his phone, but didn't read them in depth—today's goal was to completely relax.
location: Home dining room, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning chores, reading, and lunch.
description: After breakfast, Feng Haoran didn't want chores to pile up. He first wiped the dust and mud spots off the surface of his running shoes with a damp cloth, took out the insoles, crumpled newspaper and stuffed it into the shoes to absorb moisture, and set them on the ventilated balcony to dry. Then he threw the dirty running clothes into the washing machine and started the quick wash mode. While the washing machine was running, he half-reclined on the living room sofa, flipping through the "Sichuan-Tibet Self-Drive" feature in the National Geographic magazine he had borrowed yesterday, admiring the magnificent landscape photos and imagining possible future self-drive routes. After the washing machine cycle ended, he took out the running clothes and hung them on the balcony to dry. Then he cooked himself a bowl of tomato and egg noodle soup, adding a few leftover greens from the refrigerator as lunch. After the meal, he washed the dishes, and the kitchen returned to its tidy state.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Midday nap
description: Nearly 1 a.m., drowsiness after long-distance training set in. Feng Haoran set a 30-minute alarm, drew the curtains, and lay on the bed for deep relaxation and rest.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Afternoon recovery and interaction with family and friends.
description: After waking from his nap, his energy was largely restored. Feng Haoran brewed a cup of tea, continued lounging on the sofa reading a magazine for a while, then moved to the desk and used his tablet to browse marathon training posts on a running forum. At that moment, college alumna Peng Yuqing sent an invitation to dinner in the evening. Citing that he was too tired after today's high-intensity training and needed to recover, he politely declined: "I'm too tired after today's high-intensity training and want to focus on recovery. How about we meet next week? Have fun!" After replying, he continued enjoying his leisurely time.
location: Living room and study at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Accumulation and exploration of photographic aesthetics
description: In order not to waste the afternoon, Feng Haoran opened the photography website on his tablet in his study and browsed the featured works updated that day under the themes “City Scenery” and “Street Photography.” He liked the photos he enjoyed and studied the composition and color of highly-liked works, rekindling his desire to go street shooting with his camera next week.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Solo city walk and coffee time
description: Having stayed home for too long, Feng Haoran wanted to go out for some fresh air. He changed into casual clothes and drove to his usual coffee shop, Shangyin Coffee on Chaozong Street (about 30 minutes' drive). There were only a few customers in the shop. He ordered a cup of new beans recommended by the owner Shen Xinyi today — Ethiopian Guji pour-over. He sat by the window, purely observing passersby outside and listening to the jazz in the shop, completely relaxed in body and mind.
location: Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street Branch), No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Returning home and sorting out package pickups
description: After finishing his coffee, Feng Haoran drove home at a leisurely pace. On the way, he picked up the new running socks he had ordered two days earlier at the Cainiao station at the entrance of his residential community. After arriving home, he tidied up the living room briefly and put the scattered magazines back on the bookshelf.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Preparing a light dinner
description: Feng Haoran decided to have a light dinner. He cut up half a broccoli, paired it with chicken breast, cooked it simply with olive oil and black pepper, and also steamed two purple sweet potatoes. It was rare for him to have the time and the mood to cook a meal slowly, and he enjoyed the pleasure that cooking brought.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Family video call
description: After dinner, Feng Haoran made a video call to his parents, who are far away in Wuhan. His father, Feng Jianguo, was very happy to hear that he had completed a 15-kilometer training run today and reminded him not to train too hard and hurt his knees. His mother, Li Xiuying, as always, asked whether he was eating on time and sleeping well. After chatting for half an hour about family matters, he felt a sense of peace.
location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Running form technique study and notes
description: At 7:30 in the evening, Feng Haoran perked up and entered the scheduled learning session. He turned on the projector, cast his phone screen onto the wall, and played the saved video Pose Running Method Explained. He followed the demonstrations and did several sets of key running posture and forward lean awareness exercises in the open space of the living room. After each section, he recorded key points in his notebook, such as the landing point should be directly below the hips.
location: Study and living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan

name: Organizing training logs and filling in the weekly plan
description: After studying, Feng Haoran opened the Excel spreadsheet on his computer and entered today's training data with Gao Yunfei (total duration, average pace, average heart rate), and also filled in next week's schedule (Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday plans) in the remarks column. At the bottom of the notes, he seriously wrote: "April half marathon, just finish, but seek no injuries."
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening recharging and sleep
description: Feng Haoran charged his phone and sports watch, and after washing up, placed the recovery run gear he might wear tomorrow morning on the chair in advance. He took out "The Alchemy of Finance", leaned against the headboard and read for 15 minutes, but found his mind still immersed in the sense of achievement from exercise, so he resolutely closed the book and turned off the main light. Then he dimmed the bedside lamp, put on a relaxing eye mask, and did 5 minutes of deep abdominal breathing, feeling the slight soreness and satisfaction in his body. Drowsiness gradually set in, and around 10:45 he fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Wake-up and hip activation.
description: After the 7 a.m. alarm went off, didn't get up immediately but lay in bed doing 5 minutes of child's pose and hip circles to wake up the body, easing the right hip tightness from yesterday's long-distance training and helping the body transition smoothly to a waking state.
location: Master bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Early morning recovery jog
description: I put on a windbreaker and went out, doing a recovery jog along the sidewalk of Jinxing Road, keeping the pace at 6:30 per kilometer and heart rate between 130 and 135, focusing on my breathing. At the 20-minute mark, a light drizzle began to fall, so I quickened my pace slightly and returned home.
location: Along Jinxing Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (jogging along Jinxing Road starting from Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community)

name: Breakfast downstairs
description: After finishing the jog, I went to the authentic Old Changsha rice noodle roll shop outside the north gate of the neighborhood, ordered an egg rice noodle roll and a cup of unsweetened soy milk, chatted with the owner for a bit, and enjoyed breakfast.
location: Authentic Old Changsha Rice Roll Shop, outside the north gate of Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Go home, take a shower, and relax with a foam roller
description: Back home, I took a hot shower, focusing the hot water on the right hip area to relax the muscles. Then I changed into dry loungewear and used a foam roller on the yoga mat in the living room to roll out the front and back of my thighs and calves, holding each area for 30 seconds. This significantly relieved muscle stiffness.
location: Bathroom and living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99, Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Organize stamp exhibits and handwritten labels.
description: In the study, I opened the professional collection cabinet, took out the 1994 *Three Gorges of the Yangtze River* stamp album, put on cotton gloves, and used German tweezers to carefully inspect the perforations, gum, and printing details of each stamp. I selected four 'Baidi City' stamps in perfect condition and placed them in protective stamp mounts. Then I handwrote several descriptive labels, noting the issuance background and collecting significance.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Prepare materials for the exchange meeting and conduct online communication
description: Opened the laptop, scanned and archived the handwritten labels, logged into the collectibles forum to browse recent philatelic market hot topics. Saw a private message from fellow collector Luo Zhenyu in Shenzhen, briefly replied about today's exchange meeting arrangement, and agreed to share experiences later.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Lunch and browsing financial news
description: In the kitchen, I simply made a bowl of tomato and egg noodles. Then I carried the noodles to the living room and, while eating, used my iPad to browse next week's financial calendar and several in-depth analysis reports on the new energy sector, warming up for tomorrow's work.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Change clothes, set off, and take a taxi to Qinghe Teahouse
description: Put on a dark gray sweater and a black down vest, placed the prepared stamp positioning clips, notebook, pen, and spare tweezers into a canvas briefcase, and checked phone, wallet, and keys. Then used Didi to hail a car, departing from Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community for Qinghe Teahouse on Jiefang West Road, Tianxin District. The traffic was smooth along the way, arriving at the teahouse in about 25 minutes.
location: On the way from Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province to Qinghe Teahouse near the intersection of Jiefang West Road and Fuqing Street, Tianxin District.

name: Arriving early, warm-up communication, and formal check-in
description: Arrived at Qinghe Teahouse ahead of time, sat by the window in the hall, and ordered a pot of Anhua dark tea. Soon two collector friends who arrived early also came, and we naturally chatted about collections. Later, the other collector friends arrived one after another, and we moved to the reserved private room. I helped organize the check-in, handed out name cards, and exchanged greetings with a few collector friends I had interacted with on the forum. The atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Hall and private rooms of Qinghe Teahouse, near the intersection of Jiefang West Road and Fuqing Street, Tianxin District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Stamp collecting exchange meeting (first half)
description: After the host's opening remarks, collectors took turns presenting and sharing. He was the third to go on stage, introducing his collection experience and condition insights regarding "Changjiang Three Gorges: Baidi City". Senior collector Old Zhou commented that the stamp's condition reached Very Fine, and suggested paying attention to the matching "1994-18 River Closure Commemorative Postal Card". He took careful notes, then admired the Qing Dynasty Red Revenue stamps and the Republic of China Junk Ship stamps, and was deeply impressed.
location: Private room at Qinghe Teahouse near the intersection of Jiefang West Road and Fuqing Street, Tianxin District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Free exchange and making new friends
description: During the free exchange session, Mr. Liu, a philatelist from Changde, took the initiative to sit over, and the two had an in-depth discussion on techniques for identifying the authenticity of stamps. Mr. Liu shared a great deal of practical experience and showed his thematic stamp collection on 'Changde Anti-Japanese War,' which has extremely high historical value. They exchanged mailing addresses and phone numbers and agreed to send each other local specialty philatelic items monthly. During the conversation, he accidentally knocked off the tweezers, bending the tip, so he switched to spare tweezers.
location: Private room at Qinghe Teahouse near the intersection of Jiefang West Road and Fuqing Street, Tianxin District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Second half of the exchange meeting and the tasting session
description: In the second half, the discussion went deeper into the appreciation and identification of the "Red Revenue" and "Republic of China Junk Ship" stamps. A senior collector explained how to distinguish printings by examining the paper, ink, and perforations. The entire session was extremely information-dense, and I filled three full pages of notes.
location: Private room at Qinghe Teahouse near the intersection of Jiefang West Road and Fuqing Street, Tianxin District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: End of event and return trip
description: After the exchange meeting ended, I said goodbye to familiar collection friends. Walking out of the teahouse, the sky had darkened and the light rain had stopped. I called a Didi and returned to my home in Yuelu District. The roads were smooth.
location: On the way from Qinghe Teahouse near the intersection of Jiefang West Road and Fuqing Street, Tianxin District, Changsha, Hunan Province, to Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District.

name: Returning home, tidying up, and restoring collections to their proper places
description: After getting home, he first sorted the received business cards by region and spread out his notebook to review key points. Then, using spare tweezers, he carefully returned the displayed stamp album to the study collection cabinet.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: Before dinner, sitting on the living room sofa, he made a video call to his mother, who was far away in Wuhan. They chatted for half an hour. His mother asked about his work and health, and told him to dress warmly as it was getting cold. He showed his mother the photos of stamps he had organized today. His mother praised his hobbies as tasteful, and they agreed that he would visit Wuhan at the end of the month.
location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Dinner and sharing on WeChat.
description: Heated up the leftover tomato egg noodles from lunch and pan-fried a chicken breast for dinner. While eating, sent photos and takeaways from today's exchange session to Luo Zhenyu in Shenzhen via WeChat. Luo Zhenyu quickly replied, saying he might come to Changsha in March for an exhibition, and the two agreed to meet then.
location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Ordering new tweezers and shopping
description: Logged into Taobao, searched for and ordered a new pair of German imported tweezers, expected to arrive the day after tomorrow. Also noticed that the January 2025 issue of National Geographic is on sale, so ordered a copy as well.
location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Preparation for next week's work
description: Sat at the desk, reviewed tomorrow's (Monday) schedule, and confirmed there were no conflicts. Based on today's financial news and client Lin Zhihao's investment preferences, drafted a preliminary outline of allocation recommendations for the new energy sector, to be refined and discussed in tomorrow's meeting.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening relaxed reading and bedtime preparation
description: Changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, reading the chapter on how to find joy in recovery runs from The Running Bible borrowed from Changsha Library yesterday, feeling relaxed in both body and mind. After reading, got out of bed and did 5 minutes of pre-sleep stretching, focusing on the back of the thighs and hips. Then brushed teeth and washed face, checked tomorrow's weather — overcast turning to light rain — and reminded myself to bring an umbrella when going to work tomorrow morning.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Recording the Day and Preparing for Bed
description: In the phone memo, I recorded today's gains: the recovery run went well, I benefited a lot from the exchange meeting, I agreed with a collector friend in Changde to mail each other items, and I ordered new tweezers. I did a set of abdominal breathing and fell asleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning wake-up, core exercise, and breakfast news
description: Woken by his phone alarm at 6:50. It was raining outside, so the morning run was cancelled. Completed a 15-minute core activation session on the yoga mat in the living room: 2 sets of 2-minute planks, 2 sets of supine leg raises, and one set each of side plank and bird-dog. After showering, prepared whole wheat toast with fried egg and hand-brewed coffee (Colombian Huila beans). While eating breakfast, browsed work WeChat on his phone, read the semiconductor industry analysis article forwarded by Mr. Qian, and quickly checked the overnight U.S. stock quotes pushed by Bloomberg.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Commute and news reading.
description: I left at 7:30, walked with an umbrella to Exit 2 of Jinxing Road Metro Station, and bought hot soy milk at the convenience store near the community gate on the way. I took Metro Line 2 from Jinxing Road Station to Furong Middle Road Station, sat in the carriage, listened to the Bloomberg morning news podcast via Bluetooth headphones, paying attention to the impact of the Fed governor's speech on the dollar and gold, and read the chapter on investment psychology in Poor Charlie's Almanack on WeChat Reading.
location: Changsha Metro Line 2 (section from Jinxing Road Station to Furong Middle Road Station)

name: Morning meeting preparation and department weekly meeting
description: At 8:28, exited the station and walked to Huatai Securities Building, buying soda crackers at the convenience store downstairs. Went to workstation 705 on the 7th floor, opened the computer, logged into the Wind terminal and OA system, tidied the desk, and prepared materials for the 9 o'clock departmental morning meeting. At 9 o'clock, attended the departmental weekly meeting, chaired by Director Qian Yongqiang, which reviewed last week's market and customer service situation, assigned this week's tasks, and stressed the material preparation and itinerary coordination for next week's Shenzhen summit. Zheng Wenbo confirmed that the summit material list was basically complete.
location: Meeting room, 7th floor, Huatai Securities Building, 369 Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Handle VIP client investment consultations.
description: After the meeting, I returned to my desk and handled an email from VIP client Huang Siqi, who was worried about tech stock valuations. Feng Haoran retrieved her holdings, trading records, and risk assessment report, organized the data, and sent a detailed voice analysis via WeChat, suggesting that she could reduce her tech stock positions by 10%-15% in batches, lock in partial profits, and watch for opportunities in the consumer sector after the adjustment.
location: Workspace 705, 7F, Huatai Securities Building, 369 Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Write weekly investment report for high-end clients
description: Focused on writing the "High-Net-Worth Client Investment Weekly Report," integrating weekly market performance of A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, and US stocks, and analyzing it in light of expectations of a shift in domestic monetary policy. It took 1 hour and 15 minutes to complete the first draft, covering market review, core strategies, sector allocation suggestions, and personalized notes for VIP clients, and submitted it to Director Qian Yongqiang via OA for review.
location: Workspace 705, 7F, Huatai Securities Building, 369 Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

While eating, they had an in-depth discussion about the specific arrangements for next week's Shenzhen summit. Zheng Wenbo mentioned the private equity firms he wanted to focus on contacting, Feng Haoran shared potential business cooperation opportunities, and also asked about his wife's yoga experience, getting a recommendation. After the meal, they walked back to the company together.
location: Hunan Province, Changsha City, Kaifu District, 589 Zhongshan Road, Wanda Plaza, Zone C, Jiulongcang Xiaolongbao.

description: After returning to his workstation, he closed his eyes and rested for 10 minutes. He received feedback from Boss Qian via the OA system, requesting that the weekly report add a chart showing changes in core asset allocation ratios and an additional paragraph on northbound capital flow analysis. Feng Haoran revised it immediately and submitted the final version before the lunch break ended.
location: Workspace 705, 7F, Huatai Securities Building, 369 Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Quarterly compliance training.

Feng Haoran sat in the front row, listening attentively and taking detailed notes, focusing on the compliance red lines for investment advice push, customer suitability management, and new media stock recommendations. After the training, he completed the online test through the company app.
location: Large conference room, 7th floor, Huatai Securities Building, No. 369 Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Compliance consulting and training note organization
description: As soon as the training ended, Feng Haoran went to the Compliance Department office to find specialist Li Hui to consult about the promotional wording for next week's Moments ad campaign for the strategy product. Li Hui gave clear guidance that promotional promises are prohibited, and the maximum drawdown and risk warnings must be stated. After confirming the article draft, he left. Back at his desk, he organized the training e-notes, focusing on summarizing the newly added prohibitive clauses, saved them to his personal knowledge base, and browsed the latest strategy views from brokers such as CICC and CITIC Securities.
location: Compliance Department office and workstation 705 on the 7th floor, Huatai Securities Building, 369 Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province
