location: 'Fintech and Digital Human' zone, Exhibition Hall 1, Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center, 111 Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Return to the hotel to rest
description: Because of the overwhelming amount of information and physical fatigue, he took a taxi and returned to the hotel early. In the room, he applied a hot towel to his eyes and lay flat with eyes closed to rest for half an hour.
location: Room, Shenzhen Jingju Hotel, No. 78 Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Organize summit insights and work report
description: At the hotel desk, organized the core insights and technical details from the forum and exhibition into a concise PDF, shared it with Qian Yongqiang and colleague Zheng Wenbo via WeChat, and agreed to share in detail at the Monday morning meeting.
location: At the desk in the room at Shenzhen Jingju Hotel, No. 78 Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Go to the hot pot restaurant and order in advance
description: After changing into a clean casual shirt, he took a taxi to Baheli Chaoshan Beef Hotpot Restaurant. Arriving early, he chose a booth and, based on university tastes, ordered hanging tender, tender meat, beef balls and vegetables, then waited for Zhao Tianyu to arrive. Meanwhile, he browsed tomorrow's MBA online course materials on his phone.
location: Baheli Chaoshan Fresh Beef Hotpot (Shenzhen Nanshan Hi-tech Store), Keji South 8th Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Dinner with roommate Zhao Tianyu
description: Zhao Tianyu arrived on time. The two shook hands and hugged, then talked freely over hotpot. Zhao Tianyu shared his experience working as a product manager at Tencent and the age anxiety in the internet industry, while Feng Haoran talked about the pressure of promotion and digital transformation in the traditional finance industry. They encouraged each other, and Zhao Tianyu half-jokingly invited him to consider transitioning to the internet industry. The meal lasted until 21:30, and they took a group photo at the entrance as a memento.
location: Baheli Chaoshan Fresh Beef Hotpot (Shenzhen Nanshan Hi-tech Store), Keji South 8th Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Walking back to the hotel and contacting family.
description: After dinner, walked 2.5 kilometers back to the hotel, enjoying the night view of the Science Park and taking photos. Along the way, I sent a WeChat message to my mother to let her know I was safe and shared dinner photos, and chatted with my sister Feng Xinran on WeChat.
location: Along the route from Keji South 8th Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province to No. 78 Jingtian Road, Futian District

name: Daily review and preparation for tomorrow
description: After returning to the hotel and taking a shower, I reviewed the day, recorded information about new contacts and potential cooperation points, and sorted out the directions that need further study from the summit learning notes. I placed 'The Intelligent Investor' on the bedside to read tomorrow.
location: Room, Shenzhen Jingju Hotel, No. 78 Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Read The Intelligent Investor for 15 minutes, then set the alarm for 7:30 the next day, turned off the lights, and went to bed.
location: On the bed at Shenzhen Jingju Hotel, 78 Jingtian Road, Futian District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Morning core strength training
description: At 7 o'clock sharp, the phone alarm rang on time. Outside the window, the sky over Shenzhen was still gloomy, with low clouds, indicating the morning run plan was ruined. Feng Haoran immediately turned over and got out of bed, relying on his ENTJ drive and not lazing around. He changed into an athletic short-sleeved shirt and shorts, spread out a portable yoga mat on the floor of the room, opened the Keep app on his phone, chose a 30-minute 'Advanced Core Strength' course, and completed movements such as planks, lying leg raises, and Russian twists, focusing on feeling the core muscles engage. Sweat soon soaked his forehead and clothes. Dynamic stretches were interspersed between sets to gradually warm up the body. After the 45-minute workout, he wiped off the sweat with a towel, felt full of strength, and was completely refreshed mentally.
location: Room at Shenzhen Yueju Boutique Hotel, No. 18 Keji Zhong'er Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Business breakfast and information sorting
description: Feng Haoran changed into a dry shirt and went to the self-service restaurant on the first floor of the hotel. He took a tray and picked the signature nutritious set meal: two boiled eggs, a bowl of millet porridge, two slices of whole wheat toast, and a cup of unsweetened hot soy milk. He chose a seat by the window and sat down, eating leisurely while quickly browsing the morning headlines on 'Wallstreetcn' and 'Cailian Press' via his phone, focusing on the dovish remarks by Fed officials last night and the overnight rebound in US stocks. Then, he opened WeChat and sent several voice messages to his colleague Zheng Wenbo, confirming the adjustment logic for a key recommended stock in next week's morning meeting materials. At the same time, he did a final check of the 10 o'clock meeting arrangement with Zhang Mingxuan to ensure everything was foolproof.
location: First-floor buffet restaurant, Shenzhen Yueju Boutique Hotel, No. 18 Keji Zhong'er Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Check-out and luggage storage
description: After breakfast, Feng Haoran returned to the room, carefully organized 'The Intelligent Investor' and the summit materials he had looked through the night before, stuffed them into his backpack, and checked every corner of the room to make sure he left no personal items behind, especially the summit notes signed by an old friend from Shenzhen. At exactly 9:00, he dragged his suitcase to the front desk to check out, told the staff that he needed to store his luggage until 2 p.m., and the staff skillfully printed his luggage tag and directed him to the dedicated luggage storage room. Carrying only his backpack (containing 'Python Financial Big Data Analysis', the summit notebook, and a power bank), he walked out of the hotel lightly, feeling refreshed and walking briskly.
location: Lobby and front desk of Shenzhen Yueju Boutique Hotel, No. 18 Keji Zhong'er Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Walk to Tencent Binhai Building
description: Walking out of the hotel, the sky was still somewhat overcast, but fortunately it didn't rain. Feng Haoran took a deep breath of Shenzhen's slightly humid air and opened Baidu Maps for navigation. It takes about 20 minutes to walk from the hotel to Tencent Seafront Towers. He walked north along Keji Zhong'er Road, crossed several traffic light intersections, and passed several tech-filled corporate buildings along the way. He stopped with interest and used his phone to take a 'Today's Shenzhen' check-in photo—a building facade full of lines—and shared it to his Moments.
location: Along the route from Keji Middle 2nd Road to Haitian 2nd Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Visit Tencent Binhai Tower and learn Python.
description: At 9:45, Feng Haoran arrived at the visitor lobby of Building B, Tencent Binhai Tower. At 10:00, his friend Zhang Mingxuan, wearing a work badge, came downstairs on time to greet him. Zhang Mingxuan first took him to visit the Tencent corporate exhibition hall on the second floor. Feng Haoran was deeply attracted by Tencent's industrial internet layout in finance, healthcare, smart retail, and other fields. In the fintech section, he saw real-world application cases that closely matched the concepts mentioned in the summit speech, which truly opened his eyes. Afterward, the two went to the Tim Hortons café inside the building. Zhang Mingxuan ordered a latte, and Feng Haoran had an Americano. Zhang Mingxuan deftly opened his laptop and gave a live demonstration of a personal investment portfolio dashboard he had built using Excel and the Python Dash framework, and ran a simple piece of Python code to show how to fetch the net asset values of several QDII funds he was following in real time. Feng Haoran listened intently, photographed key code snippets with his phone, and asked many beginner questions about data cleaning and the Pandas library. Zhang Mingxuan again encouraged him: “Lao Feng, the future of the investment advisory industry is definitely data-driven. The path from VBA to Python is worth taking.” Before parting, Zhang Mingxuan pressed the somewhat worn copy of “Python Financial Big Data Analysis” into his hands and urged, “Take it and read it; if you have any questions, come to me anytime.”
location: Visitor lobby and internal café on the first floor of Tencent Binhai Tower B, No. 33 Haitian Second Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Walk to the dinner venue
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Mingxuan, Feng Haoran walked to the agreed-upon tea restaurant based on the location Wang Lina sent. The place was on a commercial street about 500 meters from Tencent Binhai Building, about a 10-minute walk. On the way, he sent WeChat messages to Wang Lina and his close friend Dong Haoran: "I'm on my way, almost there, see you at the usual place!"
location: Along the route from Haitian 2nd Road to No. 39 Keji Middle 2nd Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Old friends' dinner and career exchange
description: At 12:15, Feng Haoran walked into the tea restaurant and immediately saw Wang Lina and Dong Haoran already seated in a booth with dishes ordered. The three exchanged lively greetings. They quickly ordered the signature char siu, roast goose, and dry-fried beef chow fun. Wang Lina, as talkative as ever, chatted about the challenges and opportunities her cross-border e-commerce company encountered in promoting on TikTok, lamenting the 'rat race' and cost pressure of operations talent in Shenzhen. Dong Haoran excitedly shared his experiences from just joining an AI startup, vividly describing how the CEO 'painted the picture' yet made it convincing. Feng Haoran then shared his insights from the summit and his thoughts on career transition. Feeling the state of his friends striving hard on different tracks, he was somewhat moved. During the meal, he had a waiter take a group photo of the three, capturing the moment full of drive. When paying, Feng Haoran rushed to pick up the bill. As they parted, Wang Lina handed him a beautifully packaged box of Shenzhen specialties—dried lychee and salt-baked chicken wings—to bring back to Changsha for his colleagues to taste.
location: Xinfa Hong Kong Style Tea Restaurant (Keji Zhong'er Road Branch), No. 39 Keji Zhong'er Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province

name: Return to the hotel to pick up luggage.
description: After walking out of the café, the three briefly said goodbye at the entrance and agreed to meet again next time in Wuhan or Changsha. Feng Haoran quickened his pace and walked back to Yueju Boutique Hotel. On the way, he passed a Lawson convenience store, went in and bought a bottle of mineral water and a pack of wet wipes, preparing for the three-hour high-speed rail trip.
location: Along Keji Zhong'er Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, including a Lawson convenience store.

name: Take the metro to Shenzhen North Station
description: At exactly 14:00, Feng Haoran returned to the hotel lobby and retrieved his suitcase from the luggage room using the claim voucher. Leaving the hotel, he opened the map app on his phone and walked to the nearest metro station, Keyuan Station (about 5 minutes). He took Line 2 (in the direction of Chiwan) to Civic Center Station, then transferred to Line 4 (in the direction of Niuhu) and rode directly to Shenzhen North Station. The whole trip took about 45 minutes. He stood in the carriage and used the time to review his notes from yesterday's summit, and in his phone's memo app he recorded a few scattered thoughts about Python learning.
location: Guangdong Province, Shenzhen: Metro Line 2 (Keyuan Station to Civic Center Station) and Line 4 (Civic Center Station to Shenzhen North Station)

name: Waiting at the high-speed railway station and handling fragmented tasks
description: At 14:50, Feng Haoran arrived at Shenzhen North Station and passed through security into the waiting hall. The LED screen in the waiting hall showed: Train G6014 is expected to be delayed to depart at 17:10 due to a signal failure. He did not panic; this hiccup was within his expectations. He found a relatively quiet seating area near a charging pillar, put down his backpack, first plugged in a power bank to recharge his phone, then opened his laptop and quickly handled the first task: replying to two work emails from clients about confirming the time of next week's strategy meeting. Next, he took out his CFA review materials and focused on completing 20 exercise questions on equity investments. At around 16:30, he felt a bit hungry, so he ordered a Filet-O-Fish meal and a Diet Coke at the nearby McDonald's via his phone, and ate quickly. After that, he took out Python for Financial Big Data Analysis borrowed from Zhang Mingxuan, and spent half an hour carefully browsing the table of contents and the first two chapters; the concepts about data types and basic syntax felt fresh and exciting to him.
location: The second-floor waiting hall of Shenzhen North Station (near boarding gates A12-A13) and McDonald's, No. 28 Zhiyuan Middle Road, Longhua District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.

name: High-speed rail trip and review
description: At 17:10, the train finally started slowly. Feng Haoran found his window seat and stowed his suitcase. As the train left Shenzhen North Station, the view outside the window gradually shifted from a bustling city to vast fields. Unlike his usual habit of scrolling through his phone, he leaned back in his seat, closed his eyes, and began to review the fulfilling past few days like a movie: the memorable quotes from industry bigwigs at the summit about 'quantitative finance' and 'robo-advisory', the in-depth conversation with Zhang Mingxuan about Python applications, Zhao Tianyu's anxiety about age and career, and the brand-new career statuses shared by two old friends at the dinner table... These fragments of information collided and fermented fiercely in his mind. Regarding how to balance 'traditional investment advisory' with 'technology empowerment' and how to find a breakthrough for transformation in his familiar field, some vague ideas began to become clear. He took out his notebook and quickly wrote down three keywords: 'quantitative tools', 'Python basics', and 'customer segmentation'. He felt physically and mentally exhausted, but spiritually extraordinarily fulfilled.
location: G6014 train (Shenzhen North Station to Changsha South Station)

name: Arrived in Changsha and took a taxi home.
description: At exactly 21:00, the train arrived at Changsha South Railway Station on time. Feng Haoran got off the train with the crowd and queued at the taxi pickup area. After about 10 minutes, he got into a taxi. "Driver, please go to 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District," he said, giving the familiar address. The car drove into Changsha under the night sky. He looked out the window at the familiar streetscape, neon lights, and late-night snack stalls, feeling a sense of relief and security. At around 21:50, the car stopped at the entrance of his residential community. He paid the fare, dragged his luggage, and walked through the gate into the night.
location: From Changsha South Railway Station, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province to Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District

name: Return home to rest and eat
description: After returning home, Feng Haoran put down his heavy backpack and suitcase. He took off his coat and first went to the bathroom to wash his face, feeling that he had finally shed the dust and fatigue of the journey. He opened the refrigerator, took out a box of blueberries and a cup of unsweetened yogurt he had prepared in advance, and ate them slowly in small bites as the last healthy snack of the day. He reminded himself: after 10:00 tonight, he could not eat anything, and tomorrow morning he had to go to the hospital for a physical exam on an empty stomach. At exactly 22:00, he went into the bathroom and enjoyed a hot shower, letting the water wash away the drowsiness of the day.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Business trip review and plan organization
description: Although his body was signaling that it was time to rest, the ENTJ stubbornness of "tasks must be finished" drove Feng Haoran to sit at his desk and open his laptop. He opened the summit records notebook and methodically entered the electronic business cards and paper business cards accumulated over the past few days (with WeChat note details) one by one into the dedicated "Connections - Shenzhen Summit" folder in Evernote. He created a new note titled "Shenzhen Business Trip Review - 20250111" and expanded the 3 keywords he had thought of on the high-speed train that afternoon, writing several hundred characters of core reflections and next week's action plan: 1) Contact the company IT department on Monday to apply for enabling the local Python environment; 2) Use commute time to search for and bookmark Pandas tutorials; 3) Organize key points for client meetings in the coming week and prepare in advance. After doing all this, he felt that all the complicated information had been placed in the right positions and felt extremely relieved. At 23:45, he turned off the computer.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and health management
description: Feng Haoran returned to the bedroom and adjusted the bedside lamp to the most comfortable warm yellow light. He took out from the suitcase the Chaoshan beef meatballs and the old book that Zhao Tianyu had given him before his return, and placed them neatly on the bookshelf in the living room. He poured a glass of warm water and put it on the nightstand, then double-checked his phone alarm: get up at 6:30 a.m. the next morning so as to arrive at the Physical Examination Center of Changsha Central Hospital at 7:30 sharp. He lay down on the bed, recalling the fulfilling and wonderful day, and the corners of his mouth involuntarily turned up slightly. Though his body was tired, his heart was filled with surging new motivation and expectations for the future. At 00:15, he turned off the bedside lamp, and with reassurance about the next day's physical exam and a clear plan for the coming week's work, he slowly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Wake up and prepare to go out
description: Woke up naturally on Sunday, feeling that the body had recovered from yesterday's travel fatigue. While washing up, checked the key tray at the entrance and confirmed that the ID card and medical insurance card were placed properly. Considering that Changsha was cloudy and cold today, gave up the morning run plan. Before going out, filled a thermos cup with warm water to ensure a small sip for the throat before the fasting physical examination.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Going to the hospital fasting
description: To avoid getting cold and expending energy from cycling on an empty stomach, I chose to take a taxi to the hospital. I hailed a cab via Amap, with an estimated travel time of 28 minutes. On the way, I confirmed via the mobile banking app that my payment account balance was sufficient, and reviewed the list of items in the physical examination package to ensure no key items were missed.
location: Changsha Central Hospital, 161 Shaoshan South Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Completed annual comprehensive physical examination.
description: Arrived at the health check center at the scheduled time. After verifying my identity at the front desk and receiving the examination forms, I completed, in order, a blood draw (complete blood count, liver and kidney function, four lipid tests), abdominal ultrasound, electrocardiogram, chest X-ray, and urinalysis. The whole process took about 1.5 hours and was smooth and efficient. After the examination, my stomach felt empty and I urgently needed to replenish energy.
location: Health Management Center, Changsha Central Hospital, 161 Shaoshan South Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Breakfast near the hospital
description: After exiting the south gate of the hospital, I walked directly into Zhou Gong Zhou Po, the porridge shop opposite. I ordered a century egg and lean pork congee, a tea egg, and a cup of freshly ground soy milk to lightly replenish my energy. During the meal, I opened the Mint Health app on my phone, entered the breakfast information, and officially restarted health management.
location: Zhougong Zhupo, opposite the South Gate of Changsha Central Hospital, No. 161 Shaoshan South Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Fetch part of the report and health review.
description: Returned to the hospital physical examination center, collected some reports that were ready immediately (such as blood routine, urine routine), and went into Dr. Wang's office to listen to the explanation. Dr. Wang pointed to the blood lipid report and seriously noted that both total cholesterol and low-density lipoprotein were slightly above normal, diagnosing mild hyperlipidemia. He recommended reducing high-fat diet, increasing aerobic exercise, and monitoring weight. Although I felt that my age meant it wasn't a big deal, the doctor's authoritative advice and the records in Boohee Health made me start taking it seriously.
location: Health Management Center, Changsha Central Hospital, 161 Shaoshan South Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Return trip and short rest
description: Took a taxi back home. On the way, I thought about the physical examination results: since problems were found, I should manage them proactively. After returning home, I pinned the shortcut for the "Mint Health" app to the phone's home screen, and briefly tidied the desk to prepare for the afternoon's deep study work.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Prepare a light lunch
description: Considering the physical exam results and health goals, decided to eat light at noon. Took the pre-prepared sea bass from the fridge, made steamed sea bass, and stir-fried garlic broccoli. While cooking, used the kitchen scale and strictly recorded the ingredient calories according to the app's recommended portions.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Light lunch and logging
description: Enjoyed a homemade healthy lunch. After eating, he used the Mint Health app to record the calories and nutrition of the lunch, and found that the total intake was within the controlled range, feeling a greater sense of control over his health.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Midday nap and coffee
description: After the meal, I rested a bit and took a 20-minute nap on the sofa to recharge. After waking up, to concentrate in the afternoon, I brewed a cup of drip-bag coffee with a pour-over kettle. The fragrant aroma also relaxed my mood.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Knowledge and career consolidation: organizing summit materials
description: Carrying coffee into the study, he officially began the afternoon's core work. First, he sorted the business cards collected at the Shenzhen summit into "brokerage," "private equity," and "technology" categories, then entered them one by one into his phone contacts and added notes (e.g., "a private equity researcher in Shenzhen, interested in cross-border assets"). Next, he opened the summit white paper and notebook and began writing the "Shenzhen Fintech Summit Summary," focusing on three actionable directions: 1) Using robo-advisory tools to optimize client experience; 2) Paying attention to the application potential of blockchain in cross-border payments and asset rights confirmation; 3) Introducing internet product thinking and using data dashboards to show clients asset allocation logic more intuitively.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Launch the deep learning plan.
description: After finishing the summary, placed the book 'Python for Financial Big Data Analysis' borrowed from Zhang Mingxuan in the most prominent spot on the desk. Skimmed the table of contents and the first chapter, and initially established a study plan: use the weekends of next month, spend 1-2 hours a day, and first master the basic data structures. Wrote the plan in a notebook and set a weekly reminder in the calendar app.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Go out for fresh air and pick up parcels
description: After wrapping up work for the moment, I decided to go out for some fresh air. I walked about five minutes to my usual convenience store and picked up the German tweezers and the January issue of National Geographic magazine I'd bought last Friday. On the way, I also bought a box of blueberries as a healthy snack for tonight. On the way home, I casually took a few shots of the winter street scene in the neighborhood and posted them on my Moments.
location: Hunan Province, Changsha City, Yuelu District, No. 344 Yinshuang Road, Meilin Yingu International Community Convenience Store

name: Preparing a healthy dinner
description: After returning home, I started preparing dinner. Today I continued my light diet plan: made a serving of tomato scrambled eggs, a serving of blanched shrimp, and mixed grain rice as the staple. I used an app throughout to weigh and record the amount of each ingredient.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Enjoying dinner and keeping records.
description: Enjoyed a healthy dinner with the blueberries bought in the afternoon. After dinner, I used the app to check the day's total calorie intake and found it was about 1,400 kcal, just within the healthy range, which made me quite satisfied.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Family Emotional Connection: Video Call with Sister
description: Punctually contacted my sister Feng Xinran, who works in Shanghai, via WeChat video. First we talked about how each of us was doing, and I shared today's physical exam experience and my decision to manage my health. My sister was very supportive and mentioned that she has recently been trying to control her diet and work out. Then we focused on discussing the plan for returning to Wuhan for the Spring Festival: I suggested returning to Wuhan on the 29th of the twelfth lunar month (January 28), and my sister agreed. I mentioned that I felt my mother had lost weight during recent video calls, and my sister felt the same. We agreed that after returning home for the Spring Festival, we would definitely accompany our mother to Wuhan Central Hospital for a comprehensive physical exam, with my sister responsible for online registration. I took the initiative to cover all medical exam costs, and my sister said she would take charge of follow-up dietary adjustments. The two of us reached a consensus on the video call.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Sister sharing and personal emotional time
description: After finishing the serious talk, Feng Xinran excitedly shared anecdotes from a recent marketing project at her internet company, and showed off the newly hung photo wall in her rented apartment in Shanghai, which included a group photo of us siblings from last year's Spring Festival. I also shared the street photography I took in the neighborhood today. She encouraged me to keep up this hobby, saying it's more interesting than those business cocktail party photos.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Personal recharge and next week's planning
description: After hanging up the video call, I felt very energized. I took out 'The Intelligent Investor' and read the chapter on investment discipline for 40 minutes, fully immersed. After that, I opened the work calendar and began planning next week's key tasks: combining today's summit insights with daily investment advisory services, and planning to share with the team at Monday's morning meeting. At the same time, I added two items to next week's to-do list: 'restart Boohee Health and log meals' and 'make a Python learning plan'.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Free time and review
description: Turned on Apple TV and watched a documentary about investing that I had been wanting to see. During ad breaks, I used my phone to handle some unread emails. Before bed, I opened the Boohee Health app again to confirm today's calorie record was complete. Also, I organized some of the report photos taken at the hospital today (such as blood lipids) into a dedicated health folder on my phone.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: After washing up, changed into pajamas. Checked teeth and skin in the mirror. Finally, set the alarm for 6:00 tomorrow morning to remind myself to return to work energetically on Monday and resume morning running.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Lights off, lying on the soft bed. Reflecting on the fulfilling day: efficiently completed key health check-ups, resolved family health concerns in advance, restarted personal health management, and accumulated new professional knowledge. With a sense of responsibility to family and a sense of control over himself, he quickly fell asleep.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning health routine: waking up preparation, morning run, and breakfast
description: At 06:30 the alarm went off. Feng Haoran quickly woke up, recalled yesterday's physical examination results, and resolved to start a new healthy life. He put on a quick-dry long-sleeve shirt, a windbreaker, and running shoes, drank warm water, and did simple stretches. At 06:50 he went out for a slow jog to the Wanglonggang riverside scenic belt, completing a 4-kilometer recovery jog at a pace of about 6:30/km, feeling stable after the run. While running, he planned his day: first go to the university to register, buy books at noon, and handle client emails in the afternoon. After the run, he stretched by the river and took a photo of the mist over the water as a record of his morning run. At 07:35 he went home, took a hot shower, brewed a cup of Colombian Huila coffee, paired it with hot milk cereal and a banana for breakfast, opened the "Mint Health" app to log about 350 calories, and nodded with satisfaction at yesterday's records.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, and Longwanggang Scenic Belt, Meixihu Road.

name: Commute: Metro to Huatai Securities
description: He changed into business casual attire, picked up his briefcase and study materials. He walked about 5 minutes from home to Jinxing Road Metro Station and took Line 2. On the subway, wearing earphones, he quickly browsed the market briefing and MBA course selection requirements on his phone to prepare for today's check-in and subsequent work.
location: Huatai Securities Office, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Monday department morning meeting.
description: After arriving at the company, I handled a few urgent emails, then attended the Monday department morning meeting. Director Qian Yongqiang emphasized that this week we should focus on overseas market fluctuations and opportunities in the consumer sector. The meeting was short and efficient; during it, I made eye contact with Zheng Wenbo, hinting that I had something to talk about afterward.
location: Conference Room, Huatai Securities Office, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

The atmosphere was lively: Wu Junjie asked for advice on a mortgage for his new house, and I gave a brief capital allocation plan based on the current interest rate environment and his income; Peng Yuqing shared her company's New Media Department's Spring Festival special planning and complained about the client. I asked Peng Yuqing in detail about experts at Wuhan Union Hospital, and she gave me the doctor's name and contact information. Wu Junjie also shared his father's experience with health conditioning. At the end of the meal, the three of us decided to drive to Zhangjiajie around the fifth day of the Chinese New Year. Wu Junjie is responsible for route planning, Peng Yuqing for booking homestays, and I for budgeting. At 21:15, Wu Junjie paid the bill, and we said goodbye at the restaurant entrance.

name: Late return by taxi and family video call
description: Took a taxi home, about 20 minutes' drive. In the car, made a brief video call to Mom. Heard that her hand was recovering well and that he would see her tomorrow. Knowing she was happy to receive the newly purchased blood pressure monitor, he felt relieved.
location: In a taxi from Yuhua District to Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening relaxation and review
description: After returning home, I sat at the head of the bed and reviewed the day. Today was extremely productive: I completed the long run, CFA study, New Year goods planning, enjoyed street photography, and had dinner with friends to settle a major concern. In my phone memo, I double-checked tomorrow's shopping route and list, and saved the doctor's contact information given by Peng Yuqing under 'Important Contacts'. Then I opened the WeChat Reading app and started reading 'Decisive Moments in History', letting my thoughts settle in the long river of history. At 23:00, I turned off all electronic devices on time, turned off the lights, and went to bed.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Waking up and breakfast
description: Feng Haoran woke up at 8 a.m. The sky outside was gloomy, and the north wind gently tapped on the window. After washing up, he changed into a dark gray athletic hoodie and black casual pants, put on a windbreaker, and styled his hair. Then he prepared breakfast in the dining area, including two boiled eggs, 250ml of skim milk, and two slices of whole wheat bread. While eating, he opened the Walmart app on his phone, searched for items on his shopping list such as lotus root starch, malt candy, and cured meat, confirmed the aisle locations, then picked up his car keys and eco-friendly shopping bags, ready to head out.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Big shopping at Walmart
description: Feng Haoran drove for 8 minutes to the Walmart at 24pin Life Center and went straight to the snack area on the second floor. He carefully compared different flavors of Xiaogan sesame candy, checked the production date of Hubei specialty lotus root powder, weighed some bulk nuts in the dried goods area, and picked out two vacuum-packed Hunan bacon in the cured meat area. At checkout, he felt warm inside thinking that his mother would be happy to receive these hometown flavors.
location: Walmart, B1 Floor, 24pin Life Center, No. 268 Guansha Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

description: After leaving Walmart, Feng Haoran drove to Huangxing South Road Pedestrian Street. On the way, he stopped at the Meilin Yingu International Community convenience store to buy a bottle of iced unsweetened oolong tea and a pack of gum, then continued after a brief stop. After arriving at the pedestrian street, he first went to the time-honored brand 'Jiuruzhai' and queued to buy two vacuum-packed dried sauced duck and one portion of jarred pork. Then he walked into 'Laobaixing Drugstore' and carefully compared the 'Yuwell' and 'Omron' brands at the electronic blood pressure monitor counter, asked about the difference between upper-arm and wrist types, and finally chose an Omron upper-arm blood pressure monitor with easy operation and a large display as a Chinese New Year gift for his parents.
location: Huangxing South Road Pedestrian Commercial Street, No. 383 Huangxing South Road, Tianxin District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Return and put away the New Year purchases
description: After shopping, Feng Haoran drove home. Upon arrival, he piled the purchased lotus root starch, sesame candy, cured meat, nuts, etc. by category on the living room coffee table, and carefully placed the blood pressure monitor box aside. Standing in the middle of the living room, looking at these carefully prepared items for his parents, he silently resolved to take his parents to Wuhan Union Hospital for a comprehensive check-up after the New Year, and opened his phone's memo app to note down this plan.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Out for lunch and midday rest
description: Around noon, Feng Haoran walked to his usual restaurant, Manlao Shixiangli Local Restaurant, and ordered a serving of the signature pickled cabbage stir-fried with mung bean starch sheets and a bowl of rice, eating to his heart's content. After the meal, he went to the Meilin Yingu International Community convenience store near his home and bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea, then strolled home. Once home, he turned on the TV to browse midday financial news highlights, relaxing and recharging for the afternoon discussion meeting.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Host an online economics discussion session.
description: Feng Haoran sat down in his study at home on time, opened his laptop, logged into the video conferencing software, and connected with three CFA study group friends, Zhang Wen, Li Na, and Wang Qiang. The discussion theme was "The Application of Macroeconomic Analysis in Investment Decisions." He guided everyone to take turns sharing their organized exam points and recent confusions, and conducted in-depth discussions around core topics such as "The Impact of Expected Interest Rate Changes on Asset Allocation," while occasionally recording valuable viewpoints and common mistakes.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Create a self-driving trip group chat
description: After the discussion ended, Feng Haoran opened WeChat, created a group chat named "Zhangjiajie Self-Driving Squad," and added his friends Peng Yuqing and Wu Junjie to the group. He sent a message proposing to preliminarily decide the route before the New Year, shared a link to the Zhangjiajie self-driving guide he had put together last year, and presented a rough itinerary framework of "depart on the fifth day of the New Year, return on the seventh day," inviting them to join the discussion.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Contact mother to finalize the station pickup arrangements
description: After completing the initial communication about the road trip, Feng Haoran called his mother Li Xiuying in Wuhan. He first asked about the recovery of her wrist, and after learning it was fine, he cheerfully told her that he had bought a lot of New Year goods and a new blood pressure monitor today, and said he would arrive at Wuchang Station on the morning of the 28th, telling her not to worry. His mother's relieved laughter came through the phone, and after chatting about some household matters, they hung up.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Relaxation and dinner preparation
description: After hanging up the phone, Feng Haoran felt relieved. He turned on the TV screencast and listened to some light music for a while, then went to the living room to open the sesame candy he had bought in the morning, divide it into sealed bags, and stick labels on them. Afterwards, he tidied up the kitchen and prepared to cook a bowl of noodles with vegetables and shredded pork as dinner.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Dinner and organizing stamp collection
description: Feng Haoran cooked a bowl of bok choy and shredded pork noodles for dinner and enjoyed a moment of peace while eating. After dinner, he went to his study, carefully took out the stamp album, and inserted several newly purchased zodiac stamps into appropriate positions according to year and category. He admired the details of the zodiac patterns with a magnifying glass, then took clear photos with his phone's macro lens and sent them to his stamp-collecting friend Luo Zhenyu in Shenzhen via WeChat, praising the texture of the dragon scales. The two had a brief exchange about the design and condition of the stamp set.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Refine the Zhangjiajie self-driving tour itinerary
description: After the exchange with Luo Zhenyu ended, Feng Haoran reopened his computer. Based on the scattered thoughts in the group chat from Peng Yuqing and Wu Junjie (Wu Junjie wanted to see the 'Charm of Western Hunan' performance, while Peng Yuqing was both afraid and fond of the Tianmen Mountain glass skywalk), he revised the previously shared guide link into a more specific Excel itinerary, adding accommodation, budget, and a preliminary ranking of attractions. He planned to send it to the group tomorrow for discussion.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: After putting away his computer, Feng Haoran spread out his yoga mat in the living room and did a set of simple yoga stretching exercises, focusing on releasing the tension in his shoulders and lower back from driving and sitting for long periods during the day. After stretching, he picked up his phone, opened the memo app, and jotted down to confirm the high-speed rail departure to Wuhan on the 28th (G-series train, about 4 hours) and the post-holiday physical exam plan (Xiehe Hospital, mother's wrist recheck). Then he finished washing up, lay in bed, quickly scanned global market movements on a finance app, browsed Moments, and liked friends' posts. He then dimmed the room lights, played soft white noise, and set the mood for sleep.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Reading and bedtime
description: Feng Haoran turned off his phone screen, picked up 'Decisive Moments in History' from the nightstand, and read quietly for half an hour. At exactly 23:00, he closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell asleep amid anticipation and longing.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Early rising, morning preparation, and breakfast
description: The alarm went off. After a brief moment of lingering in bed, I got up and washed up. Since the weather was damp and cold and there was no morning run planned, I changed into a shirt, casual pants, and a thick down jacket. Heated milk in the microwave and ate whole wheat bread. Before leaving, I checked my bag: confirmed that the car keys, client list, laptop, and blood pressure monitor were all ready.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Drive to the company
description: Drove from home to the office, leaving early to ease the morning rush-hour commute. On the way, I listened to local traffic radio and used voice commands to browse overnight US stock and this morning's early Asia market news, to prepare for wrapping up work before the holiday.
location: From Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, to the Office Leasing Center of Kaifu District, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District

name: Morning pre-holiday work wrap-up and meeting with supervisor
description: After arriving at the company, I brewed instant coffee. Before the A-share market opened, I sent personalized Chinese New Year greeting emails to all clients, with particular attention to editing the email to Huang Siqi, mentioning the recent performance of the tech stocks she follows. After finishing the mass email, I opened the final draft of the quarterly report and did a final review of the charts and conclusions. Once confirmed correct, I submitted it to Director Qian Yongqiang via the internal system with the note: 'Submitted, awaiting in-person review.' Then I went to the director's office for a face-to-face meeting. Qian Yongqiang raised questions about the report details and emphasized the client maintenance priorities after the New Year and the cross-border business training plan. I answered each question and promised to prioritize the PPT framework after the holiday. Returning to my desk, I quickly handled emails, had a verbal handover with the colleague taking over the pre-holiday work, and finally tidied my desk and shut down the computer.
location: Huatai Securities Office, Kaifu District Office Building Leasing Center, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Drive to the yoga studio.
description: Set off from the company parking lot and drove to the usual Fanyin Yoga private studio. The roads were relatively clear during the midday period.
location: Kaifu District Office Leasing Center, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, to Fanyin Yoga Private Studio, Fuqing Street, Kaifu District

name: The last Yin Yoga class before the holiday
description: Changed into yoga clothes and completed a one-hour yin yoga class focused on relaxing the lower back and hips. Outside the window the cold wind howled, while inside it was warm and cozy. After the meditation session, she temporarily set aside work stress. After class, she exchanged "Happy New Year" greetings with Coach Liu and prepaid for two sessions after the holiday.
location: Fanyin Yoga Private Studio, Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

location: Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street Branch), No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Shopping at a convenience store on the way home.

location: Jijin Convenience Store (Chaozong Street Branch), No. 223 Chaozong Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Packing luggage and New Year purchases
description: Changed into an old hoodie, sorted the New Year goods bought yesterday (lotus root powder, malt candy, sauce duck, jar meat, etc.) into categories, and neatly placed them in the trunk. Then packed the clothes and toiletry bag to take back to Wuhan tomorrow, and double-checked that the blood pressure monitor, camera bag, laptop, etc., were all packed.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

description: First, conducted a routine check of the vehicle in the surface parking space of the residential complex: checked tire pressure, brake disc wear, oil and coolant levels, all normal. Then drove to Jingbing Doorstep Car Wash (Xianjia Garden Branch) for a thorough wash and interior vacuuming. While waiting, took photos of the clean car and the New Year goods placed in the trunk and sent them to my mother to report that all was well. After the car wash, stopped by the Meilin Yingu International Community convenience store on the way to buy bottled water and snacks for the road tomorrow.
location: Ground parking spaces of Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, Jingbing Mobile Car Wash (Xianjia Garden Branch), No. 89 Chenfeng Road, and Meilin Yingu International Community Convenience Store, No. 344 Yinshuang Road
