description: Back home, he put the floor mats removed after car washing back in place and stored the newly purchased supplies. He opened the map app on his phone, set the navigation route back to Wuhan for the next day, saved a screenshot, and also printed a physical map to keep in the car as a backup.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Phone call with father and confirming sister's itinerary
description: Sitting on the sofa, I called my father to tell him I would arrive in Wuhan around noon the next day, and briefly asked about the family. Father told me to be safe on the road and reminded me that Mom wanted to eat green vegetables. When I mentioned that I had bought a blood pressure monitor for Mom, Father said, 'Your mom will certainly be happy.' After hanging up, I immediately sent a WeChat message to my younger sister Feng Xinran to confirm the high-speed rail train number and arrival time. She instantly replied with Hankou Station information and coyly said she wanted to eat Wuhan doupi. I smiled and replied, 'I'll take you to eat it tomorrow.'
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Organize camera gear and rest
description: Open the camera bag, carefully wipe the lens, check the memory card and battery. Then lean back on the sofa and browse photography forums on my phone to relax.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Dinner
description: In the kitchen, he cooked himself a bowl of noodles, added two eggs and a few slices of greens, and watched financial short videos on his tablet while eating.
location: Kitchen at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening free time and online socializing
description: After dinner, I enjoyed the last evening of relaxation before the Spring Festival. I turned on the computer to organize and archive photos I recently took on the streets of Changsha, and did rough edits on the ones I was satisfied with. Afterwards, I had an online exchange with photographer friend Xu Jianing in Shenzhen about recent shooting experiences, and also browsed global financial news.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Washing up and personal care.
description: After turning off the computer, I started washing up, brushing my teeth carefully with an electric toothbrush and cleansing my face with facial cleanser, then applied basic moisturizer.
location: Home bathroom in the Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community at No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Lying in bed, he used his phone memo to review the day's completed tasks and confirmed nothing was missed. He silently recited tomorrow's schedule (departure time, home arrival time, pick-up time for his sister), set the phone alarm to 6:00, and placed it on the nightstand. Turning off the bedside lamp, listening to the faint north wind, he gradually fell asleep amid anticipation and concern for his mother's health.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Woke up in the early morning, ready to set off.
description: Woke up 18 minutes before the alarm. Lying in bed, I recalled the pleasure of yesterday's yoga and photography, checked the blood pressure monitor in the inner compartment of my backpack, then got up and washed up. Considering the long drive ahead, I skipped the morning run. Pulled open the curtains; the sky was faintly light, and the outdoor temperature was about -1C.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Quick breakfast and departure confirmation
description: I brewed instant coffee and had toast with peanut butter for breakfast. While eating, I sent a WeChat message to my father on my phone to let him know I would arrive at 11:00, confirmed my sister's high-speed rail train G1213 was expected to arrive at Wuhan Station at 12:17, and finally checked the New Year goods prepared at the entrance (Xiangxi bacon, Anhua dark tea, milk, and fruit) and my camera bag.
location: Kitchen at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Check vehicle condition and warm up the car
description: Took the car keys and camera bag, walked around the car to check the tires and exterior, started the engine, and set the heater to medium to warm up. Set the navigation destination to No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan. Estimated time: 3 hours 56 minutes. The dashboard showed an outside temperature of -1C.
location: Underground parking garage, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Long-distance self-drive back to hometown
description: Drove along the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway from Changsha to Wuhan. Traffic was lighter than expected, and I kept to the legal speed limit throughout. On the way, I listened to a finance podcast and kept an eye on the car's condition. At about 09:10, I made a brief 15-minute stop at Xianning Service Area, got out to stretch, filled my thermos with hot water, and sent my mother a voice message saying I would arrive soon.
location: Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway, Changsha to Wuhan section, Xianning Service Area, Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway, Xianning City, Hubei Province

name: Arrived at parents' house and carried in the New Year goods.
description: The navigation indicated that we were about to arrive, and I saw my father Feng Jianguo waiting downstairs in his old dark blue down jacket. After getting out of the car, we exchanged a brief hug, then together unloaded the New Year goods and luggage from the trunk and carried them up to the third floor.
location: Downstairs of the old Feng family residence, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan City, Hubei Province

name: Chatted with his parents and observed his mother's condition.
description: As he entered, his mother Li Xiuying came out from the kitchen to greet him. He noticed that her complexion was sallow and she did not look as well as last year. His mother smiled and took the New Year's goods, her voice sounding tired. She mentioned that his younger sister was almost there and that she was going to pick her up at the station.
location: Living room of the Feng family old residence, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Go to Wuhan Station with my father to pick up my younger sister
description: Walked with my father to Huangpu Road Metro Station, took Line 1 to Hongshan Square Station and transferred to Line 4 to Wuhan Station. On the subway, I asked again about my mother's condition. My father sighed and said she had recently been saying she was always tired and eating little. I held my father's hand.
location: Wuhan Metro Line 1 and Line 4 (from Huangpu Road Station to Wuhan Railway Station)

name: Picked up my younger sister Feng Xinran
description: At the exit of Wuhan Station, I picked up my sister Feng Xinran, who had just gotten off train G1213. She was wearing a red coat and pulling a small suitcase. We gave each other a big hug, and she pulled out a Shanghai time-honored fresh meat mooncake from an insulated bag. On the way back on the subway, my sister excitedly talked about the funny stories from the annual party, and the atmosphere was lighthearted.
location: At the arrival hall of Wuhan Station, Hongshan District, Wuhan, Hubei, and on the return metro.

name: The whole family prepares the New Year's Eve dinner together.
description: After returning home, I put on an apron and took over the kitchen with my sister. I handled the Wuchang fish and vegetables, and my sister dealt with the cured meat and dark tea. My father was peeling garlic in the living room. My mother insisted on personally making her signature dish, pork rib and lotus root soup. She stood at the stove slowly stirring the clay pot; her movements were slower than last year, and she occasionally paused and supported her back with her hand. I urged her to go rest in the living room, but she insisted on directing.
location: The kitchen and dining room of the Feng family old house, 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province.

name: Organizing photos and plating design
description: While the pork rib soup was simmering, he imported photos from the camera to the laptop, selected scenic shots from the navigation perspective for quick color grading, and sent them with the text "Safe journey, arrival at destination" to the family group. His younger sister came over to look, chatting about interesting stories from her Shanghai company and her newly purchased camera lens, while he analyzed her watchlist funds from a financial planner's professional perspective.
location: Study in the old Feng family residence at 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province.

name: Final sprint for the New Year's Eve dinner
description: Together with my sister, I sliced and arranged various braised cold dishes on plates. My father brought out his treasured Wuliangye liquor and warmed it. I used the oven to reheat the freshly made pork mooncakes my sister brought, pairing them with dark tea as a pre-meal snack. Around 5:00 p.m., we started wiping the table and setting out the bowls and chopsticks. My sister and father helped bring the dishes to the table, while my mother occasionally reminded us that the steamed fish needed enough time.
location: The kitchen and dining room of the Feng family old house, 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province.

name: Take a short break, change clothes to welcome the New Year.
description: Took off the thin coat that smelled of cooking oil, put on a clean off-white turtleneck sweater, and tidied my hair a bit. Standing by the window of the spare bedroom, watching the occasional fireworks downstairs and hearing the sound of firecrackers in the distance, I felt both warm and heavy. After a deep breath, I went to the living room to get ready for the dinner.
location: Second bedroom, Feng family old house, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: The whole family sits around the table for the New Year's Eve dinner
description: The whole family sat around the table with abundant dishes. During the meal, I shared several successful asset allocation cases from the past year; my younger sister talked about the tech newcomers she saw in Shanghai; my father drank a little and recalled scenes of celebrating the New Year as a child. My mother ate very slowly, took a few bites of fish and vegetables, drank only half a bowl of lotus root soup, and quietly moved aside the cured meat that had been given to her. I was worried but kept a smile, and put steamed fish belly on my mother's plate.
location: Feng Family Old House Restaurant, 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei.

name: Watch the Spring Festival Gala and spend time with family
description: The family of four moved to the living room to watch the Spring Festival Gala. Mother leaned in a corner of the sofa and dozed off. My younger sister handed out cherries and complained that a certain skit was not funny. We watched and chatted. At around 20:45, Mother said she was a bit tired and went back to the bedroom to rest, gently telling us to rest well. Three people remained in the living room, and the atmosphere was a bit dull.
location: Living room of the Feng family old residence, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Deep talk with my father in the study
description: About 20 minutes after his mother returned to her room, he signaled his father to come into the study and closed the door. He clearly laid out all the details he had observed today—weight loss, easy fatigue, poor complexion, loss of appetite, and slow movements—and, together with his father's earlier unusual tiredness, seriously advised that after the holiday they must take his mother to Wuhan Union Hospital to register for a specialist appointment and have a comprehensive physical examination; it could not be delayed any longer. His father was silent for a long time, then nodded heavily with reddened eyes.
location: Study in the old Feng family residence at 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province.

name: Chatting with my younger sister and organizing photos
description: After the conversation in the study, I made a cup of tea and went to the living room. My younger sister was still watching a rerun of the Spring Festival Gala, so I sat down and chatted with her, asking about her year-end bonus and relationship status. Later, I returned to the second bedroom, used my phone to import today's photos into my iPad and backed them up, opened Notes to write a short diary, ending with: "May mother be healthy, may the family be reunited."
location: Living room and second bedroom of the Feng Family Old House, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Measured blood pressure and went to bed.
description: After the living room became quiet, he quietly walked to the door of the parents' bedroom and heard even breathing. Holding the blood pressure monitor, he gently pushed the door open and, with minimal movement, took a blood pressure reading for his mother: 132/85 mmHg, which was a borderline value. Without waking her, he quietly left the room and closed the door. After returning to the secondary bedroom and washing up briefly, he turned off the lights and went to sleep before 00:30.
location: At the master bedroom doorway and the second bedroom of the Feng family old residence, 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Early morning riverside walk and street photography
description: On the morning of Chinese New Year's Day, Feng Haoran put on his sneakers, grabbed his camera, and walked to Hankou River Beach Park. At the entrance on Yanjiang Avenue, the river breeze carried moisture, and morning mist lightly veiled the Yangtze River Bridge. He photographed festive scenes of red lanterns and cargo ships. Then he walked to Cai Linji's Jiqing Street branch, bought hot dry noodles, three-delicacy tofu skin, and egg wine, and packed them home as breakfast for the whole family.
location: Hankou River Beach Park, Yanjiang Avenue, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province; and Cai Lin Ji (Jiqing Street Branch), No. 667-669 Zhongshan Avenue

name: Family ancestor worship and breakfast time
description: Feng Haoran came home with breakfast, while his mother Li Xiuying was cooking glutinous rice balls. His father Feng Jianguo had already set up the altar, and he and his sister Feng Xinran helped arrange the offerings. The whole family completed the ancestor worship ceremony together. Then they sat around the table, first eating glutinous rice balls, then enjoying hot dry noodles, tofu skin, and more. His father was full of praise for tofu skin, creating a warm and traditional atmosphere.
location: Parents' home, 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Visiting maternal uncle's home to offer New Year greetings
description: Feng Haoran, together with his parents and younger sister, carried gifts and walked to his maternal uncle's home in the same Jiangan District (about 15 minutes away). On the way, they exchanged "Happy New Year" greetings with neighbors. At his uncle's home, the elders warmly welcomed them; his uncle and aunt asked about his work and marriage, and he lightly brushed it off by saying, "My job is stable, and I'm looking for the right person."
location: Changsheng Apartment, 1200 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei, China.

name: Go to my uncle's house to pay a New Year's visit
description: Feng Haoran and his father walked 5 minutes from his uncle's home to Dazhi Road Station on Metro Line 2 and took the metro toward Hankou Railway Station. On the train, he sent WeChat New Year greetings to his photographer friend Xu Jianing and collector friend Luo Zhenyu in Shenzhen. Arriving at his eldest uncle's home, Jintaohong Mansion, his cousin had just started middle school this year, and he sent his cousin a 200 yuan WeChat red packet as a New Year gift.
location: Jintaohong Mansion, 176 Fazhan Avenue, Jianghan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Return home and have a preliminary discussion with my sister about our mother's health.
description: Feng Haoran and his father took the subway home. When they arrived, his mother and younger sister had already started preparing lunch. He changed into loungewear and went into the kitchen to help peel garlic and trim vegetables. While his parents watched TV in the living room, he pulled his sister aside to the balcony and quietly told her about their mother's high blood pressure, mentioning that he knew a cardiology friend at Peking Union Medical College Hospital. His sister agreed to discuss countermeasures together in the afternoon.
location: Parents' home, 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Warm family lunch
description: Lunch was home-style cooking made by his mother and younger sister: braised fish, stir-fried smoked pork with dried tofu, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Feng Haoran deliberately served his mother some dishes. His mother ate a bit more than yesterday, which relieved him somewhat. At the table, they chatted about his sister's company in a relaxed atmosphere. He took the initiative to do the dishes so that his parents could take an afternoon nap.
location: Parents' home, 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Contact my doctor friend, Wang Zhiqiang
description: After quickly browsing Asia-Pacific market developments in his study, Feng Haoran sent a WeChat message to his college classmate Wang Zhiqiang, who works at Wuhan Union Hospital, to consult about a physical examination for his parents. The other party replied that they could talk by phone, and he immediately made the call, explaining in detail that his mother's blood pressure was on the high side. Wang Zhiqiang suggested arranging a comprehensive physical examination for middle-aged and elderly people as soon as possible after the holiday, including cardiovascular and cerebrovascular, tumor markers, bone density, and other items, and agreed to help book an appointment.
location: Study at parents' home, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Discuss the physical examination plan with my younger sister.
description: His younger sister came to the study. Feng Haoran told her in detail Wang Zhiqiang's suggestion: have a thorough physical examination, and he would bear the cost. His sister said she would be responsible for persuading their mother. The two discussed countermeasures one by one, planning to have a formal talk with their mother tomorrow.
location: Study at parents' home, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Whole family took a leisurely walk along the riverbank
description: After the afternoon nap, his father suggested taking a walk along the river beach, so Feng Haoran brought his camera. The whole family strolled along Hankou River Beach; he captured the backs of his parents walking side by side, the moment his younger sister clung to her mother's arm acting coquettishly, and his father's profile gazing into the distance at the Yangtze River. On the viewing platform, he asked a passerby to take a family photo with the Second Yangtze River Bridge in the background — it was truly meaningful.
location: Hankou Riverside Park, Yanjiang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Kitchen photography practice and preparing dinner.
description: Returning home, his mother prepared pork rib and lotus root soup. Feng Haoran took out his camera and asked his sister to teach him food photography techniques, and together they filmed the whole process of his mother chopping ribs, peeling lotus root, and putting them into the pot, recording the birth of a New Year dish. Afterwards, he helped set the table and waited for the soup to be ready.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: New Year's Eve dinner (family banquet)
description: The whole family sat around the dining table, which was laden with dishes, and in the center was the pork rib and lotus root soup that Mother had simmered for three hours. Feng Haoran filled the first bowl and respectfully handed it to his mother, wishing her a happy New Year. She beamed with joy. His father opened a bottle of Huanghelou liquor and drank a few cups with him. The table was filled with laughter and cheerful conversation.
location: Dining room at parents' home, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Evening time accompanying parents
description: After dinner, moved to the living room and watched the replay of the Spring Festival Gala with parents. Father is interested in crosstalk and skits, mother likes singing and dancing. Feng Haoran sat aside, imported the photos taken today into the computer for initial selection and color adjustment, picked the family portrait and mother's solo photo, and prepared to send them to the family group.
location: Living room at parents' home, 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province.

name: Private socializing and personal time.
description: Feng Haoran returned to his bedroom, sent the morning riverbank photos to his childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan, and told him he was back in Wuhan. Zhang Mingxuan invited him to have a meal together the day after tomorrow, the third day of the Lunar New Year. He then logged into the stamp collecting forum, replied to his collector friend Luo Zhenyu with New Year greetings, and discussed stamp market trends. Finally, he spent 15 minutes browsing international financial news, focusing on the Fed's interest rate decision and crude oil price movements, to prepare for A-shares after the holiday.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Journaling and preparing for bed.
description: Feng Haoran opened the diary app and recorded the warmest moments of the day: the family portrait, his mother's smile, and the rapport with his sister. He wrote: 'The first day of the new year, a day full of hope. Tomorrow I will formally talk to Mom about the physical examination. I hope she can understand our feelings. Health is more important than anything.' After washing up, he set the 23:00 sleep alarm, turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully amid the sporadic firecrackers outside the window.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Morning wake-up and brisk walk along the riverbank.
description: Woke up on time at my parents' house. Cloudy, temperature 1-10C. After putting on a windbreaker and running shoes, I drove to Hankou River Beach, entering through the entrance near Atour Hotel at 1866 Jiefang Avenue. The river breeze was cold but the air was fresh. Walked briskly along the river beach for about 40 minutes, listening to financial news while planning the key points of today's conversation with my mother.
location: Hankou Riverside, Yanjiang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (near entrance at 1866 Jiefang Avenue)

name: Helping with breakfast and advising father on health
description: After finishing the brisk walk, I drove back to my parents' home, took a shower, and had breakfast with the family. My mother had made millet porridge, and my father had bought youtiao (fried dough sticks). My father earnestly reminded me to take care of my health, emphasizing that health is the foundation of everything. Feng Haoran responded seriously and took the opportunity to bring up the plan to take his mother to Peking Union Medical College Hospital for a comprehensive checkup after the holiday, mentioning that his classmate Zhiqiang had already arranged it.
location: No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (parents' home living room/dining room)

name: Warm family photo shoot
description: After breakfast, Feng Haoran took out the tripod and Sony mirrorless camera, adjusted the lighting in the living room, and used the self-timer mode to take a formal family portrait. Then he switched to candid shots: his mother's focused expression while watering the plants on the balcony, his father reading the newspaper with reading glasses, and his sister's back as she packed her luggage, capturing warm, everyday moments. Meanwhile, he quietly confirmed the division of health check-up responsibilities with his sister in the kitchen.
location: 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (parents' home living room, balcony)

name: Farewell lunch prep and sibling communication
description: After filming, Feng Haoran put on an apron and went into the kitchen to help his mother prepare lunch. His mother was simmering pork rib and lotus root soup. While peeling potatoes, he brought up the medical check-up again. His mother initially declined, saying she just felt a little dizzy. Feng Haoran and his sister persuaded her together, stressing that dizziness is not a trivial matter, and told her they had already booked an appointment with classmate Zhiqiang for February 5. His mother finally relented and agreed.
location: No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (parents' home kitchen)

name: Farewell lunch and household chores
description: The family sat together and enjoyed a hearty lunch, including pork rib and lotus root soup, steamed Wuchang fish, stir-fried choy sum, and more. Feng Haoran used juice as a substitute for wine and proposed a toast to the New Year, creating a warm atmosphere. After the meal, he proactively cleaned up the dishes and wiped down the kitchen counter so that his mother could rest well.
location: No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (parents' home dining room)

name: Saw my sister off at Wuhan Station
description: After a short rest after the meal, Feng Haoran drove his younger sister Feng Xinran to Wuhan Station. On the way, his sister urged him to take more care of their mother's affairs and reminded him not to stay up late after returning to Changsha and to carry out his health plan. Feng Haoran said he understood, watched his sister drag her suitcase into the station, and felt a hint of emptiness in his heart, but more determination.
location: Wuhan Railway Station, Baiyun Road, Hongshan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Round trip to the wet market for shopping
description: On the way back from Wuhan Station, stopped by Tiansheng Fresh Food Market to buy fresh cherries, strawberries, and seasonal vegetables, planning to cook light meals for his parents in the evening. Then drove back to his parents' home, parked in the fixed parking space downstairs, and went upstairs.
location: Tiansheng Fresh Food Market, Tiansheng Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei

name: A long talk with mother
description: This was the most important hour of the day. Feng Haoran led his mother to sit on the sofa, took out the notebook recording the comprehensive physical examination item list sent by classmate Wang Zhiqiang, and explained one by one the necessity of cardiovascular, tumor marker, thyroid function, and other tests, emphasizing that they were only routine screenings and telling his mother not to be nervous. After an hour and a half of patient communication, his mother finally put aside her concerns and agreed to go to Xiehe for the physical examination on February 5 as planned.
location: Living room of parents' home, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Community walk and father-son communication
description: After the conversation, Feng Haoran accompanied his father downstairs for a walk within the Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community in Jiangan District. His father wore a dark blue jacket and twirled walnuts in his hand, asking about the company's recent situation. Feng Haoran recounted in detail the cases and thoughts from managing client assets. His father, a veteran railway worker, offered his insight: “Investing is like driving a train — you need to be steady, read the signals accurately, and not blindly chase highs.” Feng Haoran listened carefully and was deeply inspired.
location: Inside the Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, near Jiefang Avenue, Jiang'an District, Wuhan City, Hubei Province

name: Organizing photos and preparing dinner
description: After the walk, Feng Haoran returned to his room, imported the camera photos into his laptop, carefully selected the 9 best family photos and candid moments, and prepared to send them to the family group. Then he went to the kitchen to prepare dinner, planning to make his specialty tomato and egg soup and stir-fried seasonal vegetables, so that his parents could taste his cooking.
location: No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (parents' home bedroom/kitchen)

name: Family dinner and TV time
description: The dinner was light and warm, and the dishes Feng Haoran prepared were praised by his parents. After dinner, the family sat on the living room sofa watching a Spring Festival special program, with occasional firecracker sounds coming from outside the window. His mother was visibly relaxed, leaning on the sofa enjoying the family reunion time.
location: No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (parents' home dining room/living room)

name: Socializing and preparing for the return trip.
description: Back in the bedroom, Feng Haoran sent a WeChat message to his childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan, agreeing to meet at noon tomorrow (the third day of the lunar month) at the newly opened Hubei restaurant "Chuyunxuan" in Wuchang at 11:30, because he had to return to Changsha in the afternoon. After receiving confirmation, he went downstairs to check the car, making sure the tire pressure, lights, and oil were all normal to prepare for the long drive.
location: No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (parents' home bedroom and downstairs parking space)

name: In-depth review and health plan.
description: This was Feng Haoran's own reflection time. He wrote down his feelings for the day in his notebook, especially the impact of the long conversation with his mother: real risk management lies not only in the stock market, but also in the family's health. He formulated a personal health plan for February: diet—eat out no more than 3 times a week and prepare homemade fat-loss meals; exercise—resume morning runs on Yuelu Mountain at least 4 times a week and add strength training; monitoring—weigh in weekly and record physical examination indicators monthly. Finally, he posted the plan on the wall in front of his desk as a reminder to himself.
location: No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (bedroom at parents' home)

name: Washing up and confirming sister's itinerary
description: After washing up and doing his skincare routine, Feng Haoran lay in bed and sent a WeChat message to his sister, confirming that she had arrived safely in Shanghai, and informing her of the plan to dine with Zhang Mingxuan tomorrow. His sister replied with a sticker to reassure him.
location: No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (parents' home bathroom/bedroom)

name: Going to bed
description: Considering the long drive back to Changsha the next day and a lunch appointment with his childhood friend, Feng Haoran went to bed early. He turned off his phone, listened to the occasional firecrackers outside the window, and slowly fell asleep with concerns about his own and his mother's health and a determination to change.
location: No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (bedroom at parents' home)

name: Said goodbye to parents and departed to return to Changsha.
description: At 6:15 in the morning, Feng Haoran got up on time, quickly washed up and checked the trunk luggage. He had a brief hug and farewell with his father, who was already up, and urged him to sleep a bit longer. Since his mother was still resting, he couldn't bear to wake her. At 6:25, he started the engine, drove away from the old house in Jiang'an District, Wuhan, where he had lived for over 20 years, and set off on the journey back to Changsha.
location: Downstairs at parents' home, No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan

name: Took a break on the way driving back to Changsha.
description: Feng Haoran drove along the G4 Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway from Wuhan to Changsha. After getting in the car, he connected his phone and played The Economist finance podcast as background audio. Traffic on the highway was heavier than expected but generally smooth. After about 2 hours of driving, at 8:30, he stopped at Xianning Service Area for a 15-minute rest, got out to stretch, drank hot tea, and sent a WeChat message to his younger sister Feng Xinran to let her know he was safe. After continuing on the road, he reflected on his insights from the Spring Festival, especially his worry about his mother's health, and felt increasingly determined.
location: G4 Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway (Wuhan to Changsha section) and Xianning Service Area (Xian'an District, Xianning City, Hubei Province)

name: Arrived home in Changsha, tidied up and rested
description: Drove into the underground garage of Jinxing Residential Community at 10:15, parked the car, then took the elevator home with luggage. After entering, hung clothes back in the wardrobe and put the suitcase away. Opened the window for ventilation, checked the plants and watered them. Took a shower, changed into clean loungewear, and rested on the sofa for 15 minutes to recover energy.
location: Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Walked to a gathering with childhood friends
description: At 11:15, Feng Haoran sent a message to his childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan to confirm the dinner gathering, then put on a coat and went out. Chuyunxuan was about a 10-minute walk from home; he walked along Shuangtang Road to Yuelu Avenue, feeling the quiet atmosphere of Changsha streets during the Spring Festival holiday. He arrived at Chuyunxuan Hunan Restaurant 15 minutes early and met up with Zhang Mingxuan. The two ordered Hunan dishes such as steamed fish head with chopped chili peppers and stir-fried yellow beef with small peppers, and chatted freely about New Year plans. Zhang Mingxuan talked about preparing to open his second design studio in Changsha, while Feng Haoran shared his health management, family physical exam arrangements, and new ideas for investment business. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Chuyunxuan Hunan Restaurant, No. 168 Yuelu Avenue, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan (walking via Shuangtang Road to Yuelu Avenue)

name: Go home and make an annual health plan
description: At 12:45, said goodbye to Zhang Mingxuan and walked home. At 13:00, sat down at the study computer and created a new document '2025 Personal Health Execution Plan' in the memo app. Opened fitness and nutrition apps, referred to articles and courses, and listed a detailed plan based on height and weight data: increase morning runs to 6 times per week, add hill training on Yuelu Mountain; do 30-minute core strength training 3 times per week; create a detailed meal plan, reduce takeout and increase quality protein and vegetables; schedule a comprehensive physical exam in early March and set quarterly reminders. Finally, exported as PDF and set daily reminders on the phone.
location: Home study, Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Handle Work and Consult Doctor Friend
description: Feng Haoran was in his study handling the start-of-year work. He first logged into the company system to download new industry research reports, replied to clients' post-holiday greeting emails, and made small adjustments to the asset allocation recommendations for important clients before the holiday. Around 16:00, he contacted his doctor friend Wang Zhiqiang, who works at Wuhan Central Hospital, and described his mother's recent physical condition (weight loss, blood pressure fluctuations, dizziness) in detail via WeChat, and sent an organized document. Wang Zhiqiang replied quickly and proactively arranged a deep physical examination package for the morning of February 2, including items such as cardiovascular and cerebrovascular, tumor screening, and bone density. Feng Haoran expressed sincere gratitude.
location: Home study, Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Go out for a walk and get takeout dinner.
description: At 17:00, put on lightweight shoes and went out. First took a leisurely walk in Jinxing Residential Quarter, then walked to the nearby Manlao Shixiangli Country Restaurant. Upon arrival, exchanged New Year greetings with the familiar boss, ordered my favorite stir-fried pork with peppers and seasonal vegetables to take away.
location: Man Lao Shi Xiangli Tujia Restaurant and Jinxing Residential Community, Property Building of Jianxin Resettlement Community, Second Management Area, Xihu Street, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Enjoy dinner at home and deal with backlogged messages.
description: He plated the takeout dishes, and while eating, took out his phone to reply to accumulated blessing messages from friends and colleagues during the Spring Festival. He posted a dinner photo in the family group chat, which made family members laugh.
location: Home, Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Arrange a physical exam for mother and confirm with father via video
description: After a short rest following the meal, Feng Haoran organized the appointment confirmation information sent by Dr. Wang Zhiqiang (morning of February 2, Wuhan Union Hospital, including precautions) into text and sent it to the family group. At 20:05, his father proactively video-called. Seeing the information, he was very happy and said he had already discussed it with his mother. Feng Haoran repeatedly confirmed that his father would accompany him that day, reminded him to wear a scarf and hat when going out to keep warm, and screenshotted the physical examination item list and sent it to his father. His father repeatedly praised him for being thorough. After the call, Feng Haoran felt much more at ease.
location: Home study, Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening walk to buy daily necessities
description: After finishing the phone call with his father, he changed into running shoes and went out for a night walk. Walking slowly along Shuangtang Road, he adjusted his breathing rhythm, reviewed the execution of today's plan, and considered tomorrow's morning running route. At about 20:45, he stopped at the convenience store in Meilin Yingu International Community, bought toothpaste, wet wipes and a bottle of milk, then checked out and went home.
location: Convenience store at Meilin Yingu International Community, Shuangtang Road and No. 344 Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Organize photos and plan the February agenda.
description: After returning home, imported the landscape photos snapped on the highway into the computer for simple selection and color adjustment. Opened the diary software to record reflections, expressing concern for mother's health and the belief in protecting the family. Combined the health plan made today with the February execution plan, and set relevant reminders on the smartwatch.
location: Home, Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Washing up and bedtime reading
description: At 22:30, I finished washing up, changed into pajamas, lay on the bed, and read "Principles" for half an hour to relax my mind. At 23:00, I turned off the lights on time and fell asleep with the satisfaction of completing my plan and anticipation for the new day.
location: Home, Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Long-distance morning run recovery training
description: In the early morning, the sky was faintly bright, with a temperature of about 2-3 degrees. Feng Haoran put on compression clothing and a windproof jacket, then drove to the Xiangjiang Riverside Scenic Belt to meet up with his running buddy Gao Yunfei. The two completed a 10km run along the southern section of the scenic belt at a pace of 5:45 per kilometer, with a Garmin watch recording heart rate and cadence in real time. During the run, they exchanged information about the Series B financing that Gao Yunfei's company had recently obtained and his views on the computing power chip market, which provided a new perspective for Feng Haoran's investment in tech stocks. After the run, they did 10 minutes of stretching by the river, exchanged New Year greetings, and then drove home.
location: Xiangjiang River Scenic Belt, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (near Xiaoxiang Middle Road)

name: Return home, shower, and physical recovery
description: After returning home from the morning run, he took a thorough hot shower to wash away sweat and chill. At the bathroom sink, he applied moisturizing face cream and changed into comfortable home sweatshirt and track pants. Then he used a fascia gun on his leg muscles for 5 minutes of deep relaxation to relieve exercise fatigue and ensure good physical condition.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Simple breakfast and morning news
description: Turn on the phone and connect to the Bluetooth speaker, play a financial news podcast, focusing on overnight U.S. tech stock performance and the latest Fed moves. Meanwhile, prepare breakfast: heat two slices of whole wheat toast in the toaster, fry a soft-boiled egg, and brew a bowl of Xiaogan rice wine brought back from Wuhan for a quick energy boost. After the meal, pour-over a cup of Ethiopian Yirgacheffe coffee to refresh and wake up.
location: At home (dining room), Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Monthly investment portfolio operations and strategy review
description: In the study, turned on dual screens, logged into the Huatai Securities account to browse overnight US stock close and Asia-Pacific market dynamics. After confirming no major negative news, executed the monthly plan: 1) Completed February automatic monthly investment, transferring 3,000 yuan and 2,000 yuan to CSI 300 and CSI 500 index funds respectively; 2) Using year-end bonus funds, screened technology-themed funds, and finally selected ChinaAMC Semiconductor Leader Hybrid A, characterized by AI computing power and wafer foundry, and subscribed an additional 3,000 yuan in shares; 3) To achieve the adjustment of the stock-bond ratio from 60:40 to 65:35, redeemed 10,000 yuan from a certain bond-biased hybrid fund and added the funds to E Fund Blue Chip Select Hybrid. After the operations, recorded the transaction screenshots and adjustment reasons in the personal investment management table.
location: Study room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Lunch and market research
description: At noon, I drove to a home-style Hunan restaurant, ordered a serving of stir-fried pork with green peppers, a serving of steamed fish head with chopped chilies, and a bowl of rice. During the meal, I deliberately observed the restaurant's customer flow and quickly browsed annual report data of catering ETFs and consumer stocks via a mobile app, combining first-hand on-site impressions with market information to form an intuitive judgment on the consumption recovery trend.
location: Property Management Building, Jianxin Resettlement Community, Second Administrative Area, Xihu Subdistrict, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (Manlaoshi Country Restaurant)

name: Stamp collection organization and electronic archiving
description: After returning home and changing into loungewear, went into the study, took out all the stamp albums from the collection cabinet, focusing on organizing the thematic collection of Republic of China and Liberated Area stamps. Wearing white gloves, used a Sony mirrorless camera with a macro lens to take high-definition photos of each sheet or individual stamp. Then imported the photos into Enodia collection management software to create digital records for each stamp, entering in detail the year of issue, printing variety, perforation gauge, condition (such as high grade, medium-high grade), and preliminary market reference price. While handling a set of yellowed Republic of China stamps featuring Sun Yat-sen, sent photos via WeChat to collector friend Luo Zhenyu in Shenzhen, asking for advice on paper deacidification and selection of acid-free protective mounts, and arranged to meet up next time.
location: Study room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Formulate a personal health improvement plan
description: After closing the collection software, opened Excel on the computer and, based on post-holiday weight (76 kg, target 70 kg) and physical condition, formulated a three-week "post-holiday reshaping plan." Exercise: morning runs every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday (5 km, 7 km, 10 km respectively), and strength training on Saturday (squats, push-ups, etc., 12 reps per set for 4 sets). Diet: remove carbs from dinner, increase intake of eggs and chicken breast. Set daily water intake to 2 liters and set a reminder on the watch every 1.5 hours. After printing the table, attached it to the refrigerator door with a magnet to remind himself to strictly execute the plan.
location: Study room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Remotely care for mother and confirm check-up preparation items
description: In front of the floor-to-ceiling window on the living room balcony, he made a video call to his mother, Li Xiuying. After seeing that she was watching a health program, he gently reminded her not to eat breakfast and to drink less water before tomorrow's medical check-up, and told her that he had already contacted Dr. Wang Zhiqiang and arranged all the examination procedures. His mother agreed repeatedly, while asking over and over whether Feng Haoran was eating well alone in Changsha. The call lasted about 20 minutes and ended with mutual reminders, leaving Feng Haoran feeling more at ease.
location: At home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (living room balcony)

name: Evening free activities: photography and reading
description: After hanging up, feeling relaxed, I first imported the photos of the morning mist over the Xiangjiang River taken during my morning run into my phone and did simple color grading. I selected the best one, added the caption "At the tail of the holiday, start the new month with 10 km and Sanjiaomao Coffee," and posted it to my Moments. Then I received a reply from collector friend Luo Zhenyu about stamp maintenance and thanked him. Afterward, I went into the study, took 'Poor Charlie's Almanack' from the bookshelf, turned to where I had last read, and read quietly for about 45 minutes, excerpting Munger's insights on the 'latticework of mental models' in my notebook.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (living room, study)

name: Dinner and shopping trip
description: For dinner, I made a light tomato, baby cabbage, and egg soup by myself using the leftover tomatoes, eggs, and baby cabbage from the fridge, and ate it simply with the leftover stir-fried pork from lunch. After dinner, I cleaned up the kitchen, put on a jacket, and walked about 5 minutes to the Meilin Yingu International Community convenience store at the entrance of the community. For the next day's drive to Wuhan, I bought a large bottle of mineral water, two sports drinks, a pack of soda crackers, and two meat buns as breakfast for tomorrow.
location: Home kitchen at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 84, Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province; then went to the convenience store at Meilin Yingu International Community, No. 344, Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Tomorrow's schedule planning and clothing preparation
description: After walking home, I opened the phone's notes app in the bedroom and quickly planned tomorrow's trip to Wuhan: plan to set off at 6:30 a.m., take the Jinggang'ao Expressway, arrive at Wuhan Union Hospital before 9:30, accompany my mother through check-up items such as cardiovascular and tumor screening, and take my parents to a nice meal near the hospital at noon. Then I took out clean dark casual clothes and a lightweight down jacket from the wardrobe, and placed the car keys, phone charger, medical insurance card, and the copy of the physical exam list sent by my father all in the entryway basket, to ensure everything was foolproof.
