description: Back in the bedroom, he first spent 10 minutes listing the to-do items for April 1 in his phone memo: 1. Communicate with President Qian about the final draft of the Lin Zhihao plan; 2. Keep an eye on the market opening; 3. Send tea to his father. Then, leaning on the headboard, he began reading the chapter about the “pendulum of investor psychology and emotion” in Howard Marks's Cycles and made several notes.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Washing up and getting ready for bed
description: Put down the book, went to the bathroom to wash up with warm water, and, following the doctor's advice, applied a flurbiprofen gel patch to the back of the neck. Dimmed the bedroom lights and enabled Do Not Disturb mode on the phone.
location: Bathroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Sleep
description: After lying down, he closed his eyes and quickly reviewed in his mind the things completed today: financial inventory done, automatic investment executed, overseas REITs plan completed, physical recovery going well, follow-up appointment made. With the satisfaction that everything was in order, he fell asleep peacefully before 23:00, storing up energy for the first day of April.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Deep sleep
description: After completing the financial review and health assessment at the end of March, he fell asleep peacefully at 23:00 last night and stayed in deep sleep until being awakened by a phone call in the early morning.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Received an urgent call and quickly prepared.
description: He was woken up by an urgent call from his father Feng Jianguo, learning that his mother had been hospitalized with gastric bleeding. He instantly became alert, and in just 15 minutes made decisions, washed up briefly, and packed an emergency backpack (containing a power bank, change of clothes, ID card, medical insurance card, and wallet). At 2:25, he hurried downstairs and started the car.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drove home overnight under the starry sky
description: Set off from the residential community and drove onto the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway. Stopped at Yueyang Service Area for 8 minutes, drank a cup of hot water to refresh, and updated my younger sister Feng Xinran via WeChat voice message. Stayed highly focused throughout and arrived in Wuhan at 6:00 in the morning.
location: Jinggang'ao Expressway (section from Changsha City, Hunan Province to Wuhan City, Hubei Province)

name: Arrival at the hospital and morning rest
description: You arrived at the emergency department of the Nanjing Road campus of Wuhan Central Hospital and found your exhausted father, Feng Jianguo. After a brief exchange, you went to the Maoyuan Grocery Convenience Store opposite the hospital and bought two meat buns, a cup of hot soy milk, and a new thermos. Back in the car, you used the car toiletry kit to clean up and refresh. Then you sent a WeChat leave message to your superior Qian Yongqiang: "Mr. Qian, there is an urgent family matter, I need to take a week off, details to follow."
location: Wuhan Central Hospital Nanjing Road Campus and surrounding area, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province (including the Maoyuan grocery store and parking lot across the street)

name: Leave request communication and sibling division of duties
description: At 07:10, walked to a quiet corner of the hospital and called supervisor Qian Yongqiang, explained mother's condition in detail and formally asked for one week of leave (April 1-7), which was approved. Then called colleague Zheng Wenbo and detailed the key follow-up execution points and client communication scripts for Lin Zhihao's REITs plan, ensuring a seamless handover. At 08:00, younger sister Feng Xinran called back, sounding anxious. Told her the doctor's initial diagnosis and expected hospitalization period, and quickly agreed on the division of responsibilities: she would apply for annual leave, comfort father, and handle follow-up dietary care; I would focus on medical decisions and external communication.
location: Corridor of the Emergency Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Handle hospital admission and medical coordination.
description: After the hospital officially started business, he accompanied his father Feng Jianguo to complete the hospitalization procedures for his mother, paid the deposit, and arranged admission to the gastroenterology ward. He then had a detailed first conversation with the attending physician, clearly conveying his mother's medical history and recent symptoms, and recorded the diagnosis, treatment plan, and follow-up examination arrangements in the memo on his phone.
location: Inpatient payment window and gastroenterology ward, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Accompanying for medical checks and arranging the hospital ward
description: Accompanied mother Li Xiuying for routine admission examinations including blood draw, electrocardiogram, and abdominal ultrasound. Supported her throughout and comforted her softly. After returning to the ward, placed a thermos filled with warm water by her bedside, and bought two newspapers and a copy of 'Reader' magazine from the convenience store to keep father entertained.
location: Wards and various examination departments of the inpatient department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province.

name: Japanese study during caregiving breaks.
description: After her IV infusion, my mother was stable. I sat by the hospital bed, put on earphones, opened the NHK Japanese learning app, and reviewed basic grammar and shadowed slow news. When my mother woke up midway, I put down my phone to chat with her and massaged her hands that had become cold from the IV. During a break, I used the JD app to order two books, 'Standard Japanese Intermediate' and 'Travel Japanese Conversation', to be shipped to my work address.
location: Ward, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Lunch and cancellation of camping plans
description: With my father, I bought three boxed meals in the hospital cafeteria and returned to the ward for a simple lunch. Mother needed a liquid diet due to treatment and only had some porridge. After lunch, while Mother was resting, I stepped into the corridor outside the ward and called Xie Yutong, apologizing calmly and sincerely for not being able to make it, explaining the family emergency, and that I had to cancel the three-day camping trip in western Hunan from April 4 to 6. Xie Yutong expressed full understanding and comforted me. After the call, I immediately operated on my phone: contacted JD.com's camping equipment rental customer service to cancel the order, and logged into 12306 to refund the high-speed rail tickets. Refund text messages from various platforms arrived one after another, with a total loss of about 200 yuan in handling fees.
location: Canteen and inpatient ward, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Confirming my sister's return date and strolling in the garden
description: At 13:10, my younger sister Feng Xinran sent a WeChat voice message saying she had successfully applied for annual leave and bought a high-speed rail ticket for tomorrow morning (April 2), expected to arrive in Wuhan in the afternoon. When I told my father the good news, his brows relaxed. At 14:00, while my father was taking care of my mother, I went downstairs to the hospital garden and stood for 10 minutes, breathing fresh air and stretching my back that had become stiff from sitting for a long time.
location: Inpatient ward and hospital garden, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Deep work handover and processing.
description: During the afternoon when my father was watching over the hospital bed, I walked to the quiet family rest area, took out my laptop and connected to my phone's hotspot. I found an email from an important client expressing dissatisfaction with last week's REITs portfolio performance. I quickly replied to the email, first apologizing for the trouble caused to the client, then professionally explaining the reasons for recent market fluctuations, and attached a targeted optimization and adjustment plan, demonstrating a high sense of responsibility and professionalism even while on vacation.
location: Family rest area, inpatient ward, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Family communication and care
description: After handling work, returned to the ward. My mother's spirits had improved, so I chatted with her about family matters and the news that my younger sister would be back tomorrow. I opened the phone's photo album and showed her the previously taken photos of Changsha street scenes; she was very happy to see them. Then I went back to the Japanese learning app and watched a lesson for a while to keep up with my study routine.
location: Ward, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Dinner and relaxation
description: Went to the hospital cafeteria with my father for dinner. Took a photo of the city night view outside the window with my phone; the city under neon lights was still bustling, but my heart gradually calmed with the sound of the shutter. Over dinner, I discussed tomorrow's arrangements with my father, including plans to rent a hotel room by the hour nearby to take a shower, and the division of labor rotation after my sister returns.
location: Canteen and inpatient ward, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Evening caregiving and self-reflection.
description: Returned to the ward, wiped my mother's face, massaged her feet, and chatted with her. At the small bedside table for caregivers, I used my phone memo to write down today's routine records and feelings. Then I continued to open the Japanese learning app, watched two travel conversation lessons, and planned the scene of traveling to Japan with my mother after she recovers.
location: Ward, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Hotel hourly room to recover energy
description: At 20:30, after discussing with my father, I left the hospital and walked about 5 minutes to the nearby Daidin Select Hotel, where I checked into a 4-hour hourly room. I quickly took a hot shower and changed into a clean T-shirt. Most of the fatigue from the day's running around was washed away by the hot water, and I felt refreshed. In the room, I used my phone to set the alarm for tomorrow's to-do items.
location: Daiding Select Hotel (Hankou Jiangtan Branch, Wuhan Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street), Jianghan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Walk back to the ward
description: At 21:30, checked out of the hotel and walked back to the Nanjing Road Campus of Wuhan Central Hospital. The streets were quiet at night. I took a deep breath and felt calm and determined.
location: The streets from Daiding Select Hotel in Jianghan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province to the Nanjing Road branch of Wuhan Central Hospital at No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District

name: Getting ready for bed and reflection
description: Back in the ward, my mother had already fallen asleep peacefully, and my father was resting on the companion bed. I carefully tidied my own companion bed. After writing today's summary and tomorrow's to-do list on my phone, I sent Xie Yutong a message: "Everything is settled, thank you for your understanding." With my mother's steady breathing, I turned off my phone screen and fell asleep on the companion bed around 23:30.
location: Ward, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Morning caregiving and breakfast
description: After waking up in the hospital companion chair, I quickly completed my personal hygiene. First, I checked my mother's overnight infusion records, observed her mental state, and helped her with morning washing and changing into a hospital gown. I recorded her morning blood pressure (128/75) and temperature (36.5). While my mother was eating breakfast (white porridge provided by the hospital), I walked to the first-floor cafeteria, bought myself a hot American coffee and a boiled egg, and packed a bowl of shredded chicken noodles for my father. After returning to the ward, I briefly updated my father, who had come for the shift change, on last night's situation. He looked a bit tired, and I reminded him to rest.
location: Gastroenterology ward, 6th floor, inpatient department, Nanjing Road Campus of Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province; hospital cafeteria

name: Doctor's rounds and medical orders record
description: The attending physician led the ward round, asking in detail whether my mother had any discomfort after eating yesterday and checking the gastric tube drainage. I used my phone's memo app to quickly record key medical orders: “Continue fasting today, observe for any re-bleeding, and try a small amount of liquid diet tomorrow as a transition” and “Stop hemostatic drugs, continue acid-suppressing and gastric mucosal protection treatment.” During a break in the ward round, I proactively asked whether my father’s high blood pressure was related to caregiver anxiety and lack of rest. The doctor advised observation and, if necessary, a consultation with the cardiovascular medicine department at the outpatient clinic.
location: Gastroenterology Ward, 6th Floor, Inpatient Building, Nanjing Road Branch, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Thesis revision and family coordination.
description: After my mother started the IV infusion, I sat down on the bench in the ward corridor with my laptop. First, I called my aunt Feng Xiuzhen, who lives in Jianghan District, Wuhan, to confirm that she could come to the hospital to take over around 2 p.m. Then, combined with last night's communication with Zhou Yuwei, we discussed the rejection comments from "Hunan Finance" one by one via WeChat screen sharing. I was responsible for revising the introduction's overview of the development of the ESG rating system, with a focus on supplementing the progress of the 2024 global sustainability disclosure standards. I was interrupted twice, once by the nurse calling and once by my father calling me, so the actual effective work time was about 60 minutes.
location: Bench area in the corridor of the 6th floor ward, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Communication with father and midday care
description: Returning to the ward, I found my father using the blood pressure monitor next to the caregiver chair to measure his blood pressure, which read 148/93. I pulled him over to a quiet corner of the corridor. Instead of directly talking about his condition, I first acknowledged his efforts over these past few days, then suggested that when Auntie comes to take over in the afternoon, he must go home and rest for two hours. I also advised him to register at the cardiology outpatient department in the afternoon for a comprehensive check-up. Father was silent for a while, then finally nodded. I accompanied him to the hospital cafeteria to buy his lunch (a bowl of tomato and egg noodles), and I also had a simple boxed meal.
location: Inpatient Department, 6th Floor, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province; hospital cafeteria

name: Warm companionship and emotional exchange.
description: After lunch, my mother's spirits improved somewhat. I drew the curtains, leaving a gap for sunlight to come through. I sat by the bed and chatted with her about a set of birdwatching photography works I had seen online, asking if she had ever paid attention to this kind of theme. She then asked about my work and Japanese studies. I lightly said everything was fine, and joked that being in the hospital was actually a good chance to study Japanese in peace. She smiled and told me to take care of myself. At that moment, the atmosphere in the ward became much softer.
location: Gastroenterology Ward, 6th Floor, Inpatient Building, Nanjing Road Branch, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Accompany father to the cardiology department for an outpatient visit
description: After Aunt arrived early at 14:00, I gave a few brief instructions and then walked with my father to the outpatient department. We had already made an online appointment, so we waited about 20 minutes. The doctor took a detailed history and measured my father's blood pressure (152/96). Considering his recent stress and lack of sleep, the doctor diagnosed it as 'hypertension (Grade 1)'. The doctor ordered 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring and blood tests, and recommended initial control through lifestyle adjustments and short-term medication, while also ruling out secondary hypertension. I took careful notes throughout and helped my father pick up the medicine (amlodipine besylate tablets).
location: Department of Cardiovascular Medicine, Outpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Continue paper revision and professional networking.
description: After returning to the inpatient department, I continued revising my paper. I sent a WeChat message to my colleague Zheng Wenbo, briefly told him about my family situation, and asked whether there were any urgent matters requiring remote handling. He replied that everything was fine and told me to take care of my family with peace of mind. Then I took a photo of my father's newly prescribed blood pressure medication and sent it to investment director Qian Yongqiang, briefly explaining the situation. He replied with words telling me not to worry about work. After handling these matters, I used the remaining 30 minutes to optimize the logical chain of the literature review section of the paper.
location: Bench area in the corridor of the 6th floor ward, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Mutual support among patients and a walk in the hospital courtyard
description: A strange young lady was pacing anxiously in the corridor, so I took the initiative to approach and ask. I learned that her mother had just been admitted to the hospital and she was unfamiliar with the admission process and where to pay. I told her in detail how to complete the procedures on the self-service machine, walked her through the route from the ward to the payment office in the outpatient hall, and also shared some caregiving tips. After helping her, I walked two laps around the hospital garden downstairs from the inpatient building as today's exercise, and also moved my neck, which had been stiff from sitting for a long time.
location: The 6th-floor ward corridor of the inpatient building and the hospital garden, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province.

name: Evening family communication and dinner
description: Back in the ward, my mother had already rested for a while. My aunt said that her condition was stable in the afternoon with no discomfort. I accompanied my mother for the hospital dinner (lotus root powder, a liquid diet) and told her she could try eating normally tomorrow; a look of expectation appeared in her eyes. Meanwhile, I discussed the weekend care arrangements with my aunt. She voluntarily offered to cover another day so that both my father and I could take a break. I thanked her sincerely.
location: Gastroenterology Ward, 6th Floor, Inpatient Building, Nanjing Road Branch, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Self-regulation and family video call
description: In the evening, I had a video call via WeChat with my father, who was resting at home at No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District. I saw that he was in much better condition than in the afternoon. He said he had taken his medicine and his self-measured blood pressure had dropped to 140/85. I reminded him again about wearing the ambulatory blood pressure monitor and having the blood test tomorrow morning, and told him he didn't need to come to the hospital too early and could sleep in a bit. After hanging up, I saw a message from my younger sister and replied briefly to reassure her. Then I went to the balcony of the ward and did a 15-minute unguided mindful breathing practice, focusing on the present moment and feeling my anxiety level out. Afterward, I wrote today's diary in my phone memo, focusing on the results of my father's medical visit and tomorrow's care plan.
location: Balcony of the ward on the 6th floor of the inpatient department of the Nanjing Road campus of Wuhan Central Hospital, 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Japanese study and tomorrow's planning.
description: Put on my earphones, opened the NHK Japanese learning app on my phone, and completed today's listening lesson and vocabulary review tasks in 30 minutes. This was like a mental switch that allowed me to temporarily step away from the tense caregiving atmosphere. Afterward, I opened the phone memo and sorted out tomorrow's to-do list: 1. Accompany Mom to try a liquid diet; 2. Confirm the results of Dad's ambulatory blood pressure monitoring; 3. Exchange paper revision drafts with Zhou Yuwei; 4. Ask Aunt to bring some soft snacks that Mom likes the next day.
location: At the accompanying chair in the 6th-floor ward of the inpatient department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan City, Hubei Province.

name: Bedtime preparations
description: Made up the bed on the accompanying chair, turned off the ceiling light, and left only a small night light on. Moistened my mother's lips and confirmed that she had fallen asleep peacefully. Listening to the sparse traffic sounds from the riverbank area outside the window, I closed my eyes, ready to end this fulfilling yet exhausting day.
location: At the accompanying chair in the 6th-floor ward of the inpatient department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan City, Hubei Province.

name: Morning buffer and health monitoring
description: Feng Haoran woke up from the hospital recliner and washed up briefly. Because of the hospital environment, he skipped his morning run, but in the corridor he followed the cervical spine stretching video Gao Yunfei had sent last night to exercise his shoulders and neck, while listening to "Financial Morning Express" via Bluetooth earphones to stay sensitive to market dynamics. Then he went to the convenience store on the first floor to buy instant coffee and two steamed buns. Returning to the ward, he took over from his father, who had stayed overnight, and learned that his mother had slept peacefully with occasional coughing. He checked the ambulatory blood pressure monitor on the bedside table, noted that the readings were stable at around 135/85, and felt relieved.
location: Inpatient building 8th floor ward, corridor, and first-floor convenience store, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Morning companionship and breakfast preparation
description: Helped the nurse on duty measure my mother's morning vital signs. Prepared a liquid breakfast for her by mixing the rice soup provided by the hospital with the nutritional protein powder brought by my aunt. Taking advantage of my mother's good spirits, I fed her while encouraging her. Then I opened the memo app on my phone to confirm today's event list and synced it to the phone calendar.
location: Ward 8, 8th Floor, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Paper discussion and family health consultation
description: His mother began an IV drip. Feng Haoran put on noise-canceling headphones, connected with Zhou Yuwei via Tencent Meeting on a bench in the 8th-floor corridor, and discussed the paper’s rejection comments section by section. Regarding the core contradiction of “the logical connection between asset pricing models and ESG in the introduction,” he proposed a new angle: “start from the return-drawdown ratio and use the market inefficiency hypothesis to bridge the two,” combining financial practice. Zhou Yuwei approved of it. The discussion was efficient, though it was interrupted twice by nurse calls, but the overall goal was clear. Afterwards, he proactively went to the doctor’s office, found his mother’s attending physician, handed over his father’s hypertension diagnosis record, and asked in detail about the specific implementation of a low-salt, low-fat diet. The doctor recommended a “red-black list of common foods,” emphasizing that low-sodium salt and steaming/boiling are better than frying and sautéing. Feng Haoran recorded the whole conversation and took notes in his memo app, and finally printed out the diet list. When he returned to the ward, his mother had finished the IV. While helping her tidy the bed, he relayed the doctor’s advice in a relaxed tone, which made her nod and smile.
location: Hubei Province, Wuhan City, Jiangan District, 26 Shengli Street, Wuhan Central Hospital Nanjing Road Campus, inpatient department 8th floor corridor, doctor's office.

name: Midday handover, work, and walking with mother
description: Aunt Feng Xiuzhen arrived at the hospital to take over. Feng Haoran carefully handed over his mother's diet, medication times, and the day's examination arrangements, reminding her to do physiotherapy at 2 o'clock. While his mother was napping, he used the downtime in the ward to work on his phone on the client briefing to be sent to his colleague Zheng Wenbo in the afternoon. He pulled up two market analyses left over from last week from his cloud notes, highlighted key data and investment conclusions, and backed them up to WeChat File Transfer Helper. When his mother woke up, she was in good spirits, so he accompanied her for a walk in the hospital garden, acting as a 'human crutch.' The sun was just right, and he took a few candid photos with his phone. Afterwards, he went to the hospital cafeteria to pack lunch: light stir-fried seasonal vegetables and steamed sea bass for his father, and a twice-cooked pork rice bowl for himself.
location: Ward on the 8th floor of the inpatient department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, 26 Shengli Street, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province; the small garden downstairs; and the first-floor cafeteria.

name: Emotional support for a friend and debt analysis
description: After his mother's afternoon nap, Feng Haoran made an excuse to go out and buy water, walked to a quiet and airy garden bench downstairs in the inpatient building, and proactively made a video call to Peng Yuqing. When the call connected, her voice was hoarse as she bitterly recounted the details of her company's closure and the pressure of 150,000 yuan in debt. Feng Haoran listened quietly the whole time without interrupting. After her emotions calmed down a bit, he used his professional perspective as an investment advisor to help her break down the debt, suggested prioritizing repayment of loans from relatives and friends, negotiating with the bank for deferment and lower monthly payments, and said he could lend her a few tens of thousands from his liquid funds to tide over. The call lasted 50 minutes, and Peng Yuqing's mood improved significantly, promising to sort out a debt list later.
location: A quiet garden corner outside the first floor of the inpatient department of the Nanjing Road Campus of Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province.

name: Afternoon wrap-up of thesis and work briefing
description: His mother was watching a TV series in the hospital room. Feng Haoran, sitting in the accompanying chair, spent 40 minutes focusing intensively on the historical context section of the literature review in his thesis. Based on the new ideas discussed in the morning, he rewrote and polished three paragraphs. Afterwards, his mother tried the rice cakes brought by his aunt. Feng Haoran chatted with her while using his phone to finish the two market analysis briefs, which he sent to Zheng Wenbo via WeChat with a message saying that there were many family matters at home and he had only done a rough overview, but the data and logic were fine, and he could call if needed.
location: Ward 8, 8th Floor, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Evening care and fragmented study
description: Assisted the nurse with evening care for mother. Handled fragmented information, replied to a few WeChat messages from colleagues, and checked fund net value changes. Using the 15 minutes while the nurse was providing care, put on earphones to listen to Japanese learning audio and consolidate the grammar learned yesterday.
location: Ward 8, 8th Floor, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Catch up with friends and prepare a customized dinner for father
description: While getting some fresh air outside the ward building, Feng Haoran received a WeChat message from Gao Yunfei. He replied by voice, explaining that his running volume was on hold because a family member was hospitalized, thanked him for the stretching video, and attached a photo of the dusk sky. His father hurried over from home to take care of his mother. Feng Haoran walked 7 minutes to Xiangzi Restaurant on Shengli Street at the hospital gate, and according to the doctor's diet plan, packed takeout for his father: low-salt shredded pork with green peppers, stir-fried potato shreds, and rice. He specifically reminded the owner to use less oil. Back in the ward, the family of three had a simple dinner. Feng Haoran handed the packed dishes to his father and reminded him that he must eat this way at home too.
location: Xiangzi Restaurant, Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province; Ward on the 8th floor of the Inpatient Building, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital.

name: In-depth father-son dialogue and digital health management
description: Feng Haoran sat side by side with his father on the bench in the corridor on the 8th floor, starting an honest father-son conversation. His father sighed about being too strong-willed in the past. Feng Haoran held his father's hand and comforted him, promising to face things together and first control his high blood pressure. Then he took out his phone and taught his father step by step how to use the health monitoring app, setting up a daily blood pressure check-in record hand by hand. His mother wanted to sleep early, so Feng Haoran tucked her in and dimmed the lights. Then, on the accompanying care chair, he sent a long, logically clear WeChat message to Peng Yuqing, suggesting she first organize a debt list, sort out her skills for knowledge payment and content monetization, and informing her that funds could be gathered by Friday. Peng Yuqing quickly replied with thanks.
location: Corridor and wards on the 8th floor of the Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Evening review and mindful breathing.
description: I used my phone to write a diary, reviewing the completion of today's core tasks: the paper, father's diet plan, and assistance to Xiaoyu were basically completed. My emotions found a balance among anxiety, responsibility, and the sense of achievement from helping others. Then I put on earphones and did 15 minutes of mindful breathing, focusing on each breath, slowly breathing out stress and fatigue.
location: Companion chair, 8th floor, inpatient department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Going to bed
description: After finishing the mindfulness practice, he adjusted the position of the caregiver chair and turned off the main screen light of his phone. His father was snoring softly on the other bed. Listening to his mother's steady breathing, Feng Haoran felt a strange peace of mind. In the dark, he silently planned tomorrow's to-dos, and then fell into a deep sleep before 23:15.
location: Ward 8, 8th Floor, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, No. 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Morning wake-up and state adjustment
description: Woke up on the hospital ward companion chair, confirmed that mother Li Xiuying was breathing evenly and had a peaceful night. Outside the window the sky was grey; a trace of melancholy arose because the Qingming Festival made it impossible to return home to pay respects to ancestors. After wiping my face with a wet wipe to freshen up, I put on earphones and played soft music, adjusting my mindset to welcome the new day.
location: Orthopedics Ward, 10th Floor, Inpatient Department, Nanjing Road Campus, Wuhan Central Hospital, 26 Shengli Street, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: In the early morning, working on the thesis and providing care in parallel.

description: Set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning, do a bedtime review in the diary, and write down three satisfying things: efficient work handover, photography exhibition gains, and camping preparations ready. Plan tomorrow morning's departure checklist: check ID card, bring camera, refuel the car.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Relaxation and Falling Asleep
description: At 21:45, turned off the main light and turned on the bedside lamp, put on headphones to play rainforest white noise, and did a 10-minute mindful breathing exercise. At 22:10, turned off electronic devices, read two pages of 'Poor Charlie's Almanack', and turned off the light to sleep at 22:30, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Morning Preparation and Equipment Check
description: On Saturday morning, natural light woke you at exactly 6:00. Although you didn't have a morning run scheduled, you habitually did 10 minutes of stretching by the bed to wake up your body. After washing up, you changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and hiking pants, and had a simple breakfast of milk oatmeal and a banana. Then you walked to the balcony and, through the car window, confirmed that the tent, sleeping bag, and other gear in the trunk were securely fixed. Finally, you checked the Nikon D850 camera bag, a thermos filled with spring water, a power bank, and a set of change of clothes, making sure all camping supplies were ready.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Pick up Peng Yuqing to go camping
description: At 6:45, you set off on time in your home SUV, heading along the South Second Ring Road via Houzishi Bridge toward Yuhua District. After about 25 minutes, you arrive at the entrance of Jiusheng Hotel at 7:10. Peng Yuqing is already waiting by the roadside with a huge hiking backpack. You help her put the bag into the trunk and tease with a smile: “Are you moving house?” Peng Yuqing complains that she couldn't sleep last night because she was thinking about camping. The two of you continue driving to the next pickup point.
location: From No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province to Jiusheng Hotel, No. 239 Shaoshan South Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Pick up Xie Yutong and have breakfast together
description: You set off from Yuhua District and crossed the city to Kaifu District. At 7:45 you arrived near Xie Yutong's home and found her carrying a small hiking bag, waiting for you at the familiar 'Old Changsha Rice Noodle Shop' on the corner. You three decided to have a steaming bowl of beef rice noodles there for energy. During the meal, Xie Yutong shared how she had worked late last night and only packed her luggage this morning; Peng Yuqing listened quietly, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. After breakfast, you got ready to set off.
location: Old Changsha Rice Noodle Shop, Area C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drive to Daweishan National Forest Park
description: At 8:15, we set off from the city on time, driving along the Changsha-Liuyang Expressway. You turned on the stereo and played a relaxing folk song playlist. Outside the window, the scenery transitioned from urban high-rises to rolling green mountains, which was refreshing. Peng Yuqing and Xie Yutong chatted about work and life in the back seat, while you occasionally chimed in to share interesting stories from last week's photography exhibition visit. After driving for about 2 hours, we arrived at the parking lot of Dawei Mountain National Forest Park at 10:20.
location: From Kaifu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, via Changliu Expressway to the parking lot of Dawei Mountain National Forest Park, Liuyang City, Hunan Province.

name: Weighted hiking and camp setup
description: The three of you split the equipment: you carry the heaviest tent and cookware bag (about 15 kg), while Peng Yuqing and Xie Yutong share the sleeping bags, food, and tripod. Walk slowly along the trail for about 1.5 kilometers to reach the pre-booked flat camping area. The weather in November is cool, but carrying weight up the mountain still makes the three of you slightly sweaty. You work together to choose a sheltered spot, skillfully set up the pyramid tent, and lay out the moisture-proof mats. You use trekking poles to secure the guy lines while they organize the interior, and the campsite is quickly set up.
location: Designated camping area on the mountainside, Dawei Mountain National Forest Park, Liuyang, Hunan Province

name: Camp lunch and rest
description: Near the stream by the tent, the three of them sat on the ground and took out their packed lunch: energy bars, bread, apples, and yogurt. While eating and chatting, you pulled out your phone and snapped a silhouette of the two of them sitting on a rock by the stream, munching apples. The air was filled with the rich fragrance of vegetation and the sound of the stream. After the meal, you checked the GoPro battery and prepared to record some video footage in the afternoon. Everyone rested a bit to build up energy for the afternoon hike.
location: By the stream in the camping area of Dawei Mountain National Forest Park, Liuyang City, Hunan Province

name: Deep hiking, healing conversations, and photographic creation.
description: This is the soul time of the day. You stroll along the azalea trail, stopping now and then. At the Qixing Ridge observation deck with a wide view, you take out your Nikon D850, search for the best light and shadows, and photograph the azaleas covering the mountainside and the towering peaks in the distance. At the same time, an open and deep conversation begins: Xie Yutong confides in the high pressure of working at a major internet company and her confusion about wanting to quit and travel; Peng Yuqing talks about the anxiety of debt brought on by job changes and investment losses. You share your own career bottleneck between becoming a technical investment advisor and taking the management track. While taking photos, you give Peng Yuqing specific professional advice on sorting out her cash flow, delaying loan repayments, and finding sideline opportunities. During the break, you take out your phone and start to conceive and dictate the material for the second episode of "Haoran Financial Intelligence Course", with the theme "Teamwork and Asset Allocation from a Camping Trip". Alternating between the camera and the phone, you record this fulfilling and healing time.
location: From the Rhododendron Trail to Qixingling Observation Deck, Dawei Mountain National Forest Park, Liuyang City, Hunan Province

name: Returning to camp and preparing for a cookout.
description: In the evening, you returned to the campsite exhausted but relaxed. It was getting dark and the temperature dropped. You took out a headlamp and a portable gas stove from your bag, and directed the teamwork to start preparing dinner. Using a cassette stove, you boiled spring water, cooked three packets of instant noodles, and also boiled a large pot of black tea in a cookware set, adding milk to make simple milk tea. Everyone sat around the ground mat, warming up while sharing fun stories and reflections from the hike, enjoying the simple dinner prepared with their own hands.
location: Dawei Mountain National Forest Park Camping Area, Liuyang City, Hunan Province

name: Campfire night talk and star photography
description: In the designated area of the campsite, they lit a campfire on a fireproof mat. The firelight reflected on everyone’s faces, bringing warmth. The conversation naturally extended from life pressures to the meaning of life and personal values. You shared the inspiration of “waiting for the decisive moment” from the photography exhibition and encouraged them to patiently wait for turning points in life. Around 21:00, the campfire gradually weakened, and the starry sky appeared. You took out the tripod, set up the phone and camera, and tried to shoot star trail photos. You told them to use a 30-second long exposure, and as they watched the light trails on the phone screen gradually appear, the three of them gasped in amazement.
location: By the campfire in the camping area of Dawei Mountain National Forest Park, Liuyang, Hunan Province

name: Personal material organization and review
description: After the shoot, you crawled into the warm tent. You opened your phone and did a preliminary organization of the day's footage. In the Notes app, you wrote down three things that made you satisfied: 1. During the hike, you completed an honest, in-depth conversation; 2. You successfully captured a backlit photo of azalea bushes with a composition you were happy with; 3. You gave Peng Yuqing effective financial advice by the campfire. Finally, you sent a message in the "Dawei Mountain Camping Squad" group chat: "Today was a day that healed my soul. Thank you both." After a brief review, you got ready for sleep.
location: Inside a tent in Dawei Mountain National Forest Park, Liuyang City, Hunan Province

name: Falling asleep under the starry sky
description: Lying on the moisture-proof mat and down sleeping bag, you close the tent, leaving only a small vent. Through the transparent window of the tent, the brilliant night sky is unobstructed. Listening to the faint wind and insects outside, the day's exhaustion and tension completely melt away. You adjust your sleeping position, hearing the soft conversations of two friends in the neighboring tent, slowly close your eyes, and fall into a deep sleep under the stars and tranquility.
location: In a sleeping bag inside a tent at Dawei Mountain National Forest Park, Liuyang, Hunan Province

name: Woke up in the campsite, packed up camp, and had a simple meal
description: Woke up to the sounds of birds in the Qixingling camping area of Dawei Mountain National Forest Park in Liuyang. Though my body felt sore, my mind was relaxed. The three of us divided tasks and worked together to take down the tent, clean up trash, and organize sleeping bags and cooking utensils, ensuring that no trace was left. At 06:50, drank instant coffee to refresh myself and reminded myself to keep a light diet to conserve energy for the day's activities.
location: Qixingling Camping Area, Dawei Mountain National Forest Park, Liuyang, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Hiked down the mountain to the parking lot and handled work messages.
description: Carrying a backpack of about 15 kilograms, I hiked down along the winding mountain trail, taking photos of the morning scenery along the way. When I arrived at the South Gate parking lot at 08:00, I found a message from my supervisor Qian Yongqiang sent at 07:30 asking about the outline of next week's client presentation materials. I replied briefly by voice at 08:10, promising to complete the initial framework before tonight.
location: South Gate parking lot, Dawei Mountain National Forest Park, Liuyang, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drove back and had breakfast at a restaurant in Liuyang town.
description: Drove off from the parking lot at the south gate of Dawei Mountain, heading toward Changsha along Provincial Highway S326. Arrived at "Lao Liuji" restaurant on Huaichuan Street, Liuyang City at about 08:45, and ordered Liuyang steamed dishes, stir-fried pork with peppers, and sautéed seasonal vegetables for breakfast. During the meal, the three chatted casually about camping stories, and after refueling, continued the return trip.
location: Laoliuji Restaurant, 368 Jinsha Middle Road, Huaichuan Street, Liuyang, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Continue the return trip and take Peng Yuqing home
description: After the meal, drove back to Changsha city via Changliu Expressway, playing the career development podcast discussed by the campfire last night. Arrived at the gate of Phase II, Vanke Jinyuhuafu, Xiangzhang Road, Yuhua District at 10:00. Peng Yuqing thanked him for the company and advised him to stay calm when dealing with debts, agreeing to meet again next week.
location: Phase II of Vanke Jinyu Huafu, Xiangzhang Road, Yuhua District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Took Xie Yutong to Changsha South Railway Station.
description: Navigated directly from Vanke Jinyu Huafu Phase II to Changsha South Railway Station, arriving at the East Entrance at 10:22. When saying goodbye, Xie Yutong mentioned that we could try a more professional rock climbing experience next time, which rekindled your interest in studying rock climbing. After watching her enter the station, you marked a plan on your phone to research rock climbing tonight.
location: East entrance on Level 2 of Changsha South Railway Station (50 m walk from Exit 3 of Changsha South Railway Station Metro Station)

name: Go to Hongxing Farmers Market to purchase ingredients
description: Set off alone from Changsha South Railway Station, heading along Xiangzhang Road to Hongxing Farmers' Market in Yuhua District. Parked the car and entered the market at about 10:45. Following the doctor's advice, picked Tiegun yam, organic millet, and old-fashioned oats in the dried goods section, and also bought seasonal asparagus, spinach, tomatoes, and fresh free-range eggs to prepare for a healthy diet.
location: Hongxing Farmers' Market, Zhongyi 1st Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Return home to sort out ingredients and make a weekly meal plan
description: Returned home with the purchased ingredients to the Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community in Yuelu District. After washing the Chinese yam, he portioned and froze it, and sealed the millet and oats in the cabinet. At 11:15, he spread his notebook on the coffee table and, based on nutritional knowledge, devised a 'Family Health Week' meal plan centered on steaming and light cooking, including multigrain porridge for breakfast and steamed dishes for lunch. He also placed some grains into the electric slow cooker and scheduled cooking.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Organize camping equipment and preliminary photo selection
description: At home, I set up the camping tent to dry in the shade, hung up the sleeping bag, and rinsed the hardshell jacket. At 12:00, I sat at the computer and imported the camping photos from the camera memory card into Lightroom, initially selecting 20 landscape shots and 9 portraits to prepare for in-depth editing in the evening. I also confirmed the news that Peng Yuqing had arrived home safely.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Family video call to celebrate Mother's Day
description: Half an hour in advance, I made a family video call and sent Mother's Day greetings to my mother Li Xiuying in Wuhan dialect. My mother was in the kitchen, and the newly received health pot had already been unpacked. My father Feng Jianguo also appeared on camera. I guided my mother on using the health pot on the spot and gave a remote tutorial using the freshly purchased Chinese yam. When my mother successfully made fine yam cake, her eyes were moist with tears, which touched me deeply. At 13:10, I solemnly and warmly announced two family resolutions to the whole family: establish "the first Sunday of each month" as Family Sharing Day, with all members required to video link; establish a "Family Health Fund" with a monthly deposit of 500 yuan for parents' special health check-ups, nutritional supplements, and emergency expenses. My father nodded silently, and my sister Feng Xinran applauded me in front of the screen.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, living room

name: One-on-one interaction with sister Feng Xinran and preparing a surprise
description: After the family video call ended, you had a separate call with your younger sister. She shared her little frustration about shooting a Vlog at a store last week, but the footage was shaky due to lack of a handheld stabilizer. You comforted her and hinted that there would be a surprise tonight, then smilingly asked for her specific mailing address in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to prepare for sending her filming equipment.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, living room

name: Simple lunch and washing clothes
description: Because of the advance reservation, lunch was ready: millet and yam porridge, stir-fried asparagus, and a boiled egg. While eating, I scrolled on my phone to watch beginner instructional videos from a climbing coach, accumulating knowledge for my personal interest. Finished eating at 15:00, cleaned up the dishes, then took the camping gear washed in the morning out of the washing machine and hung it on the balcony to dry, preparing for the next outdoor activity.
location: Dining room and balcony, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Ordered a DJI Pocket 3 for my younger sister and confirmed flower delivery
description: In the study, I opened the e-commerce platform. To avoid the issue of shaky footage, I bought a DJI Pocket 3 all-around kit with better performance for my sister, paid expedited delivery to ensure it arrives at her residence in Pudong New Area, Shanghai by Tuesday, and wrote an encouraging note in the order remarks. At 16:00, I switched to the logistics app and confirmed that the Mother's Day carnations and my sister's sunflower bouquet (previously ordered) had both been delivered, and I received photos and voice messages of thanks from them.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Deep photo retouching and sharing with photography partners
description: Putting on earphones to play white noise, he continued editing the camping photos, finely adjusting the light and dark levels of three landscape photos, and retouching the portraits of Peng Yuqing and Xie Yutong to make them vivid and natural. At 17:00, he shared a silhouette of a tent under the starry sky with his photography partner Xu Jianing in Shenzhen. Xu Jianing praised the composition right away and discussed the camera parameters with him, and the two agreed to go to Wugong Mountain together next time to photograph the sea of clouds.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Research beginner rock climbing courses and reply to work messages
description: Switched web pages to formally research rock climbing, compared the prices, courses, and coaches of three climbing gyms in Changsha, and finally booked a beginner trial class at 10 a.m. tomorrow at Mango Climbing Gym on Wanjiali Road, Yuhua District. At 18:00, replied to Boss Qian's afternoon inquiry, prepared a brief document on the framework for next week's client presentation, and sent it to the work group. Then recorded the reservation information and equipment list in the memo.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Simple dinner and reading CFA textbooks
description: Dinner was simple: reheated the multigrain porridge saved from lunch, with a boiled egg and a few lettuce leaves. At 19:00 I returned to the bedroom, took out the derivatives overview chapter from the CFA textbooks and started reading, building up knowledge for possible client consultations next week and maintaining professional excellence.
location: Dining room and bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Mindfulness meditation and bedtime preparation
description: Turn off the bedroom light, do 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focus on reviewing today's mountain wind, mother's smile, and sister's future, feeling physical and mental satisfaction and peace. End meditation at 20:10, after deep breathing set the alarm for 6:00 tomorrow morning, check the cervical pillow position to ensure correct sleeping posture, inject momentum into tomorrow.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Fall asleep and rest
description: Fell asleep with a fulfilling and warm sense of satisfaction. Weight was about 74.8kg. Mood was full of drive, and mentally and financially prepared to repay part of the debt before the Dragon Boat Festival.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning meditation, stretching, and breakfast
description: Wake up at exactly 6:30, with a light drizzle outside the window. Wearing quick-dry sportswear, I spread the yoga mat on the floor in front of the living room's floor-to-ceiling windows, follow the meditation app for a 10-minute breathing exercise, and let my mind smoothly transition into the workday. Then I do 10 minutes of full-body stretching, focusing on the shoulders, neck, and waist to prepare for a long day of desk work. I go into the kitchen, take out the ingredients from Hongxing Farmers' Market, put millet and water into the electric stew pot, and steam two eggs at the same time. While waiting, I water the green plants on the balcony and quickly browse the financial morning news on my phone. Breakfast is steaming millet porridge, silky steamed eggs, and a cup of homemade black coffee.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Driving commute and market observation
description: Wearing a navy blue casual suit jacket and beige business casual pants, took the commuter bag and folding umbrella and went out. The light rain gradually stopped, and the ground was still wet. Drove out of the residential area, turned from Jinxing Road onto Yuelu Avenue, then crossed the Xiangjiang River via Xiangfu Road Bridge. Connected to the car Bluetooth, listened to the 'Financial Morning News' program, focusing on the latest policy interpretation of the real estate bond market. It took about 45 minutes to arrive at the Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District.
location: Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Arrival at work and preparation before the morning meeting.
description: Arrived at the company, bought a sandwich at the convenience store downstairs as backup. Swiped in and entered the 17th-floor office of the Huatai Securities Building, put the wet umbrella on the umbrella rack by the door. Turned on the computer, first watered the succulents on the desk, then quickly scanned overnight overseas market trends and this morning's domestic financial news. In the notebook, wrote down today's work priorities: Lin Zhihao's account observation, cross-border REITs plan, and draft of the weekly investment report.
location: Office on the 17th floor, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Team morning meeting
description: Attended the Monday team morning meeting chaired by Qian Yongqiang with colleagues in the 17th-floor meeting room. Mr. Feng briefly reported the initial situation after Lin Zhihao's position adjustment last Friday, with A-share positions reduced to 30%, and shared his judgment on the long-term market trend. General Manager Qian stressed that the focus this week should be on the upcoming macroeconomic data and encouraged everyone to exchange opinions.
location: Meeting Room, 17th Floor, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Handling client emails and monitoring accounts
description: Back at my desk, I started dealing with the backlog of client emails and spent 30 minutes replying to three clients' inquiries about this week's market strategy. Then I focused on opening Lin Zhihao's account, carefully checking the opening performance and capital flows of two consumer blue-chip stocks and one dividend ETF that he transferred in last Friday, and recorded key data in preparation for the afternoon discussion. In between, I also handled client Huang Siqi's inquiry about the impact of the cryptocurrency market and provided professional advice.
location: Workstation, 17th floor, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Writing a weekly investment report and a cross-border REITs proposal.
description: Entered a state of deep work, opened the document and completed the "Market Review and Outlook" section of this week's investment weekly report. Then switched to the draft of the cross-border REITs plan and filled in the market environment analysis section, referring to the latest policies of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, and incorporating the vitality of township consumption observed while having breakfast at "Lao Liuji" yesterday, thinking about the opportunities for REITs in new urbanization.
location: Workstation, 17th floor, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Lunch and climbing gym course consultation.
description: Reschedule the original rock climbing trial class to the lunch break. Bring a homemade bento (steamed chicken breast, brown rice, cucumber salad), drive south along Xiangjiang Middle Road, turn onto Xianjiahu Road, and arrive at Yantu Climbing Gym on Xianjiahu Road, Yuelu District, in about 15 minutes. Quickly finish the bento in the resting area of the gym, then ask the front desk about course information. Learn that there is a 'zero-basic beginner class' every Wednesday evening, costing 199 yuan per session, including coach guidance and equipment. Decide on the spot to sign up for the Wednesday class and pay a deposit.
location: Yantu Climbing Gym, Xianjiahu Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Midday break and coffee time
description: Drove about 10 minutes from the climbing gym to Shangyin Coffee on Chaozong Street near the company, at 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District. Ordered a signature hand-drip “Citrus,” whose refreshing flavor dispelled the afternoon drowsiness. Sitting by the window, I opened my phone, synced this morning's work records to the memo, and flipped through photos from yesterday's camping, selecting 3 to share in the evening. At about 13:20, I walked 2 minutes back to the company.
location: Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street Branch), No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Work preparation and state adjustment
description: Returned to the office and steeped a cup of green tea. Used 30 minutes to distill the morning's observations of Lin Zhihao's account data and market information into concise bullet points, and placed them alongside my compiled notes on recent policy changes, fully preparing for the afternoon discussion with Zheng Wenbo.
location: Workstation, 17th floor, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Discussed market hotspots and research report planning with colleagues
description: Met with colleague Zheng Wenbo in the break room, and discussed the market hotspots observed in the morning. Mr. Feng asked him about the impact of the recent steepening of the bond yield curve on REITs product pricing, and Zheng Wenbo shared his exclusive views on the energy sector. After the discussion, they decided to work together next week on a research report on the 'domestic substitution' theme.
location: Pantry rest area, 17th Floor, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Work archiving and drafting/sending client emails.
description: Back at his desk, he began organizing the client meeting notes from last Friday. He filed the position adjustment confirmation documents and scanned meeting minutes for Huang Siqi and Lin Zhihao into the corresponding client folders in the CRM system. Based on the meeting notes, he drafted a follow-up email for Lin Zhihao summarizing today's account performance and recommendations. After checking, he sent the follow-up email to Lin Zhihao, handled several other accumulated emails, and updated the progress bar in the weekly work report. He saved the draft proposal completed today to the cloud and set a reminder for tomorrow morning. At 16:30, he shut down the computer and packed his backpack to leave work.
location: Workstation, 17th floor, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Driving home and shopping at the convenience store
description: Drove home, taking the Sanchaji Bridge across the Xiangjiang River to avoid the evening rush hour, taking about 50 minutes. On the way, remembered that the laundry detergent at home was used up, stopped at the Meilin Yingu International Community convenience store opposite the community (No. 344 Yinshuang Road), and bought a bottle of family-size laundry detergent and whole wheat bread for tomorrow morning's breakfast.
location: Hunan Province, Changsha City, Yuelu District, No. 344 Yinshuang Road, Meilin Yingu International Community Convenience Store

name: Dinner preparation and camping gear cleaning.
description: Back home, changed into loungewear. Laid out the camping gear brought back from Dawei Mountain (tent inner and outer fly, sleeping bag, ground pad) in a row on the balcony, carefully wiped the dirt off the bottom of the tent with a damp cloth, and left it to air. Then made dinner: pan-fried a piece of pre-marinated chicken breast with stir-fried vegetables and mixed grain rice.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Music relaxation and equipment storage
description: After finishing dinner, cleaned up the dishes. Back on the balcony, folded and stored the dried moisture-proof mat and sleeping bag. The tent was almost dry, so I put it away into the duffel bag. Turned on my phone to play relaxing jazz music, made a cup of tea for myself, and leisurely scrolled through today's financial news.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Video call with parents
description: Mr. Feng placed a video call to his parents. He first belatedly wished his mother a happy Mother's Day and asked if she had used the health pot to make yam cake. His mother smiled and showed the finished yam cake she had made that afternoon. Mr. Feng checked the diet diary his father had recorded and found that lunch had too much oil and salt, so he reminded them again. Finally, he asked his mother whether she had gone out for a walk today, and hung up with relief after receiving an affirmative answer.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Sharing camping photos and online interaction
description: Turn on the computer, import yesterday's camping photos and videos into Lightroom, quickly adjust colors, then select 9 favorite photos (including the morning mist, Dawei Mountain sea of clouds, and a three-person group photo). Send the photos to the "Camping Squad" WeChat group, and review camping fun moments online with Peng Yuqing and Xie Yutong, agreeing that this healing trip was remarkably effective. Also put the completely dried and stored tent back in the storage cabinet.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: CFA Level II Derivatives Study
description: Switched to study mode, sat down at the desk in the study, and took out the CFA Level II textbook Derivatives. Spent 90 minutes focusing on solving calculation and concept problems related to swap pricing and Greek letters (Delta, Gamma, Vega). When encountering a complex problem about the value of an interest rate swap, after looking at the explanation, made detailed notes in the mistake notebook.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Washing up and bedtime review
description: Finished studying, brushed teeth, washed face, changed into loose cotton pajamas. Briefly reviewed the day: work was efficient, climbing class booked, gear cleaned, feeling calm and content. Lying in bed, wrote tomorrow's to-do list in phone memo: send reply email to Huang Siqi, continue filling in the case analysis section of the cross-border REITs plan, and check in the evening whether my sister received the DJI Pocket. Set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning, turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning meditation, stretching, and healthy breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 6:30 a.m., full of energy. Did 10 minutes of mindful meditation on the yoga mat on the balcony, followed by 10 minutes of full-body stretching. description: Night fell, the campfire rose, and the firelight illuminated faces. Feng Haoran guided the conversation from camping anecdotes to life's confusions. He candidly shared recent work pressure and promotion goals, and used portfolio thinking to help Xie Yutong analyze the risk-reward ratio of changing jobs. Faced with Peng Yuqing's bottleneck in self-media, he suggested replanning from content positioning and user profiles. The three took turns confiding and offering advice until 11 p.m. Sparks crackled, and friendship quietly deepened under the starry night.
location: Zhurong Peak Camping Area, Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparations and goodnight diary.
description: At 22:30, the three of them worked together to completely extinguish and bury the campfire, ensuring there was no fire hazard. Feng Haoran checked all equipment and tent zippers. After a simple wash with wet wipes, he crawled into his sleeping bag, turned on his headlamp, and took out his notebook. In the dim light, he wrote down his thoughts for the day: "On the top of Mount Heng, talking with friends, wishing peace and health on the Dragon Boat Festival. I wish my family health." Photo attached: silhouettes of the three and the setting sun. At 23:30, accompanied by the chirping of cicadas and the wind in the mountains, he fell asleep contentedly.
location: Zhurong Peak Camping Area, Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province

name: Morning campsite pack-up and descent down the mountain.
description: In the faint morning light, the phone alarm rang on time. As the team leader, you immediately woke up Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing. The three of you had clear roles: you were responsible for dismantling and packing away the main tent, Xie Yutong organized the sleeping bags and ground mats, and Peng Yuqing quickly cleaned up the campfire ashes from last night and sorted and bagged the trash. You used the stove to boil water for instant coffee and oatmeal, and quickly had breakfast with compressed biscuits. At 7:00, you led the way down the mountain with weighted packs. The mountain air in the early morning was damp and cold, and the road was a bit mossy. You reminded your teammates to watch their steps. After nearly 2 hours of trekking, you arrived at the parking lot at 7:30 and loaded the gear securely into the trunk.
location: Campsite near Zhurong Peak on Mount Heng in Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province, and along the route to Xiling Parking Lot.

name: Drove back to Changsha, dropping off friends along the way.
description: You drove the vehicle and merged onto the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway from the Nanyue toll station. The drive was long, and Peng Yuqing suggested playing a folk song playlist from her phone. The three of you listened to the music while reminiscing about last night's campfire conversation. At 9:30, you stopped at Yancheng Service Area as planned, got out to stretch your legs, and bought three bottles of water and a lighter (as a backup) at the convenience store. At 10:40, following the navigation, you first took Peng Yuqing to Shouxing Street intersection in Kaifu District, Changsha, where she got out and waved goodbye. Then you turned onto Xiangzhang Road and dropped Xie Yutong off at the roadside on Xiangzhang Road, Yuhua District, Changsha at 11:08. You drove alone back to Yuelu District and arrived home at 11:10 at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road.
location: From Hengyang, Hunan Province to Changsha, via Yancheng Service Area on the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macao Expressway, Shouxing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Xiangzhang Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, and Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha.

name: Arrived home, rested, and reported safety.

You sighed with relief and called your mother, Li Xiuying, via video on your phone. On the screen, she saw that you looked tired but energetic, and after confirming you had arrived home safely, she didn't ask any more questions. After hanging up, you quickly took a hot shower to wash away the dust and fatigue. After changing into a dry T-shirt and shorts, you collapsed on the living room sofa, set a 40-minute alarm, and closed your eyes for a nap to help your body recover quickly.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

In Lightroom, you quickly browsed the camping photos, selected the 9 with the best light and composition, quickly color corrected them, and posted them to the three-person WeChat group "Hengshan Camping" with the caption "Done". The group immediately became lively. Feeling a bit hungry, you went to the kitchen and cooked a bowl of plain noodle soup, poached two eggs, and mixed a plate of cucumber salad. While eating, you scrolled through your phone, checking U.S. stock futures and post-holiday market sentiment.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

After shopping, you drove to a well-reviewed pet lifestyle store in Yuelu District that you had contacted earlier. With the staff's professional advice, you bought a litter box, cat litter, food bowl, water bowl, cat bed, scratching board, plus a bag of kitten food and a few small toys, spending 500 yuan in total. It sniffed the cat bed and food bowl, confirmed safety, then lay down next to the scratching post, occasionally looking up at you. You didn't disturb it, just muttered a few self-deprecating words softly, then returned to the living room, turned on the TV, and prepared for dinner, giving it a reassuring environment to adapt to.

After showering, I quickly finished breakfast: a glass of milk, two slices of whole wheat toast, and a boiled egg. Then I sat on the sofa and fully tested the band's blood pressure, heart rate, and sleep monitoring functions. After confirming it was running stably, I restored it to factory settings. I found a blank greeting card from the desk drawer, wrote Father's Day wishes in neat penmanship, reminding my father to take care of his health. I carefully packed the band, charging cable, and card into the gift box, then put it in a SF Express courier bag for later.

Then handled backlogged work emails: replied to client Lin Zhihao's questions about the position report, and replied to account manager Sun Xiaoya's email regarding account change needs. Subsequently opened the draft asset allocation plan for Lin Zhihao, and based on yesterday's market views, began to refine the specific allocation ratios and recommended targets in defensive sectors (utilities, consumer staples), with supporting analysis.

During the meal, you took out your tablet to open the draft of Lin Zhihao's proposal and discussed execution details with Zheng Wenbo, especially how to explain to the client the logic behind increasing defensive allocations and the timing of subsequent rebalancing. After receiving many suggestions, you returned to the office around 12:40. During the lunch break, you sent a WeChat message to your client manager in Shanghai, Cai Wenjing, asking about the tech sector trends and resources for your sister's job search. Then you leaned back in your chair and rested with your eyes closed for about 20 minutes.

I carefully recorded the key points relevant to my client proposals, and briefly exchanged views with colleagues after the meeting.

description: After changing into a quick-dry T-shirt and climbing pants, and packing his chalk bag and climbing shoes, he drove about 15 minutes to Daxi Climbing Gym in Lugu Sports Park. After a full warm-up, encouraged by Coach Lao Zhou, he challenged the classic blue V2+ route three times. He fell at the dynamic crux on the first two attempts; on the third attempt, after adjusting his center of gravity and footwork, he successfully grabbed the key hold and completed the route. Though his stamina had declined, his finger strength and route-reading had clearly improved. After training, about an hour later, he stretched and relaxed, and chatted briefly with a nearby climber about World Cup qualifying news. Then he drove home, arrived at 19:05, took a shower, and made a simple dinner: instant pasta with leftover broccoli chicken breast and a fried egg from the previous night. While eating, he saw a WeChat message from his father expressing anticipation that the band had been shipped.
location: The climbing gym is Daxi Climbing Gym inside Lugu Sports Park, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province; dinner is at home.

name: Evening relaxation and reflection

I picked up Baozi, the pet cat lying in the corner of the sofa, and gently scratched its chin while reviewing the day in my mind: the bracelet was shipped, the plan progressed smoothly, and there was a breakthrough in rock climbing. My thoughts also drifted to yesterday's argument with my younger sister Feng Xinran, and I decided I must handle it tonight.
location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

First read through the relevant worked examples in the textbook to understand the logic of parameter setting, then concentrated on doing 6 practice problems. The first 4 went smoothly, but on the 5th problem about early exercise of American options, I got stuck in the calculations. After repeatedly checking the formula and calculating twice on scrap paper, I finally sorted out my thinking.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

He added a sentence: "It was my fault yesterday. I was too eager to solve the problem and should have asked how you were first. Whether you want to talk about anything, or just need someone to listen to you vent, your brother is here." After taking a deep breath, he hit send. Seeing the 'Sent' notification, the weight finally lifted from his shoulders, and he felt relieved.

Used the Tide app for a 10-minute pre-sleep meditation, focusing on breathing and letting thoughts slowly settle. After meditation, took out the bedside diary and recorded the day's key events: morning run recovery, sending out the bracelet, plan breakthrough, climbing progress, more solid grasp of CFA, and sending an apologetic WeChat message to my sister. Then listed tomorrow's to-do items in the phone memo: follow up on Lin Zhihao's plan feedback, start writing the weekly report, and contact Cai Wenjing to see her reply. Turned off the bedside lamp, set the alarm for 6:30 a.m., and fell asleep peacefully and contentedly.

I listened patiently as my sister poured out her grievances over being laid off and her confusion and fear about transitioning to the CFA exam. I didn't rush to give advice, but offered empathy and unconditional support, saying that no matter what decision she made, I would be her strongest backing. The nearly 35 minutes of communication turned the relationship from tense to warm and substantively repaired it.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province
