name: Morning run.
description: The alarm went off on time, and I turned over and got out of bed. I changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and running shoes, drank a couple of sips of warm water, and headed out. It felt muggy, so I decided not to chase a specific pace. Starting from the neighborhood, I jogged along Shuangtang Road to the south gate of Yuelu Mountain, then turned back along Xinmin Road at the foot of the mountain, covering about 5.2 kilometers in total, with a steady pace of 06:58/km. Sweat quickly soaked my back, but after the run, my shoulders and neck felt a bit lighter. I stretched for 5 minutes at the neighborhood gate, focusing on the trapezius and shoulder blades, to make sure my cervical spine didn't "protest".
location: Along Shuangtang Road, Yuelu Mountain South Gate, and Xinmin Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Go home, wash up, and have breakfast
description: He came home sweating. The orange tabby cat 'Duoduo' crouched at the entrance, glanced at him, and lazily walked away. He took a hot shower and changed into dry loungewear. Breakfast was a quick combo: a bowl of hot milk with oatmeal, plus a boiled egg. While chewing, he mentally went through the calculation logic of 'duration' and 'convexity,' but resisted opening a book and kept a calm mindset.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Pre-exam preparation and review
description: Finally checked the exam "equipment": admission ticket, ID card, calculator (with new batteries), black pens, and a transparent file bag. Removed the printed formula cards from the binder, selected a few core ones (such as the Black-Scholes model and GIPS standards), and placed them on top of the file bag. Used the last 45 minutes to quickly go through the high-frequency mistake collection at the desk, eyes fixed on the page, fingers silently calculating on the desktop until ideas were clear.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Walk to the physiotherapy center
description: Left 10 minutes early. Exited from the east gate of the residential area, walked north along Shuangtang Road for seven or eight minutes, and arrived at the booked community physiotherapy center. Passed a breakfast stall on the way, with steaming hot air mixed with the smell of oil, but resisted buying anything, afraid that stomach discomfort would affect my condition.
location: Middle section of Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (along the way to Shuangtang Road Community Health Service Station).

name: Cervical spine physical therapy
description: Reported on time. The physiotherapist, Sister Sun, first assessed the range of motion of my cervical spine with manual techniques and said it had improved compared to last week. Next was 20 minutes of cervical traction (tension set to 6 kg), followed by alternating medium-frequency electrotherapy and ultrashort-wave hot compresses. While working, Sister Sun said, 'Xiao Feng, the strength of your neck and shoulder muscles is still a bit weak. When you go home, do more wall chin tucks and resistance band training; that will help support you.' I nodded and noted it down, feeling the tightness in my neck slowly melt away with the hot compress.
location: Physiotherapy room, Shuangtang Road Community Health Service Station, middle section of Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Exam sprint review.
description: After physical therapy, I walked home, boiled a kettle of water, and brewed a cup of light-roast Yirgacheffe with a pour-over pot, filling the room with floral and fruity aromas. I set my phone to Do Not Disturb, spread out CFA formula cards and a collection of wrong answers, and focused on tackling the big calculation problems in Fixed Income and Portfolio Management. While silently memorizing formulas, I quickly worked through calculations on scratch paper, trying to make the logical chains clearer in my mind. I still felt a bit tense, but I calmed myself with a 'follow the process' strategy.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Prepared and enjoyed a simple lunch.
description: Close the book and make yourself a light lunch: boil a small handful of buckwheat noodles, blanch broccoli and chicken breast, mix with a little light soy sauce and sesame oil, and pair with a glass of ice water. To keep your mind clear in the afternoon, resolutely avoid any oily or spicy food.
location: In the kitchen and dining room of the home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: WeChat communication with colleagues
description: While eating noodles, my phone vibrated with a WeChat message from Sun Xiaoya, a colleague in Hangzhou. She first asked about the progress of the project in Changsha, then shared photos of a community coffee shop she had recently discovered by the Qiantang River; the wooden decor looked very stylish. I picked up a chopstickful of soba noodles and typed back: "The project is on track, don't worry. That shop looks great! Next time you come to Changsha, I'll take you to a hidden gem I've personally scouted—it's tucked away, and I guarantee you'll get a nine-grid photo." The atmosphere was relaxed, a bit of interpersonal lubrication in the tense schedule.
location: Home dining room, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Lunch break and pre-departure check
description: Put away the dishes, leaned back on the sofa and closed my eyes to rest for 25 minutes, without setting an alarm. My internal wake-up clock is more accurate than any alarm. Woke up on time at 13:00 and felt much more refreshed. Took a deep breath, checked one last time the admission ticket and ID card in the document folder, confirmed the transportation route, and everything was ready. Today's goal: execute normally, not seeking to exceed expectations.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Go to the test center.
description: Left early and, at the entrance of the residential community, used an app to hail a ride-hailing car. After getting in, I lowered the window halfway to let the hot wind rush in, stopped thinking about any knowledge points, and instead put on earphones to listen to Beethoven's "Moonlight Sonata", trying to cool down my overactive cerebral cortex. The driver was very quiet and said nothing along the way. The ride took about 25 minutes and arrived at the exam entrance right on time at 13:48.
location: Yuhua District Examination Center, No. 27 Shuguang Middle Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province (during ride-hailing trip)

name: CFA Level I exam
description: Entered the examination room 10 minutes early and took the assigned seat. After the paper was handed out, I used a preset strategy: first scanned the entire paper and started with the questions I was most confident about (such as ethics and equity) to stabilize my composure. When encountering the complex duration calculation in fixed income, I first wrote the key formulas and logical framework on scratch paper, then worked through the calculation step by step. Although there were two comprehensive questions on alternative investments where my calculation stalled due to insufficient review depth, I tried my best to write down whatever process points I could earn. When time was up, as I stood up to hand in the paper, my palms were sweaty.
location: Standard Examination Room, Yuhua District Examination Center, No. 27 Shuguang Middle Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Post-Exam Discussion with Exam Peers
description: After walking out of the exam hall, under the big tree at the entrance, I met two young candidates who were also taking the CFA exam, looking like recent college graduates. We all smiled wryly at the same time, and then couldn't help comparing answers to a few key multiple-choice questions. One girl said, "I think I didn't choose well on the 'conflict of interest' question in the ethics section." I thought back and found that my choice was different from hers, and my heart skipped a beat. We added each other on WeChat and agreed that if we didn't pass this time, we would form a study group next time. I felt a bit heavy-hearted, after all, I estimated I was hovering around the passing line.
location: At the gate of Yuhua District Examination Center, No. 27 Shuguang Middle Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Commute back home
description: Took a taxi home. This time I picked a song by a post-rock band, leaned against the car window, and let the cityscape recede. When the car reached Xiangjiang Middle Road, the setting sun was shining through gaps in the clouds onto the river, creating a beautiful Tyndall effect. I took out my phone and snapped a photo—a small healing moment. The traffic was a bit heavy, and I got home in about 25 minutes.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (passing Xiangjiang Middle Road on the way back)

name: Physical and mental relaxation after the exam
description: I changed into loose loungewear and greeted Duoduo, who came up to me at the entrance. First, I collapsed onto the sofa and completely emptied my mind for 5 minutes, thinking of nothing. Then, I took out the fascia gun and deeply relaxed my shoulders, neck, thighs, and back muscles, and also did 10 minutes of yoga-style shoulder and neck stretches. While lying on the floor mat, Duoduo came over and nuzzled my cheek with its head. I scooped it up with one hand, held it with both arms, and listened to its 'purr, purr' sounds; my tense nerves finally relaxed.
location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Handle chores and contact close friends.
description: I took the thawed char siu and soft-boiled eggs out of the fridge. While waiting for the delivery, I replied to my close friend and stock-investing buddy Peng Yuwei on WeChat, telling her I had finished the exam today. She replied instantly: "I bet you'll definitely pass! If you don't, I'll treat you to three consecutive bowls of Japanese ramen until you're stuffed!" I smiled and replied with a "It's a deal" emoji. I then opened the food delivery app and submitted an order from a Japanese ramen shop I had saved for a long time.
location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Enjoyed Japanese ramen for dinner
description: The delivery arrived on time. Tonight's ritual was fully charged: rich tonkotsu broth ramen topped with thick-cut chashu, half a soft-boiled egg, and wood ear fungus strips. I opened the iPad, found a boring travel variety show as background sound, slurped the noodles, and completely emptied my mind, not letting a single study-related thought enter.
location: Home dining room, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening movie relaxation
description: To reward myself for getting through the day, I decided not to watch any financial news. I turned on the projector and picked an episode of the documentary “The Trading Room” about insider trading on Wall Street in the 1980s. But today was not about studying—just purely watching the plot and the actors' performances, focusing on those scheming characters. Duoduo jumped onto the sofa, curled up on my lap, and quietly kept me company.
location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

I sent the final photo to my photography partner Xu Jianing with the caption: 'The first shot to get my groove back after the exam. Don't you think the colors have a bit of that Wong Kar-wai vibe?' She quickly replied with a voice message: 'Solid! To be honest, the composition really has that vibe. Next time take me along for street shooting by the river.' We chatted briefly for five minutes about recent photography gear and exhibitions, feeling very pleased.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Bedtime prep and journaling
description: After washing up, changed into pajamas and lay down on the bed. Duoduo had already occupied the foot of the bed, lazily licking its paws. I couldn't help recalling the two big questions I didn't finish during the afternoon exam, and felt regret over the gaps in my review. I picked up the diary on the nightstand and seriously wrote a line: "I hope the grader is lenient and lets me pass." Then I opened the meditation app and did 10 minutes of guided mindful breathing, trying to clear my mind and calm my body.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Turned off the lights on time. Tomorrow I still need to handle work matters and call the client Huang Siqi, so I must ensure enough sleep. Today's exam consumed enormous mental energy, and I actually felt sleepy earlier than usual. Duoduo gave a soft purr in the dark, moved a little, and settled peacefully at my feet.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

Leaning against the headboard, he opened the school academic affairs system app and saw the green prompt of '60 points', finally relieved after three days of anxiety. He then pulled up the grade table for each subject, calculated the weighted average, took a screenshot and sent it to his sister Feng Xinran, joking 'Long live 60 points, I'll have to work hard in the second half of the year', and did 15 minutes of neck rehabilitation stretches. At 7:40, he went to the dining area, brewed instant coffee, and had it with whole wheat bread and boiled eggs for breakfast. During the meal, he contacted real estate agent Lu Jiaming via WeChat voice, confirmed the inspection of three retirement communities at 9 a.m. tomorrow, and asked him to send the route map and materials to his email.
location: Building 3, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Quarter, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (bedroom and dining room at home)

name: Cycling to visit Shangyin Coffee and learning pour-over coffee

At the shop he met Shen Xinyi, who was adjusting newly arrived Ethiopian coffee beans. Feng Haoran got straight to the point and asked about a pour-over starter kit. Shen Xinyi brought out a burr grinder, a pour-over kettle, and a V60 dripper, demonstrated the brewing technique, and explained water temperature and pouring methods. He listened carefully, recorded the key steps on his phone, and also took several close-up shots of the grinder's texture in natural light, then agreed to order through the link she sent.
location: No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (Shangyin Coffee, Chaozong Street Branch)

After arriving at the company office, he first poured a glass of ice water, then turned on his computer and handled work by priority: replying to client emails about market fluctuations, retrieving the NAV data of funds under key tracking, updating the Excel analysis model, and sending a notice to subordinates to revise next week's weekly report template.

The two also discussed the recent trend of the new energy sector in the A-share market, and the atmosphere was congenial.

After waking up, opened the e-commerce app on my phone, found the store recommended by Shen Xinyi, added a pour-over kettle, coffee grinder, thermometer and filter paper according to the list, chose express delivery to the company front desk, completed payment, order amount about 1,500 yuan.
location: 19th Floor, New Hunan Building, Section 1, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (company rest area)

Then he attended the department's H2 investment strategy conference call and made brief remarks. During the break, he saw a WeChat message from college classmate Wu Junjie, replied decisively that he was unavailable for a run on Sunday, and invited him to go climbing on Wednesday evening, treating him to Hunan cuisine to celebrate. The other party agreed.

location: Returned from Huatai Securities Changsha Furong Middle Road Business Department to Building 3, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (home)

After a total of 35 minutes of exercise, rest.
location: Building 3, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (living room at home)

I set scoring items for core dimensions such as geographical location, medical facilities, living environment, price, service items, and transportation convenience, ready to fill in on-site tomorrow.
location: Building 3, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (home study room)

Then he did 10 minutes of mindful breathing and set an alarm for 22:45. At 22:45, he turned off the lights, reviewed the next day's itinerary, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Building 3, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (home bedroom)

description: Feng Yuan set off from home at 6:30 a.m. and jogged to the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain to meet his running partner Gao Yunfei. They completed a 5 km morning run back and forth along Denggao Road, maintaining a cervical spine rehabilitation running posture while exchanging greetings and encouraging each other. Returned home at 7:25, did a 15-minute full-body stretch on the yoga mat on the living room balcony, then did 25 minutes of McKenzie therapy and elastic band shoulder and neck strength training, feeling significant improvement in cervical spine comfort.
location: Round trip from Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community (99 Shuangtang Road), Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, to Denggao Road at the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain

description: After morning exercise, took a quick shower and had breakfast at the dining room with oatmeal, milk, and boiled eggs. Meanwhile, shared morning run photos with younger sister Feng Xinran via WeChat. The sister complained about the hard work during the plum rain season in Shanghai, so Feng Yuan told her to take care of her health and arranged a video call next week. Also sent a voice message to his mother, telling her that the exam results had passed and asking her to rest assured. Afterwards, in the study, roughly classified stamp materials into "Republic of China", "Flowers", and "Animals" categories, marked them with sticky notes, and prepared for the stamp exhibition.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Inspecting two senior living communities
description: At 9 am, Feng Yuan met real estate agent Lu Jiaming at the entrance of Qixia Elderly Care Community (No. 579 Tongzipo Road), and inspected the community clinic, green spaces, and accessibility facilities, noting that the emergency response time was not clearly marked. They then drove to Fenglin Health Care Community (No. 169 Fenglin Third Road) to learn about its green channel with the Provincial People's Hospital and regular shuttle bus service. Throughout the visit, he took detailed photos with his phone and recorded notes in his memo, comparing the advantages and disadvantages of the two communities. Lu Jiaming also briefly introduced the surrounding second-hand housing market. At 11:30, the inspection ended, and Lu Jiaming drove Feng Yuan back to his residential community.
location: Qixia Senior Care Community, No. 579 Tongzipo Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province; Fenglin Health Care Community, No. 169 Fenglin Third Road

description: Back at the entrance of the residential complex, Feng Yuan picked up the box of the pour-over coffee equipment he had bought from the parcel locker. After going upstairs, he couldn't wait to open the box, checked that the pour-over kettle, coffee grinder, and other accessories were intact, and gave them an initial wash. For lunch, he microwaved frozen shepherd's purse and pork dumplings, and watched a pour-over coffee tutorial video shared by his friend Shen Xinyi while eating. After lunch, the sun was strong, so he drew the curtains and took a one-hour nap. During that time, he did not use his phone, keeping his eyes closed and fully relaxing.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Pour-over coffee practice and online help request.
description: After the lunch break, he started practicing pour-over coffee. The first time, he used the new grinder to grind Costa Rican beans. Pouring water at about 95 degrees caused over-extraction and bitterness; the second time, he adjusted the grind size and lowered the temperature to 93 degrees, but it was still astringent. After consecutive failures, he photographed the parameters and sent them to Shen Xinyi for help. Shen Xinyi pointed out that the grinder needed to be 'cleaned' and suggested a water temperature of 88-90 degrees. Following her advice, Feng Yuan simultaneously organized the photos of the elderly care community taken in the morning and entered them into the comparative evaluation form.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Successfully brewed coffee and shared it.
description: Following Shen Xinyi's guidance, Feng Yuan cleaned the leftover coffee grounds from the grinder, reground the beans, precisely controlled the temperature at 89°C with a thermometer, and poured water in a thin stream in circles. He deliberately slowed his pace to 7'00/km and did extra shoulder, neck, and core stretches after the run to activate his body and build up energy for rock climbing. He ran home at 7:00, took a quick shower, changed into a quick-dry climbing T-shirt and shorts, and carefully checked the gear bag he had prepared the night before, including a helmet, harness, climbing shoes, chalk bag, and 3-liter water bladder. He also confirmed that four bottles of sports drink and two energy gels were packed. Everything was ready.
location: Yuelu Mountain, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, and Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District.

name: Gather at the north gate and take a headcount.
description: Feng Haoran arrived promptly at the north gate of Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community at 7:10, where four climbing team members were already waiting. While chatting with them to confirm their status, he used his phone to urge the two latecomers. At 7:20, the last two members arrived. He gave a brief welcome and emphasized the day's route and time plan. At 7:30, all six members had arrived, the headcount was completed, and they were ready to set off.
location: North Gate, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drive to Heimifeng and explain the rock climbing plan
description: Feng Haoran drove the SUV, with coach Lao Zhou (Zhou Jianguo) in the passenger seat and six team members in the back seats, heading along Yuelu Avenue, via Furong North Road and Kaifu Avenue, toward Heimifeng National Forest Park. Along the way, Feng Haoran followed the navigation and briefly introduced today's climbing route, difficulty grading, safety regulations, and various time points. Lao Zhou added details on protection station setup and rope knot precautions. The atmosphere in the car was expectant and focused; Feng Haoran noticed the team members' positive state through the rearview mirror.
location: In Changsha, Hunan Province, on the way from Yuelu District via Furong North Road and Kaifu Avenue to Heimifeng National Forest Park in Wangcheng District

name: Heimifeng outdoor rock climbing, first half: group climbing
description: After arriving at the parking lot at the foot of Mount Heimifeng, Feng Haoran quickly organized everyone to sort out their gear and put on helmets. He divided the 8 people into two groups by experience level: he led the 3 more skilled team members (Chen Hao, Wang Lei, Liu Yang), and the remaining 3 team members (Zhang Wei, Li Qiang, Zhao Ming) were led by Coach Lao Zhou. Feng Haoran set a timer on his phone and strictly controlled the climbing time and rotation interval for each route, striving to complete the morning plan efficiently. Halfway through, two team members complained that the rest time was too short. He replied: 'Today's routes are all below 7A. This pace is both a challenge and a workout for you.'
location: Climbing Area, Heimifeng National Forest Park, Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha, Hunan

name: Summit rest, strategy adjustment, and lunch discussion
description: After completing the morning climbing goal, everyone rested at the pavilion on the top of Heimifeng Peak, replenishing water and energy gels. Feng Haoran noticed the atmosphere beginning to feel a bit oppressive. Coach Zhou handed him a bottle of water and said in a low voice, 'Haoran, ease up the pace a bit; some of the team members are finding it a little tough.' Feng Haoran nodded but inwardly stuck to his plan. He used his phone to take a silhouette photo of the team members under the rock wall and adjusted the afternoon climbing strategy. Then they had lunch under a tree at the summit. Feng Haoran had brought his own beef sandwich and energy bars, and he proactively exchanged insights with team members, especially asking the team member who had complained about insufficient rest (Li Qiang). The other avoided eye contact and only said, 'It's okay.' The lunch atmosphere was subtle.
location: Hilltop pavilion and under trees, Heimifeng National Forest Park, Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Second Half of Outdoor Climbing: Teammate Withdrawal and Activity Wrap-Up
description: The afternoon climbing continued. Just past halfway, the disheartened team members Zhang Wei and Li Qiang came directly to Feng Haoran and said, 'We can't take it anymore, we must go down early.' Feng Haoran felt anger rising inside, but seeing the exhaustion and dissatisfaction on their faces, he took a deep breath, nodded in agreement, told them to be safe, and watched the two go down the path. Coach Lao Zhou sighed from behind. After the two members withdrew, the remaining four were clearly low in morale. Feng Haoran forced himself to slow down, no longer urged them with a timer, and focused more on observation and protection. He actively belayed his teammates and shouted encouragement, but it had little effect, and the activity ended early in a gloomy atmosphere.
location: Climbing Area, Heimifeng National Forest Park, Qiaoyi Town, Wangcheng District, Changsha, Hunan

name: Coach's persuasion on the return trip, going home to rest, and apologizing to the community
description: Feng Haoran drove silently from Heimifeng back to the city center. Coach Zhou sat in the passenger seat. After passing the toll station, he finally spoke: "You lead the team very efficiently and with great responsibility, but some members can't be rushed. Next time, listen more to what they say." These words stung Feng Haoran, and he spent the ride reflecting on the controlling and forceful side of his ENTJ personality. After returning home, he first played with his cat Baozi using a feather wand for five minutes, then publicly apologized in the rock climbing group: "Everyone, today I was too tough on pacing and didn't fully accommodate everyone's feelings. I especially sincerely apologize to the two friends who left midway. In the future, I will adjust my leadership approach, listen more, and improve coordination." Later, he also sent earnest apologies to Zhang Wei and Li Qiang in private messages. Li Qiang replied "No worries," but Zhang Wei didn't respond.
location: On the way from Wangcheng District to Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, and at home in Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District.

name: Simple meal and a review of climbing lessons.
description: Not feeling like going out, Feng Haoran made a simple sandwich with eggs, lettuce, and whole wheat bread, and mixed a cup of protein powder for dinner. While eating, he wrote down today's reflection keywords on his notebook: “leadership, listening, rhythm, empathy”, and decided to treat this experience of leading the team to failure as an important growth opportunity.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Evening A-share market review and fund portfolio adjustment

Noting that the CSI 300 closed lower and northbound capital saw net outflows for several consecutive days, he focused on analyzing the mixed fund heavily weighted in consumer and healthcare stocks, and found that its recent performance lagged the index. He decided to reduce the monthly fixed-amount investment in that fund by 20% and use the new funds to continue the planned SIP in a CSI 300 index fund, in order to balance the portfolio's exposure. This rational decision helped him hedge against the emotional fluctuation caused by the failure in outdoor rock climbing during the day with "doing the right thing."
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

During this period, Gao Yunfei sent his morning running data; I replied with thanks and asked via WeChat for his views on the rental trends of office buildings in Shanghai's Hongqiao Business District. At around 11:00, I had a half-hour work handover with Zheng Wenbo, explaining in detail that Huang Siqi's agreement had been finalized, but he needed to follow up on the September 5 review reminder, and I transferred the relevant client communication records and rebalancing instructions through the internal system. Then I opened WeChat and saw that the payment deadline for the rock climbing camp was the day after tomorrow (the 28th). I decided to handle it in the evening and wrote a to-do in my notepad: On the 28th, remind parents to fast for their physical examination. Continued reviewing Lin Zhihao's company's financial statements for the last three months and highlighted suspicious fund flows with a highlighter.

Pan-fried the chicken breasts in two batches until golden brown on both sides, sealing in the juices. After letting them cool slightly, tightly wrapped each piece in plastic wrap, placed them in airtight food storage bags, and neatly stacked them in the freezer. On the subway, browsed stock market midday dynamics and confirmed the farthest exit for navigating to the hotel.
location: Beijing Capital International Airport Terminal 3, No. 1 Erwei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing to Crowne Plaza Beijing International Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Hotel check-in and gear arrangement
description: After arriving at the hotel, check in and request a quiet room. After entering the room, carefully take out the binder containing the 'Large Dragon Stamps', confirm the three layers of protection are secure, and place the camera, spare batteries, and charger on the desk.
location: Crowne Plaza Beijing International Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Lunch: Authentic Beijing fried sauce noodles
description: Walked to Haiwanju (Xiangyun Xiaozhen branch) near the hotel, ordered a bowl of signature fried sauce noodles, a serving of mustard cabbage, and a bottle of Arctic Ocean soda. While eating, browsed philately forum posts about this exhibition on the phone. After the meal, charged camera spare batteries at a nearby convenience store.
location: Haiwan Ju (Xiangyun Town Branch), Building 1, Courtyard No. 6, Antai Street, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Exhibition setup preparation.
description: Walk back to the hotel to pick up all equipment, then head to the China International Exhibition Center (Shunyi Hall). According to the exhibition hall guide map, find the personal booth in Hall A1. Carefully take out the 'Large Dragon Stamps' from the packaging, adjust the lighting angle to perfectly present the details of the stamps, hang up the personal introduction board, and organize business cards and brochures.
location: Hall A1, China International Exhibition Center (Shunyi Hall), No. 88 Yuxiang Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: First-day exhibition and in-depth exchange
description: The exhibition officially opened to the public. As an exhibitor, I warmly welcomed every visitor and introduced the condition, format, and collectible value of the 'Large Dragon Stamps' one by one. I used my camera to capture close-ups of the exhibits and the atmosphere of the venue. I exchanged business cards with two senior collectors and recorded in detail their collection directions and investment preferences, laying the foundation for future cooperation.
location: Hall A1, China International Exhibition Center (Shunyi Hall), No. 88 Yuxiang Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Organizing materials and work coordination.
description: After the first day of the exhibition ended, he returned to his hotel room. After a short rest, he opened his laptop to deal with the backlog of work emails from the morning, replied to client inquiries, and confirmed the time of Monday's online meeting. At the same time, he browsed the schedule of the next day's stamp exhibition sub-forums and marked the sessions he was interested in.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Evening rest and environment exploration
description: Putting on lightweight running shoes, I walked slowly on the newly built road near the hotel to loosen my legs, which were slightly stiff after standing for a long time, and enjoyed the coolness of Beijing's early autumn. Along the way, I photographed nice buildings and leaves as photography materials. Feeling I had good energy afterwards, I decided to jog for 20 minutes to gradually restore my morning running routine. I bought an electrolyte drink at a roadside convenience store to replenish fluids.
location: Around Crowne Plaza Beijing International Airport Hotel, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Dinner: light meal delivery
description: Considering the long evening talk ahead, I decided to order takeout at the hotel to keep up my energy. Through the food delivery app, I ordered a light salad and a serving of chicken porridge. While eating, I briefly sorted through the photos taken in the afternoon and copied the selected ones to my iPad.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Preparing to welcome an important guest
description: Tidied the room, prepared tea sets and glass cups, placed the exhibit photos taken that day and the "Large Dragon Stamps" on the coffee table, and waited for the arrival of collector friend Luo Zhenyu.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Had an in-depth talk with Luo Zhenyu about the stamp market
description: Luo Zhenyu arrived on time, and the two hugged warmly. Brewed a pot of Lapsang Souchong brought from Changsha, and both took out their treasured stamp albums. Feng Haoran displayed 16 carefully prepared Large Dragon stamps, while Luo Zhenyu shared several Red Revenue stamps he had recently collected. The two chatted about varieties, printing, and recent auction prices and market trends, with extremely in-depth exchange. Feng Haoran recorded part of the conversation on his phone as a memo.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Farewell and Late-Night Reflection
description: The long conversation was still not exhausted; after saying goodnight, Luo Zhenyu left. Feng Haoran tidied up the stamps on the table, recorded the core gains and potential investment opportunities from tonight's exchange in his notebook, and wrote down the day's reflections.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Pre-sleep preparation and falling asleep.
description: After washing up, I used the water flosser again for oral cleaning and checked my left calf to make sure there was no discomfort. I set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning, and finally turned off the lights and went to sleep feeling satisfied and a little tired.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Morning wake-up and morning run.
description: The phone alarm went off, and Feng Haoran woke up naturally. He first checked that the wound on his left calf had completely healed, then did some simple stretches to wake up his body. His thoughts calmed down from the lively conversation with Luo Zhenyu last night, and he quickly reviewed the core sales pitch for today's booth. He changed into running shoes and shorts, left the hotel, and jogged along Tianbei Road south to Huosha Road and back, at a pace of 6:30/km. In the cool morning air, he sorted through stamp market data and financial logic.
location: No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing, Crowne Plaza Beijing International Airport Hotel and the surrounding Tianbei Road and Huosha Road

name: Shower, dressing, and breakfast
description: After returning to the room to shower and freshen up, he changed into a neatly pressed dark blue suit jacket, white shirt, and dark trousers, and put a voice recorder, blank business cards, and materials on the Large Dragon stamps into his briefcase. He went to the second-floor buffet restaurant, got Western-style scrambled eggs, bacon, toast, and American coffee. While eating, he sent a WeChat message to Luo Zhenyu to confirm arrival time; the other party replied that he expected to arrive at the exhibition hall at 9:30. He then quickly browsed the morning news summary on the Bloomberg Terminal.
location: Crowne Plaza Beijing International Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Itinerary confirmation and departure
description: At checkout, confirmed luggage storage with the front desk, took out my phone to re-check the walking route from the hotel to the exhibition center, and marked the lunch alternative restaurant “Tidu TIDU Roast Duck (Xiangyun Town Branch)” on the map, then set off.
location: Lobby of Crowne Plaza Beijing International Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Move to the exhibition hall
description: Carrying a backpack with materials, I walked from the hotel to Hall E1 of the Shunyi Pavilion at the China International Exhibition Center, a distance of about 1.5 kilometers, taking 15–20 minutes. Along the way, I observed the collectors already gathering outside the exhibition hall and assessed the expected foot traffic level for today.
location: Along the route from No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing to No. 88 Yuxiang Road.

name: Booth arrangement and lighting setup
description: After arriving at the booth, put on white gloves, carefully take out the Large Dragon stamp, the centerpiece of the exhibition, from the portable moisture-proof box, adjust the angle of the acrylic display case to ensure the perforation details are clearly visible under the spotlight, and take photos to send to Luo Zhenyu to inform him that everything is ready.
location: Feng Haoran's booth, Hall E1, Shunyi Pavilion, China International Exhibition Center, No. 88 Yuxiang Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: In-depth exchange with fellow collector Luo Zhenyu.
description: Luo Zhenyu arrived as promised and went straight to the point. He carefully examined the perforations, paper, and color printing of the Large Dragon stamps with a high-magnification magnifier, praising their condition. Feng Haoran, based on the latest market transaction data, discussed the scarcity and risk-resistance of rare stamps from the perspective of alternative asset allocation, and shared Huatai Securities' internal art market analysis model, elevating the exchange to a professional financial investment dimension.
location: Feng Haoran's booth, Hall E1, Shunyi Pavilion, China International Exhibition Center, No. 88 Yuxiang Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Lunch: Taste Beijing cuisine and visit the exhibition
description: The two walked to Admiral TIDU Roast Duck Beijing Cuisine (Xiangyun Town Branch). Feng Haoran ordered the signature roast duck, Old Beijing minced pork noodle (zha jiang mian), and pea flour cake (wan dou huang), truly tasting authentic Beijing cuisine. During the meal, the conversation expanded from stamps to macroeconomics and the real estate market, and they chatted happily. After the meal, they returned to the exhibition hall, toured the premium area of other exhibitors together, took high-definition close-up photos of rare Qing Dynasty and Republic of China stamps, and took souvenir photos with fellow collectors in front of the exquisite booth.
location: TIDU Roast Duck Beijing Cuisine (Xiangyun Town Store) at COFCO Xiangyun Town, No. 9 Antai Street, Shunyi District, Beijing, and Hall E1, Shunyi Venue, China International Exhibition Center

name: Brief rest and information sync
description: After Luo Zhenyu temporarily took his leave, Feng Haoran returned to the booth to drink water and rest. He quickly browsed unread messages on his phone and replied to his family’s concerns, and outlined in his notebook the communication framework for the afternoon with potential client Zhang Haitao.
location: Feng Haoran's booth, Hall E1, Shunyi Pavilion, China International Exhibition Center, No. 88 Yuxiang Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Booth exchange and potential resource connections
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic at the booth increased noticeably. Feng Haoran proactively talked with collectors who stopped by, no longer focusing only on stamp varieties, but approaching from an asset allocation perspective, interpreting the scarcity, appreciation curve, and risk resistance of rare stamps in financial language. During this time, he noticed Zhang Haitao, who paced back and forth several times and had a sharp, capable demeanor.
location: Feng Haoran's booth, Hall E1, Shunyi Pavilion, China International Exhibition Center, No. 88 Yuxiang Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Met private equity partner Zhang Haitao.
description: Zhang Haitao stopped in front of the Great Dragon Stamp booth. Feng Haoran seized the opportunity and introduced it from a financial perspective: “The number in existence and scarcity of this stamp are similar to a high-quality growth asset in the primary market, with an annualized compound return of about 12% and extremely low correlation with the stock and bond markets, making it an ideal alternative asset.” Zhang Haitao was surprised. After exchanging business cards, the two chatted for 40 minutes at a small round table beside the booth, covering topics such as alternative investments and family office allocation, and agreed to have an in-depth phone discussion next Tuesday afternoon.
location: Small round table next to the booth in E1 Hall, Shunyi Hall, China International Exhibition Center, No. 88 Yuxiang Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Booth wrap-up and farewell
description: After seeing off Zhang Haitao, Luo Zhenyu also came to say goodbye. The two confirmed the dismantling time for tomorrow: at 10 a.m. tomorrow, Luo Zhenyu would arrive at the exhibition hall to help finish up, then take the high-speed rail back to Shenzhen. Feng Haoran began to tidy up his booth, carefully packing away the Large Dragon stamps, and said temporary goodbyes to neighboring exhibitors.
location: Feng Haoran's booth, Hall E1, Shunyi Pavilion, China International Exhibition Center, No. 88 Yuxiang Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Return to hotel and social media/contact organization
description: Walked back to the hotel to check in, took off the suit jacket and changed into a cotton T-shirt. Sat at the desk to organize the more than ten business cards received today and newly added WeChat contacts, managing each with tags. Specifically marked Zhang Haitao's contact details, and noted in the address book: 'Private equity partner, deep understanding of alternative asset allocation, highly relevant to my career direction, with potential cooperation opportunities. Suggest a phone call at 10:00 on Tuesday.'
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Evening walk and urban street photography
description: Take the Sony mirrorless camera and stroll into Tianzhu Old Street beside the hotel. In the afterglow of the sunset, adjust the aperture to capture satisfying street moments: the aunt haggling at the fruit stall, the old man playing chess, the sparrows resting on the power lines in the distance, using the lens to record the unique relaxation of Beijing autumn.
location: Tianzhu Street, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Light dinner and replenishment
description: On the way back from the walk, passed through Xiangyun Town and went to Subway, ordered a whole wheat turkey breast sandwich and a cup of hot black tea, and took them back to the hotel room. This way, I could handle work messages on the way back to the room and also avoid the awkwardness of dining alone in a restaurant.
location: Subway (Xiangyun Town Store), 5-103, F1, South Area, COFCO Xiangyun Town, No. 9 Antai Street, Shunyi District, Beijing, and Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport Hotel Room

name: Review today's accomplishments and brainstorm future strategies
description: Back in the room, he opened his laptop and created a new document titled 'Beijing Stamp Exhibition Review', recording in detail the key points of the exchange with Luo Zhenyu and Zhang Haitao's views on a certain technology stock fund. He also outlined the talking points for the phone call with Zhang Haitao next Tuesday, the core topic being how to incorporate rare stamps into the alternative investment basket of the family office.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Core strength training
description: He spread a bath towel on the floor and began core training: 4 sets of push-ups, 3 sets of planks, and 2 sets of squats. The exercise completely relaxed his mind, which had been tense from a full day of intense mental work.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Reading and organizing
description: After showering, I leaned against the headboard and continued reading the last two chapters of 'Nonviolent Communication', using a highlighter to mark skillful sentence patterns that could be used in client communication. Then I browsed the day's stamp close-ups and street photos in my phone album, selected 10, and did simple post-processing color grading with Lightroom mobile.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Diary review and tomorrow's planning
description: He took out his notebook and wrote a short diary entry with a fountain pen, recording the day's key gains and emotions: 'Exchanging ideas with Brother Zhenyu, our minds were in sync; meeting Zhang Haitao was the biggest surprise of this trip. The Beijing trip was all under control.' Then he clearly wrote down the next day's to-do list: wake up at 7:30, pack; go to the exhibition hall at 9:00 to help Luo Zhenyu dismantle the booth; leave the exhibition hall at 11:00 and head to Capital Airport; return to Changsha and rest in the afternoon.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: Put down the laptop, stood by the bed and did a simple five-minute yoga-style stretch to relax his stiff back and legs from sitting for a long time. Sent a message to his parents saying "Everything went well today", set the alarm for 7:00 in the morning, turned off the light and lay down. With the satisfaction of a fulfilling day and anticipation for future cooperation, Feng Haoran soon fell asleep.
location: Room at Crowne Plaza Beijing Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Hotel morning preparation and farewell.
description: Woke up at 7 a.m. in the hotel. After washing up, I checked the luggage and packaging materials for the exhibits, paying special attention to the wound on my left calf, which was healing well. Went to the restaurant for breakfast, ordered a bowl of zhajiang noodles, took a photo and sent it to my mother to let her know I was safe. After the meal, returned to the room and called Luo Zhenyu to thank him for last night’s sharing and say goodbye. Then packed my belongings and went to the front desk to check out.
location: Crowne Plaza Beijing International Airport, No. 60 Tianbei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Walk to the exhibition hall
description: Set out from the hotel and walked about 35 minutes to the Shunyi Pavilion of the China International Exhibition Center, reflecting on the dismantling process and precautions along the way; the morning air was cool.
location: In Shunyi District, Beijing, the walking section from Crowne Plaza Beijing International Airport to China International Exhibition Center (Shunyi Venue).

name: Exhibition teardown and business exchange.
description: After arriving at the booth, I began the meticulous dismantling work: carefully taking the three Large Dragon stamps out of the constant-temperature and constant-humidity display case, wrapping them in acid-free paper and putting them into a special rigid art tube, and checking the exhibit list and documents one by one. Near the end of the dismantling, private equity partner Zhang Haitao visited as promised. We had an in-depth exchange in the rest area, discussing from the allocation value of collectibles as alternative assets to the REITs market and macroeconomic strategies, exploring the possibility of cooperation, agreeing to participate in the year-end investment salon, and exchanging detailed contact information.
location: Booth and rest area, China International Exhibition Center (Shunyi Venue), 88 Yuxiang Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Simple lunch near the exhibition hall.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Haitao, I had a simple meal of beef noodles with a fried egg at a small Beijing-style restaurant near the exhibition hall. Then I bought bottled water and daily nuts at a convenience store as airplane snacks, while sorting out the upcoming itinerary and work plan.
location: A Beijing-style eatery and a convenience store near Yuxiang Road, Shunyi District, Beijing.

name: Going to the airport and working while waiting for the flight
description: Took a taxi to Terminal 3 of Beijing Capital International Airport. On the way, handled three client emails and previewed client Lin Zhihao's latest asset allocation plan for tomorrow, marking key data and risk exposure. After arriving, checked in. Because the flight was delayed by 2 hours, in the waiting hall I organized the key points from the exchange with Zhang Haitao into detailed notes, read the final chapter of Nonviolent Communication and reflected on client communication language, then selected stamp exhibition photos and sent them to Shenzhen photography partner Xu Jianing to discuss next month's outdoor shooting date.
location: Terminal 3, Beijing Capital International Airport, No. 1 Erwei Road, Shunyi District, Beijing

name: Caught up with alumni during boarding and the flight.
description: Boarding started at 19:40. After finding his seat, he ran into his college alumnus Liu Zhe, who is now a professional in cross-border M&A at a leading securities firm and was returning to Changsha to visit family. The two chatted happily, from memories of college courses to career development, exchanged views on the CFA exam, registration system reform, cross-border investment, and overseas markets, added each other on WeChat, and agreed to keep each other updated on industry information. The flight landed in Changsha at 22:00.
location: Inside the cabin of flight CA1363 from Beijing to Changsha.

name: Arrived in Changsha late at night, contacted running friends.
description: The plane landed at Changsha Huanghua International Airport; after picking up luggage, he took a taxi home. On the way, he sent a WeChat message to running buddy Gao Yunfei, letting him know that he had arrived in Changsha and his wound had healed, and agreed to resume a 3-kilometer slow jog at the south gate of Yuelu Mountain at 6:30 the next morning.
location: On the way from Changsha Huanghua International Airport, No. 308 Airport Avenue, Changsha County, to Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District.

name: Home rest and diary review
description: Arrived home late at night, packed a few things, and stored the Dalong stamps properly. After washing up, he sat at his desk and wrote in his diary, summarizing the gains from the Beijing trip: the exchange with Zhang Haitao opened an alternative investor network channel; the chance reunion with Liu Zhe on the plane laid the groundwork for future business; reading 'Nonviolent Communication' boosted his confidence in communication; he decided to resume morning running the next day and restart his daily rhythm. He turned off the light and went to sleep near midnight.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Morning run and stretching exchange
description: Got up at 5:30 to prepare, drank warm water, and checked that my ankle was fine. At 6:00 I drove to the east gate of Yuelu Mountain on time and met up with running friend Gao Yunfei. After a warm-up jog of 3 km at a 7 min/km pace, I focused on feeling my left calf for feedback, and the wound was completely normal. After the run, I did 5 minutes of static stretching in the east gate plaza, focusing on relaxing my calves and Achilles tendon. I chatted with Gao Yunfei about the latest news of his yacht club, and casually mentioned that he should call me for the next event, leaving an option for weekend relaxation. At 7:00 I drove home, ending the morning exercise.
location: Yuelu Mountain East Gate Square, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Shower, breakfast, and chores
description: After arriving home, I quickly took a shower and changed into the shirt and dress pants prepared in advance. Breakfast was quick: oatmeal with boiled eggs. At the same time, I threw the two shirts brought back from Beijing into the washing machine and set the cycle. Before leaving, I checked again that the grip strengthener was in my sports bag, ready to go to the gym directly in the evening.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Commute Study and Magazine Purchase
description: Left on time by car at 7:30 for work, listening to financial radio on the way, focusing on expectations for the Fed's interest rate decision. Passing near Kaifu Temple, made a brief stop at a roadside newsstand and bought the latest issue of China Business Network (CBN) magazine, planning to browse it during lunch break.
location: On the way from 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China to Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District

name: Morning market review and preparation
description: Arrived at the office before 8 o'clock and brewed a cup of hot tea. Logged into the market terminal and quickly browsed global market movements from last night to this morning: the three major U.S. stock indices showed mixed gains and losses, and the A50 futures index fluctuated slightly. Recorded the levels of the targets of interest, detailed the morning operation tasks, listed key stocks to watch and position adjustment ideas, and prepared for the morning meeting.
location: Huatai Securities Kaifu District Office, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China.

name: Department morning meeting
description: Attended the department's regular morning meeting. Colleague Qian Yongqiang highlighted the need to pay attention to changes in the flow of funds through the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect next week. I briefly shared observations from the philatelic exhibition I attended during last week's business trip regarding alternative investment trends, and everyone discussed for a few moments. The morning meeting ended at around 9:30.
location: Large conference room, Huatai Securities Kaifu District Office, Area C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Execute systematic fund investment and purchase insurance.
description: Returning to my desk, I logged into the Huatai Securities app, went to the fixed-investment management page, and manually executed a monthly fixed investment of 3,000 yuan in the CSI 300 index fund and 2,000 yuan in the technology theme fund. After verifying the amounts were correct, I confirmed. Then I opened the insurance platform, gave the comprehensive accident insurance I had compared last week a final review, confirmed that paying 1,200 yuan annually offered the best value for money, and decisively placed and paid for the order.
location: Workstation at Huatai Securities Kaifu District Office, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Organize retirement community materials and preliminary trip exploration.
description: Compile all the WeChat chat records, photos, and reflections from the two senior living communities that the parents inspected at the beginning of the month into an Excel spreadsheet. Score and compare them based on dimensions such as geographic location, medical facilities, dining rating, activity richness, and cost structure, and include screenshots. At 11:40, generate a PDF and send it to the parents via WeChat. In the family group, leave the message: "Take a look first; we'll video chat in detail at 8 PM." Then search for the names and addresses of mainstream senior living communities in Wuhan, save the introductions, and create a memo in the phone calendar: "December: Visit senior living communities in Wuhan."
location: Workstation at Huatai Securities Kaifu District Office, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Lunch with Zheng Wenbo
description: When the lunch break bell rang, I went downstairs with colleague Zheng Wenbo to Wanda Plaza for lunch. We ordered shredded pork noodles with pickled mustard greens and a portion of soup dumplings. Zheng Wenbo asked about my experience at last week's stamp exhibition, and I shared my experience of meeting Zhang Haitao, who deals in alternative investments, and schoolmate Liu Zhe. He joked, 'You collectors really live in a different world,' and I replied, 'Actually it's the same logic as asset allocation—it's all about long-term value judgment.'
location: Soup Dumpling Shop, 3rd Floor, Zone C, Wanda Plaza, 589 Zhongshan Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Coffee socializing and afternoon nap
description: While walking back to the office after lunch, passed by Shangyin Coffee Shop on Chaozong Street. The owner, Shen Xinyi, was watering potted plants at the door. Went up to say hello and chatted for two minutes, agreeing to come another day to taste her newly arrived coffee beans. After returning to the office, rested with eyes closed at the desk for 15 minutes to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street Branch), No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Process emails and prepare video materials
description: Organized the materials related to Xie Yutong on the desktop, opened the screen-sharing software in advance, and also opened the previously searched Sichuan-Tibet route materials, camping equipment list, and several self-driving guide documents to ensure efficient communication in the afternoon. Then handled client emails, replying to a client who inquired about overseas asset allocation with preliminary views and suggestions, and agreed to have a deeper discussion on Friday.
location: Workstation at Huatai Securities Kaifu District Office, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Video call with Xie Yutong and register for yoga
description: At 2 p.m., Xie Yutong's video call connected on time. We first chatted for half an hour about her recent relaxing course experience at a yoga studio in Yuhua District, and she strongly recommended I try it too. After thinking it over, I decided to sign up for the evening class on September 18 (Thursday), and asked for the studio name and course link. Then she shared her screen for the "National Day Sichuan-Tibet Self-Drive Trip," and we discussed the camping spots along the standard National Highway 318 route section by section, reaching a consensus: I would be responsible for route planning, and she would handle camping spots and camera positions. Before the call ended, she said, "Finally we can go out together again," and I replied, "Yeah, the gifts of nature owed from the first half of the year are due to be repaid." After the call, I immediately logged into the yoga studio website, selected the 7:30 p.m. course on September 18, completed payment, and sent her a screenshot of the successful registration for confirmation.
location: Workstation at Huatai Securities Kaifu District Office, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Handling work emails and drafting a communication outline
description: Handle current client emails and proposals. Then spend 30 minutes opening the mind map to organize the key points for tomorrow afternoon's phone call with Zhang Haitao, list several core arguments analyzing the value of stamps from a financial perspective, and prepare a few questions to ask him. In the middle, there was a financial product promotion call; I declined politely.
location: Workstation at Huatai Securities Kaifu District Office, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Commute home from work and pickup
description: Packed up the desk and left work at 17:30 sharp. First drove, stopping by Aoshiguang Gym on the way to pick up the temporarily stored finger exerciser. After confirming it was correct, I put it into the backpack, then drove directly back home in Yuelu District, arriving at the community parking lot at about 18:10.
location: On the way from Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, China, via Aoshiguang Gym, to No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District

name: Dinner and evening preparation.
description: After arriving home, he changed into comfortable loungewear. He cooked a simple bowl of soba noodles with a few greens and a fried egg. After the light dinner, he cleaned up the kitchen. After the meal, he browsed 'Nonviolent Communication' in his study and was deeply moved by the chapter on 'empathic listening'. Then he used sticky notes to write down a three-point outline for the call with his parents to ensure efficient communication in the evening. He took the grip strengthener out of his bag and arranged it neatly to prepare for the evening training. He opened the PDF comparing retirement communities for his parents once more to confirm it was correct, adjusted the video software to the optimal settings, and waited for the 20:00 call to connect.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, China

name: Video call with parents and meeting notes organization
description: At exactly 8 o'clock, I made the video call. My mother answered first, and my father came over shortly after. I walked through the retirement community comparison table and shared my idea: “Dad, Mom, it doesn't have to be fixed at one place. In autumn and winter, Wuhan is cold but Dad has many friends there; in spring and summer, Changsha has a better climate and it's more convenient for me to visit. How about we consider the dual-city model?” My father was silent, and my mother was reluctant to part with her old colleagues, but after an hour of discussion, we finally reached a consensus: at the end of the year, I will first return to Wuhan to inspect local options, and then decide whether to start the dual-city model. As soon as the call ended, I immediately organized the three agreed points into text and sent it to the “Family Group” and @mentioned my parents, and also marked “December, inspect retirement communities in Wuhan” in my phone calendar.

Decided to make this short sequence a fixed part of my bedtime routine.

On the final kilometer, Feng Haoran accelerated and sprinted as planned, finishing at a 4:30 pace. After the run, they did 10 minutes of deep stretching at the observation deck. Gao Yunfei suggested trying interval training next week, and Feng Haoran noted it in his memo. At 06:50, he drove back along the same route to his home in Meilin Yingu Community, arriving at 6:55, and placed his running shoes and sweaty clothes in a ventilated area.

With everything ready, I prepared to go out.

description: After changing into climbing shoes, he did 30 minutes of low-difficulty traversing and dynamic stretching in the gym's warm-up area, focusing on mobilizing his shoulder joints and fingers. Then he attempted pull-ups: after taking a deep breath, he completed 2 standard reps in a row—his first breakthrough in years. Feng Haoran suppressed his excitement and cheered inwardly. At 09:00, the broadcast called contestants to gather. While doing final hand-shake relaxation, he carefully studied the layouts of the V2 and V3 routes, mentally rehearsing footwork and force application sequences, his mindset shifting from excitement to focus.
location: Warm-up area, Rock Walker Climbing Gym, Building B, Lugu Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship Park, 1698 Yuelu West Avenue, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Rock climbing competition and post-competition exchange
description: When the competition started, Feng Haoran chose a V2 overhang route. He missed the final hold on the first two attempts; on the third attempt, he adjusted his footwork and stabilized his center of gravity, completing the climb smoothly, drawing applause from the other climbers in his group. With increased confidence, he challenged a V3 route, but fell off twice at the middle crux due to insufficient core strength. After his muscles were exhausted, he gave up and realized that core strength remained his weakness. After all events concluded, he ranked 15th out of 40 climbers, a decent performance in the amateur group. After the competition, he proactively talked with several climbers who had completed V3 routes. They pointed out that his shoulder and back force generation could be optimized and demonstrated several resistance band exercises to strengthen the rotator cuff. He decided to join the Advanced Training Camp every Sunday evening.
location: Rock Walker Climbing Gym, Building B, Lugu Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship Park, No. 1698 West Yuelu Avenue, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province - climbing routes and rest area

location: Study room in the home, Building 7, Meilin Yingu Residential Community, Yin'an Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Evening preparation and sharing preview
description: At 18:30, when he returned home, Feng Haoran first turned on the computer in his study, systematically organizing his recent collection of Kyoto street photography along the three dimensions of “composition, light and shadow, and color.” He selected five representative works and saved them as screenshots. Then he posted a notice in the Changsha Photography Association WeChat group: “Tonight at 21:00, I will share the Japanese street photography composition techniques I have summarized. Welcome to discuss.” From 19:30 to 20:00, he briefly reviewed today's tactical mistakes in the rock climbing competition to mentally prepare for signing up for the “Advanced Training Camp.”
location: Study room in the home, Building 7, Meilin Yingu Residential Community, Yin'an Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Photography analysis, online sharing, and review
description: At 20:00 it officially started. Feng Haoran created a new note document and placed the five works into three categories: "white space", "contrast", and "line guidance". He analyzed each one: the multi-layered lines of the Kyoto alley, the contrast between the red umbrella and the gray wall at the temple gate, and the depth and white space of the torii. Comparing these with the night view of the Xiangjiang River he shot last week, he found that he was still lacking in line guidance and recorded the key points. At 21:00 he sent the prepared example images to the group on time and began explaining, starting with "white space", emphasizing that large areas of sky or water can create a sense of tranquility, and showed his imitation comparison image of the Xiangjiang night scene. Then he talked about "contrast" and "line guidance". The group members responded enthusiastically; someone immediately uploaded a photo of Taiping Street for advice, and he patiently pointed out how to strengthen the lines through post-cropping. At 21:40 the sharing ended. He returned to his notebook and wrote down today's keywords: "rock climbing breakthrough, photography sharing, morning run with friends", and outlined his initial plan after advancing to the advanced training camp: focus on core strength and finger strength every week.
location: Study room in the home, Building 7, Meilin Yingu Residential Community, Yin'an Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

At 11:30, I proactively contacted client Lin Zhihao, informed him that his asset allocation optimization plan had been fully implemented, and explained the fund logic and expectations. At the same time, I quickly replied to two clients' email inquiries about market conditions, confirming there were no urgent issues.

Referencing the Tokyo and Kyoto works collected in my phone, I used a table to summarize their characteristics: Tokyo’s “high saturation, motion blur, vintage feel” and Kyoto’s “low saturation, framed composition, serene feel,” preparing to use this as a basis for drafting a framework for a WeChat official account article.

When the lights came on, the effect was excellent, and Shen Xinyi was full of praise for Feng Haoran's professionalism.

Then they moved on to the differences between Chinese and Japanese street photography styles. Xu Jianing suggested combining Japanese composition with Changsha's vibrant everyday life to make it more unique.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

Checked the weather forecast and saw it would be sunny on Saturday. In the phone's notes app, I planned a two-day self-driving trip: depart in the morning, do test shots at service areas along the way, arrive at Nanyue Hengshan before noon, and hike up the mountain in the afternoon to photograph the sunset. After that, I did 25 minutes of deep stretching with yin yoga in the living room, focusing on relieving tightness in the back of the thighs and the neck and shoulders.
location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

description: During stretching, I reviewed the day in my mind: the tempo run went well, work was efficient, the photos were perfectly hung on the wall, the MBA course was rewarding, and a self-driving trip plan had begun to take shape. I felt fulfilled and satisfied. After washing up, I set the alarm for 5:30 on Saturday and reminded myself to add a vaccine reminder for Mom to the calendar tomorrow. At 23:00, I turned off the lights and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

Perform high-intensity interval training: complete 5 sets of 800-meter interval runs at a pace of 4'50" per kilometer, with a 400-meter jog as recovery between sets, totaling 8 kilometers. Finish training at 07:00, then do 15 minutes of deep stretching by the track, focusing on loosening the calves and hips, to build up cardiovascular and leg strength for tomorrow's trip to Hengshan.
location: Rubber track at the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, No. 58 Denggao Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

location: Underground parking garage, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province
