location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: Finished washing up and lay in bed. Took one last look at tomorrow's sunrise time forecast for Mount Heng, set the 5:00 alarm, turned off the phone screen, and fell asleep 15 minutes later, looking forward to tomorrow's light and shadow.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Early Morning Wake-Up and Final Preparations
description: The alarm went off on time. I quickly washed my face with cold water to wake up, went to the kitchen and made a cup of black coffee, and drank it with two slices of whole wheat bread as a simple breakfast. In my mind, I went over today's shooting route and equipment list one last time: camera, tripod, hardshell jacket, trekking pole, first aid kit, two energy bars, and 1.5 liters of water. After confirming everything was ready, I loaded the camera bag into the trunk of the SUV.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (bedroom, kitchen, entryway)

name: Self-drive to Mount Heng
description: Drove out of the community underground garage at 04:35. The sky was still dark, and there were few vehicles on the expressway. Engaged adaptive cruise control and drove at a constant speed of 110 km/h. At 06:15, refueled at Xiangtan Service Area and took a short 10-minute break, getting out to stretch and using my phone to confirm the scenic area's opening hours. At 06:50, following the navigation prompts, the car smoothly exited the Nanyue Expressway toll station.
location: Starting from the basement garage of Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, via Yuelu Avenue, Jinggang'ao Expressway, and Nanyue Expressway, arrive at the visitor center parking lot of Mount Hengshan Scenic Area, Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province.

name: Arrival and preparation for the first stop shoot
description: At 07:00, successfully parked the car in the visitor center’s underground parking lot. I carried a photography gear bag weighing about 12 kg and brought hiking poles. In the parking lot, I quickly confirmed the boarding point for the scenic area’s eco-shuttle and the walking route to Nanyue Temple.
location: Tourist Center Parking Lot, Nanyue Hengshan Scenic Area, Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province

name: Humanistic photography: Morning light and incense at Nanyue Grand Temple
description: Walked about 10 minutes to reach Nanyue Temple, catching the first wave of morning pilgrims. Morning light passed through the flying eaves and dougong brackets, casting dramatic light and shadow on the devout worshippers. I set up a tripod and used slow shutter speed to capture the temple silhouette wreathed in incense smoke, and also used an 85mm prime lens to snap close-up shots of several devotees' expressions as they offered incense. This was the first satisfying shooting subject of the day.
location: Nanyue Grand Temple, No. 2 Beizhi Street, Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province.

name: Mountain Climbing Creation: From Halfway Pavilion to South Heaven Gate
description: At 08:30 I took the scenic eco-bus to the Mid-hill Pavilion stop. After getting off, I started hiking upward. Morning mist drifted among the trees, Tyndall light pierced through the leaves, and I switched to a wide-angle lens to capture the melody of light and shadow. At 10:00 at the Mid-hill Pavilion rest stop, I met a mountain porter carrying heavy goods. With his consent, I quickly used the 70-200mm telephoto lens to capture his knotted muscles and resolute eyes. This photo will become one of the most story-driven works of the day.
location: Nanyue Hengshan Scenic Area, Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province (hiking trail from Banshan Pavilion to Nantianmen)

name: Summit and landscape creation: Clouds and rocks of Zhurong Peak
description: Continuing upward along the stone steps, at 10:50 I reached the vicinity of Nantianmen, where clouds began to surge in the valley, extremely spectacular. At 11:15 I arrived at Zhurong Peak, where the sea of clouds fully spread out. I searched for multiple camera positions and used a wide-angle lens to shoot dozens of photos combining the sea of clouds with ancient buildings, and also tried slow shutter to express the motion of drifting clouds.
location: Zhurong Peak Observation Deck, Nanyue District, Hengyang, Hunan Province.

name: Light mountaintop refreshment and ideation
description: He walked to the Wangritai Teahouse beside Zhurong Peak and sat down, ordered a cup of local cloud mist tea, and while sipping it, looked through the photos in his camera (over 260 shots in RAW format). He opened his notebook and quickly wrote down the creative framework for the 'Mountains and Letters' series: using the mountain stone steps, clouds and mist, and ancient trees as 'letter paper,' and the moments captured through light and shadow as 'handwriting.' At 12:25, he ate an energy bar to replenish his strength, saving energy for the creative work on the way down the mountain.
location: Wangritai Tea House, Zhurong Peak, Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province

name: Downhill creation: dialogue between light and shadow and the ancient path.
description: At 12:30, I chose the ancient path with fewer tourists, "Fanyin Valley", to go down the mountain. The afternoon sunlight pierced through the dense forest, creating strong light beams on the stream and moss. At 13:30, I passed the Nanyue Martyrs' Shrine, stopped for ten minutes to learn about its history, and took wide-angle shots of its solemn and majestic interior.
location: From the Fanyin Valley Ancient Trail to the Martyrs' Shrine, Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province.

name: Return transportation and brief rest
description: At 14:00 took the scenic area eco-shuttle down the mountain, and returned to the parking lot at 15:00. Rested briefly at the parking lot, replenished water, and synced today's hiking data (about 12 kilometers, elevation gain 1,300 meters) to the mobile fitness app.
location: Nanyue Hengshan Scenic Area, Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province (Environmental shuttle and visitor center parking lot)

name: Dinner: Savoring local flavors
description: Drove 2 minutes to the 'Hengshan Renjia' farmhouse restaurant recommended by Dianping. Ordered a serving of Hengshan tofu and smoked bamboo shoots stir-fried with cured meat, plus a bottle of iced mineral water. Sat in the courtyard enjoying the tranquility at the foot of the mountain, reflecting on today's itinerary. During the meal, I quickly glanced at the A-share closing data on my phone and replied to client Lin Zhihao's brief inquiry about next week's market strategy. Finished the meal at 16:10.
location: Hengshan Renjia Farmhouse Restaurant, Jinsha Road, Nanyue District, Hengyang City, Hunan Province (about a 2-minute drive from the Nanyue Hengshan Scenic Area Visitor Center)

name: Return drive
description: Departed back to Hunan at 16:20. The return route was the same as the way there. At 17:30, I rested for 10 minutes at Yancheng Service Area and washed my face. Then, while driving, I had a 15-minute phone call with my mother via Bluetooth, told her the trip went smoothly, and reminded her again about the gastroscopy follow-up early next month. At 19:10, I smoothly drove into the community basement garage.
location: Return from Hengshan Renjia Farmhouse Restaurant, Jinsha Road, Nanyue District, Hengyang, Hunan Province to Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, via the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway

name: Photo import and post-processing
description: After returning home and showering, I entered the study at 19:30. I imported 320 RAW photos from the SD card into Lightroom, removed blurry and unusable shots, and selected more than 80. According to the four themes of 'Morning Temple', 'Light Forest', 'Cloud Peak', and 'Mountain People', I cropped, adjusted tones, and locally sharpened 20 of them. At 20:30, I opened the layout software, arranged these 20 works into an electronic photo album titled 'One Day at Hengshan and the Cloud Stone Book', and wrote a short shooting note for each photo.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Online sharing and in-depth exchange
description: At 21:00 exported the photo album as a PDF, and created 4 nine-grid selected photos to post to the Changsha Photography Association WeChat group and Moments. Immediately received dozens of likes and comments. The exchange with fellow photographer Xu Jianing from Shenzhen was especially in-depth; I shared the parameters of the 'mountain porter' photo (1/125s, f/2.8, ISO 800) and the shooting background, and gave her some suggestions on line guidance for her street photography compositions. At 21:50 the conversation gradually cooled down.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: File archiving and planning for tomorrow
description: Spent 15 minutes archiving today's RAW footage, selected files, and the album I made to an external hard drive and OneDrive cloud drive respectively. Also checked the climbing gym notice, confirmed there is a monthly competition next Sunday, and planned tomorrow's (Sunday) morning run with Gao Yunfei — a long-distance endurance run to prepare for next month's half marathon.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Yoga stretching and body recovery.
description: Changed into workout clothes and came to the yoga mat in the living room. Did 15 minutes of active stretching, focusing on relaxing the tight calves, quadriceps, and hip flexors after the hike. Finished with 5 minutes of abdominal breathing to calm the heart rate.
location: On the yoga mat in the living room of Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed.
description: After taking a hot shower, changed into pajamas. At 23:00, lay down on the bed, turned off the bedside lamp, and set the alarm for 7:00 tomorrow. At 23:15, while savoring today's sea of clouds on Zhurong Peak, gradually fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Early morning wake-up and pre-run preparation
description: At 6:45 in the morning, Feng Haoran woke up in his bedroom in Jinxing Residential Community, Yuelu District. The soreness in the back of his thighs reminded him of the intensity of yesterday's hike on Mount Heng. He checked the heart rate monitoring data on his phone and confirmed it was suitable for aerobic recovery training, then decided to start the tempo run on time. After getting up, he put on quick-drying clothes and running shoes and did some simple joint warm-ups. At 7:00, he left home and walked to the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain, using this about 15-minute walk as a pre-run warm-up. The community was quiet in the early morning, with occasional birdsong.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province to East Gate of Yuelu Mountain

name: Morning run: 8 km tempo run and return
description: After arriving at the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain, Feng Haoran did a light stretch and officially started running at 7:20. He ran an 8-km tempo run along the mountain ring road, with a stable pace of about 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. When he reached the 5th kilometer, the fatigue in the back of his thighs increased, and he took out an energy gel from his waist pack to replenish. The last 2 kilometers he slowed down to a 7:30 pace as a cool-down, and finished before 8:00. After the run, he did a 10-minute targeted stretch for the quadriceps and hamstrings on a bench at the foot of the east gate, and the tightness was significantly relieved. Then he walked home slowly, opened the sports app along the way to record the running data, and felt satisfied with his recovery.
location: Yuelu Mountain Ring Road and the area near the East Gate, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Shower, high-protein breakfast, and preparation of materials for the promotion interview
description: Back home, Feng Haoran took a warm shower and changed into loungewear. Still sitting at the dining table while eating, you used your phone to check Weibo updates, replied to netizens' questions about encrypted USB drives and remote data wiping, and agreed with a comment suggesting adding a step to "lock the phone account on the computer side", deciding to add it to a later article.
location: No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community

name: Photography equipment check and physical warm-up
description: After breakfast, you spread out your full set of photography equipment on the living room coffee table, carefully checked the condition of the Canon 5D4 body and three lenses, confirmed all battery levels, cleaned the lenses, and formatted the memory cards. You then packed spare batteries and a dual charger into the camera backpack. After that, you did 15 minutes of core strength training and leg stretches to build up stamina for a full day of standing shooting.
location: No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community

name: Coordinating the café event and departure preparations
description: You checked the camera bag again and confirmed everything was ready. Then you messaged Zheng Wenbo to confirm the pick-up time, and Zheng Wenbo instantly replied OK. You then communicated with Xu Jianing via WeChat, discussing that because the wedding ended late, you couldn't go together to Chaozong Street to shoot night scenes, but you could take street-style shots of the café along the way, and you agreed to call at 10 p.m. to discuss the details of the 'Autumn Limited' event. After making arrangements, you changed into black casual pants and a dark gray polo shirt, ready to drive.
location: No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community

name: Drove to pick up colleague Zheng Wenbo
description: You set off from home on time and drove to Gaoling Community in Furong District to pick up your colleague Zheng Wenbo. Along the way, the two of you chatted about market conditions and Sun Xiaoya's wedding, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: Building 7, Gaoling Community, Furong District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drive to the wedding hotel
description: After picking up Zheng Wenbo, you drove to The St. Regis Changsha. Wenbo remarked on how quickly Sun Xiaoya got married, and you responded with a smile while already thinking about shooting angles in your mind.
location: The St. Regis Changsha, No. 289 Shawan Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Professional filming of the entire wedding ceremony.
description: After arriving at the hotel, you immediately confirmed the schedule with the bride Sun Xiaoya and focused on photographing family and friends. When the ceremony started, you used a telephoto lens to precisely capture the tears in the bride's eyes during the ring exchange, switched to a 24-70mm lens to record the interaction during the couple's speeches, and moved among the tables to capture the proud gazes of parents and the smiles of friends. At noon, you had a buffet with Zheng Wenbo, and in the afternoon continued shooting outdoor scenes and family/friend group photos. The entire process was professional and efficient.
location: Banquet hall and exterior of The St. Regis Changsha, 289 Shawan Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Dinner party photography and social engagements
description: During the dinner segment, you worked while eating a simple meal, used a large-aperture lens to shoot stage interactions, and captured the wonderful moment of the bride throwing the bouquet and the girls' surprised expressions with high-speed continuous shooting. When the couple toasted with their families, you switched to an ultra-wide-angle lens to capture a lively panoramic scene, taking in the joy of the reunion.
location: Banquet Hall, The St. Regis Changsha, No. 289 Shawan Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Seeing a friend off and driving home
description: As the wedding drew to a close, you took the last group photo of the couple seeing off guests, then bid a brief farewell to Sun Xiaoya, promising to retouch the photos as soon as possible. Afterwards, you drove Zheng Wenbo back to Gaoling Residential Community. On the way, the two of you reviewed the wonderful moments, and you were very confident about the candid shots. After dropping off Wenbo, you drove alone back to your home in Yuelu District.
location: No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community

name: Photo pre-screening and communication on street photography activity
description: Back home, you made a cup of tea, then turned on the computer and imported hundreds of photos from the memory card into Lightroom, quickly culling them down to 40 core photos. At 22:00 sharp, you had a call with Xu Jianing to finalize the café street photography event under the theme 'Autumn Limited Edition,' encouraging customers to take photos containing café elements on Chaozong Street and vote online. During the half-hour call, you simultaneously completed the first round of preliminary color grading.
location: No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community

name: Retouched wedding photos late into the night.
description: After hanging up the phone, you put on your headphones and began to focus on deep retouching of the selected photos, adjusting exposure, color temperature, and contrast one by one, and using Photoshop to fine-tune the subjects' skin and the backgrounds, striving for each photo to be perfect. The retouching work lasted until midnight, during which you were fully concentrated, completely immersed in the joy of photographic post-processing.
location: No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community

name: Morning wake-up and physical recovery
description: Woke up in soft cloudy light. Considering last night's late-night photo editing, canceled the morning run. Did 15 minutes of gentle spinal yoga in bed, focusing on stretching the shoulders, neck, and lower back. Took a warm shower, then changed into comfortable cotton-linen loungewear.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Light breakfast and equipment charging
description: Homemade breakfast: a cup of hot American coffee, an avocado egg whole-wheat sandwich, providing high-quality fat and protein. Meanwhile, packed the Canon EOS R6 and 24-70mm lens, checked that all three batteries were fully charged, and cleared two 128GB memory cards. Opened the phone and reconfirmed the 2 PM cafe design meeting with Shen Xinyi agreed on WeChat.
location: Home kitchen/study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Walking to the banks of the Xiang River
description: Changed into a khaki jacket, put on his photography backpack, left through the south gate of the community, and walked along Shuangtang Road to Xiaoxiang Middle Road. He walked for about 10 minutes, feeling the cool autumn morning breeze.
location: From Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex to Middle Xiangjiang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Autumn street photography creation by the Xiangjiang River.
description: Walked leisurely along the scenic belt on the west bank of the Xiangjiang River. Cloudy weather, 17-23C, with light ideal for street photography. Key captures: the silhouette of Orange Isle Bridge in the morning mist, the water ripples dragged by boats on the river, and the trajectory of plane tree leaves falling on the footpath. Under Yinpenling Bridge, I used a slow shutter speed to capture a set of contrasting images of anglers by the riverbank and the rippling water. At 11 o'clock, the sight of a child running with a balloon in backlight made me press the shutter immediately, becoming one of my most satisfying works today.
location: Xiangjiang Middle Road Scenic Belt, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (section from Orange Isle Bridge to Yinpenling Bridge)

name: Walk to Taiping Street for lunch
description: After the photo shoot, walk to Taiping Street. The walk takes about 20 minutes, and along the way I observe the customer traffic at newly opened tea shops and trendy toy stores. My professional investment advisor instinct kicks in, and my brain quickly analyzes the business data of this internet-famous street.
location: From the Yinpenling Bridge section of the Xiangjiang Middle Road scenic belt to Taiping Street, Tianxin District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Exploring a new-style Hunan-flavored lunch
description: Today, for a change of taste, I chose this internet-famous restaurant known for its sour and spicy flavors. I ordered the signature stir-fried shredded pork tripe with pickled radish and stir-fried cured meat with garlic and chili, and used the phone's macro lens to record the glossy, oily sheen of the dishes as they came out of the wok, as practice material for food photography. While waiting for the meal, I used a phone app to do a preliminary selection of the morning photos and marked a few potential gems.
location: No. 122 Taiping Street, Tianxin District, Changsha, Hunan Province, "Yi Zhan Deng" (Taiping Street branch)

name: Take a short walk to the café.
description: From Yi Zhan Deng, walked through Fanhou Street and arrived at Xinyi Pour-over Coffee in less than 5 minutes. Passing the print shop next door, went in to confirm the price and turnaround time for poster printing.
location: From Taiping Street, Tianxin District to Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee Shop, Fanhou Street, Furong District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Café Promotion Design and Event Warm-up
description: I sat in my usual window seat and ordered a cup of the day's limited 'Huakui' pour-over. I spent the first 30 minutes importing some photos of café interiors taken today and in the past from my camera into my laptop. Then, Shen Xinyi and I officially started work. I used Canva to design the poster, selecting a backlit silhouette photo taken today as the base image, paired with the handwritten artistic font 'Autumn Limited Edition Light and Shadow Street Photography.' Shen Xinyi was responsible for drafting the copy details: 'Bring your camera and your story. This Saturday at 15:00, gather at Xinyi Café, follow street photography expert Feng Haoran, and capture the stories at the corners of the city.' The poster draft was finalized at 16:00 and immediately sent via WeChat to the print shop to produce an A3 matte poster. Then, in the café's WeChat group for new and old customers, we posted the event announcement and sign-up list (limited to 15 people), while Shen Xinyi posted the poster on her Moments.
location: Xinyi Hand-Brewed Coffee Shop, Fanhou Street, Furong District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Subway return trip and supply preparation.
description: After saying goodbye to Shen Xinyi, he walked to Yingbin Road Metro Station. The ride took about 35 minutes, and he put on earphones to listen to an episode of the podcast 'Investment Insider' about 'recovery signals in the consumer sector.' After arriving home, he ate a banana and drank a cup of whey protein powder to quickly replenish energy for the evening training. He checked his climbing shoes, chalk bag, and magnesium powder.
location: Changsha City, Hunan Province: Metro Line 2 Yingbin Road Intersection Station to Line 4 Liugoulong Station

name: Rest at home and knowledge system construction.
description: There was a 1-hour break before the evening activities. Instead of lying flat, I used this time to organize the review notes from last night's wedding photo retouching and entered them into a document named "Wedding Photography Post-production: Light and Emotion V2.0". Then I browsed the Fengniao Photography Forum and took a screenshot of a tutorial on "Techniques for a Clear and Transparent Look in Overcast Weather Post-production" and saved it.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drive to the climbing gym
description: He changed into quick-dry sportswear and drove off. Leaving the community, he drove north along Jinxing Road for about 10 minutes and arrived at the Climber Climbing Gym.
location: From Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community to Climber Climbing Gym on Jinxing Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Advanced core strength at the climbing gym
description: Today was the third training session this month. After a thorough warm-up, the core goal was to complete a brand-new V3 route. Confronting a blue route that required a big dynamic side pull, the first two attempts were short by half a palm's width. On the third attempt, I adjusted the direction of my right foot on the hold, took a deep breath, then used a large swing to precisely lock my right hand onto the target hold, successfully completing the route. Although my forearms were sore, the sense of accomplishment from finishing the route was exciting. In the rest area, I happened to meet my running buddy Gao Yunfei—he was doing climbing instead today because his right knee is in the recovery period. We exchanged tips on knee care and talked about our recent progress in running and climbing.
location: Climber Climbing Gym, Jinxing Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drive home and buy a quick meal
description: After a simple stretch at the climbing gym, drove home. At the convenience store near the community entrance, bought a ready-to-eat chicken breast salad and a carton of high-calcium milk. After getting home, took a quick shower and had dinner at the dining table.
location: From Climber Rock Climbing Gym in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province to Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, passing by Meilin Yingu International Community Convenience Store, No. 344 Yinshuang Road.

name: Street photography post-processing and social media posting.
description: At the desk, imported the photos from the camera into the computer. Used Lightroom to carefully adjust the colors of today's most satisfying set of backlit silhouettes and river ripples: lowered the highlights, brightened the shadows, and added a touch of warm orange tone to the images. Carefully selected 9 final images and uniformly applied an 'Autumn Limited' frame and filter on the phone. Posted on personal social media with the caption: "The autumn of the Xiangjiang River is the wind at Orange Isle, the running in backlight, and the eternal moment in the sound of the shutter. Have a nice weekend." Afterwards, refreshed the page and replied to likes and comments from several friends and photography group members.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening review and relaxing reading.
description: Wrote today's review in my diary: street photography output satisfaction 9/10; poster design completed smoothly; successfully sent the V3 route; met Gao Yunfei. Afterwards, made a cup of hot tea, leaned against the headboard, opened Chapter 2 of Howard Marks' The Cycle, and immersed myself in the discussion of investment psychology and cycles.
location: At home in Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, from the study to the bedroom

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Turn off the main light, leaving only a yellow desk lamp. Set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning and put the phone on Do Not Disturb mode. Reviewing today's highlights—the backlit silhouette and the explosive breakthrough in rock climbing—I fell into a deep sleep with a smile on my face.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning long-distance running training and morning recovery
description: At 5:30 a.m., the alarm went off. Feng Haoran quickly got up, washed up briefly, and had a banana before leaving at 5:45. He walked through the housing complex and arrived under the Orange Isle Bridge at 5:58, where he met his running partner Gao Yunfei. At 6:00, they set off along the east bank of the Xiangjiang River heading south for a 15-kilometer long run. Their pace stayed steady at about 6:25 per kilometer. Gao Yunfei's knee had recovered well, and they exchanged tips on half-marathon technique and breathing rhythm. After completing the 15 kilometers at 7:30, they stretched by the riverside for about 15 minutes. Feng Haoran was satisfied that he hadn't slowed down in the latter part, and he and Gao Yunfei agreed to do an 18-kilometer training run on the weekend. He then walked home alone, arriving at his residence at No. 99 Shuangtang Road in Yuelu District at 8:13. Back home, he quickly took a hot shower to recover, then prepared a high-protein breakfast: a protein shake, two boiled eggs, and a slice of whole-wheat bread. While eating, he browsed financial news on his phone and formed a preliminary view of the day's market. After changing into a shirt and trousers, he checked his briefcase to make sure everything was in order, and at 8:40 he drove off to work.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province; under Orange Isle Bridge; and the running track on the east bank of the Xiang River

name: Morning client maintenance and market briefing writing.
description: At 8:53, Feng Haoran drove to the Huatai Securities office building located in Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District. He first dealt with customer emails that had piled up over the weekend and quickly reviewed global market closing figures. At 9:00, he called core client Lin Zhihao for a 20-minute one-on-one quarterly asset review, analyzing his Hong Kong stock holdings and suggesting adjustment recommendations. At 9:30, he had a video meeting with client Huang Siqi via the online meeting system to confirm her satisfaction with the current allocation. From 10:00 to 11:30, he focused on writing a briefing titled "Briefing on Recent Fluctuations and Allocation Strategies in the Overseas Cross-border REITs Market" assigned by his supervisor Qian Yongqiang, reviewing a large amount of Bloomberg data. At 11:40, he printed the draft briefing and went to Manager Qian's office for a 10-minute report and discussion, receiving feedback for revisions. He then continued his morning routine work until 12:30.
location: Office, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Lunch with colleagues
description: At 12:30 noon, Feng Haoran and his colleague Zheng Wenbo met at Ba Wan Gai Ma Fan in Area B of Wanda Plaza for lunch. He ordered a signature dish of steamed baby cabbage with garlic and vermicelli, and stir-fried yellow beef. The two chatted while eating. Zheng Wenbo shared his weekend experience of viewing houses, while Feng Haoran talked about how he felt on this morning's 15-kilometer long run and complained about the revision points in the cross-border REITs briefing. The relaxed atmosphere eased the tension of the morning's work.
location: Ba Wan Gai Ma Fan (Changsha Kaifu Wanda Store), Zone B, Wanda Plaza, No. 589 Zhongshan Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Afternoon work: briefing revision and team communication
description: After returning to the office at 13:30, Feng Haoran spent 45 minutes revising and completing the final version of the cross-border REITs briefing based on Mr. Qian's feedback, and sent it via internal email. At 14:30, he invited Zheng Wenbo to the pantry to discuss recently launched public REITs products and analysis views on the building materials sector. From 15:30 to 16:30, he organized client service records and prepared an asset allocation framework for potential clients he would meet with tomorrow. At 17:00, he checked the next day's work schedule, turned off his computer, packed his briefcase, and drove away from the company at 17:10.
location: Office, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: After-work commute, buying light meals, and collaborative promotion with the cafe.
description: At 17:10 Feng Haoran drove away from the office and first went to a convenience store along Zhongshan Road in Kaifu District. He arrived at 17:25 and bought a ready-to-eat chicken breast salad and a carton of high-calcium milk as dinner. He then continued driving and arrived at Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee Shop on Jiefang West Road in Furong District at 17:48. After arriving, he and the owner Shen Xinyi put up the A3 matte poster for Saturday's event on the community bulletin board outside the shop and in a prominent spot inside. The two then sat down in a corner booth. Feng Haoran opened his laptop to help optimize the shop's pages on Dianping and food delivery platforms, re-editing the promotional copy and images for the "Limited Autumn Street Photography Event" and the "Light Lunch Set". After that, he sent the digital version of the event poster and introduction to the coffee shop's WeChat fan group and a photography partners group, officially starting the online promotion and calling for sign-ups and organizing.
location: Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee Shop, Jiefang West Road, Furong District, Changsha, Hunan Province (with a stop at a convenience store on Zhongshan Road, Kaifu District on the way)

name: Simple dinner and family video call
description: After the collaboration came to an end, Feng Haoran sat in the dining area of the café, enjoying a freshly bought chicken breast salad and high-calcium milk. Meanwhile, he made a WeChat video call to his parents in Wuhan, reporting the good news of his 15-kilometer morning run and recent work progress. His mother Li Xiuying told him to take care of his health, and his father Feng Jianguo asked about his knee condition. Feng Haoran responded to each, saying he might not go back this weekend, and reassured his parents. After talking for about 15 minutes, he hung up, feeling relaxed.
location: Dining area inside Xinyi Hand-Brewed Coffee, Jiefang West Road, Furong District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drove home and completed the wedding e-album
description: At 19:50, Feng Haoran drove away from the cafe, returned to Yuelu District via Jiefang West Road and Orange Island Bridge, and arrived at home at No. 99 Shuangtang Road at 20:10. After changing into loose home clothes, he went straight to the study, turned on his computer and Lightroom software, created a new album project titled 'Sun Xiaoya & XX Wedding Highlights 20251018', and carefully selected from the remaining photos. He meticulously adjusted the exposure, color, and facial details of each photo, and finally selected 50 of the most representative moments, covering the ceremony, outdoor scenes, and interactions between the couple and friends and family. At 22:00, he started making an electronic album, adding soft background music and transition effects to the selected photos. At 23:00, the complete electronic album was generated. He shared the link via WeChat with the newlyweds, Sun Xiaoya, and the company photography interest group chat, and quickly received a lot of praise. Sun Xiaoya sent a private message saying the photos made her very emotional. Feng Haoran felt that all the effort was worth it. He then checked tomorrow's weather and schedule, set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode, turned off the lights at 23:30, and went to sleep with a full sense of accomplishment.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning core training
description: The alarm went off on time. Considering that the right knee needed recovery after yesterday's long run, I did a 10-minute combined core workout on the yoga mat, including a 3-minute plank, supine alternating leg raises, squats, and push-ups, to fully wake the body from sleep.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Wash up and get dressed
description: Took a quick warm shower, changed into a dark gray casual blazer and a light blue shirt. Took a black folding umbrella from the umbrella stand at the entrance and put it into the briefcase, preparing for possible rain.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Buy breakfast and head out
description: Walked to the Meilin Yingu International Community convenience store at the community gate, bought a whole-wheat chicken sandwich, a cup of unsweetened yogurt, and a bag of daily nuts. While checking out, I browsed the financial news summary on my phone, then quickly walked to the underground garage to drive to work.
location: Hunan Province, Changsha City, Yuelu District, No. 344 Yinshuang Road, Meilin Yingu International Community Convenience Store

name: Driving commute and morning information intake.
description: After starting the car, connected to the car Bluetooth and listened to the financial podcast Caixin Morning Call. This episode reviewed last night's moves in the three major U.S. stock indices, the dollar index fluctuations, and the latest oil price developments. While listening, mentally rehearsed the day's work priorities, driving from Yuelu District to the Huatai Securities building in Kaifu District.
location: Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning market review and making coffee
description: After arriving at the office, I used my own pour-over kettle and Kenyan washed beans to brew a pour-over coffee. I then opened the Bloomberg terminal and quickly scanned pre-market global market quotes and important news, forming the day's trading context in my mind. Before 9 a.m., I had a brief exchange with arriving colleague Zheng Wenbo about today's unusual movements in the building materials sector.
location: Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Core work: proposal revision and case analysis
description: I pulled up the cross-border REITs distribution plan with feedback from my supervisor Qian Yongqiang, focusing on adding stress-test scenarios for global interest-rate fluctuations and currency risk on the cash flows of underlying properties. I used Excel to build cash-flow models under different scenarios and generated conclusions, then submitted the revised version for review. Meanwhile, from 10:00 to 10:15 I arranged an online meeting with client Lin Zhihao for next week, tentatively set for Thursday afternoon. From 10:30 to 11:40, my colleague Zheng Wenbo came to me for help with an investment case on an AI chip tech stock. I quickly analyzed its discounted cash-flow model and comparable company valuations, pointed out the two major risks of technology iteration and customer concentration, and suggested adjusting the risk premium coefficient.
location: Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Wrap up pending tasks and prepare for lunch
description: Received feedback from Qian Yongqiang, who approved the revised stress test section, and the plan could move to the next step. He immediately submitted the final version in the system, breathed a sigh of relief, packed his laptop, and prepared to go to a café for midday foot traffic observation.
location: Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Walk to the coffee shop and monitor data
description: Leave the Huatai Securities Building and walk to Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street branch). On the way, the clouds thickened, and I felt a hint of stuffiness before the rain. At the same time, I opened the operations dashboard on my phone to compare yesterday's and today's customer flow data.
location: Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street Branch), No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Noon coffee shop customer flow observation and strategy suggestions
description: Arrived at the café, and after greeting the owner Shen Xinyi, I found a seat by the window with a view of the counter and sat down. I opened the mobile operations backend and compared the customer flow data for the midday period between yesterday and today, finding that today increased by about 10%-12%. During the 45 minutes of observation, I saw two girls taking photos and checking in, and a middle-aged man read the poster and ordered a pour-over coffee. I suggested to Shen Xinyi that during afternoon tea hours, she could launch a check-in gift of freshly baked mini cookies, and use Dianping group-buy vouchers to drive traffic. I ordered a Costa Rica honey-processed pour-over coffee myself and savored its bright acidity. At 12:50, I paid the bill, got up, and left.
location: Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street Branch), No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Walk back to the office
description: Walked back to the Huatai Securities building. A light drizzle began to fall on the way, so I opened the folding umbrella I had with me.
location: Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Afternoon daily work and collaboration
description: Back at my desk, the afternoon's work focused on three areas: 13:15-14:00 handling daily inquiry emails and phone calls from clients such as Li Jianguo and Lin Zhihao, answering questions about recent market volatility; 14:00-15:00 writing detailed valuation analysis notes for colleague Zheng Wenbo's tech stock case, putting the morning's verbal communication in writing and flagging data sources that needed further verification; 15:00-16:30 working with Zheng Wenbo to deeply analyze the latest monthly data for the building materials sector and exchanging investment views.
location: Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Prepare evening course materials and set off
description: I got up from the office chair to stretch my neck, then transferred the handouts and past notes for tonight's 'FinTech' course from the computer to the tablet. I packed my briefcase and drove to the Lunan campus of Central South University. On the way, the rain grew heavier; I set the wipers to medium speed, and light jazz 'Blue in Green' played in the car.
location: Lunan Campus, Central South University, 605 Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Pre-class preparation and teacher-student communication
description: Arrived at the classroom early, sat in the last row by the window, and took out the tablet to browse this week's reading materials again. When the professor walked into the classroom, I actively approached and briefly mentioned my confusion about the compliance of blockchain technology in asset securitization encountered at work. The professor said we could have an in-depth discussion after class.
location: Comprehensive Teaching Building, Lunan Campus, Central South University, 605 Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Participated in the FinTech course and interacted.
description: The class started on time. The professor systematically explained the principles of blockchain's distributed ledger, consensus mechanisms, and smart contracts, and focused on analyzing their application prospects in areas such as asset securitization and supply chain finance. During the break, he walked to the front of the classroom and had an in-depth discussion with the professor for about 10 minutes on the difficulties of applying distributed ledgers in tax compliance and cross-border asset confirmation. The professor provided new insights from the perspective of differences in domestic and foreign regulatory frameworks.
location: Comprehensive Teaching Building, Lunan Campus, Central South University, 605 Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drove home and video-called with mother
description: After the class ended, I drove home; the rain had become light. When I reached Orange Island Bridge, I made a WeChat video call to my mother through the car system. We chatted for a few minutes, and I told her that work had gone well today and that I had attended a great class in the evening. She reminded me to keep warm as the weather turned colder, and I replied that she needn't worry, I was fit and strong. By the time I hung up, the car had already entered the community.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Rest and post-class case review at home
description: Parked the car in the garage, took the elevator home, changed into soft loungewear, and organized the evening's course materials and notes from the tablet to the computer desktop. Then opened Tencent Meeting and had a post-class case review with MBA group classmates. Combining the customer flow data observed at the café today, he extended the discussion by sharing thoughts on how blockchain can replace and challenge centralized clearing institutions in securities trading clearing. His classmates said the practical perspective was very enlightening.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Archiving of historical research reports and establishment of an index.
description: Started organizing the individual stock analysis reports of the past two years as planned. Then he took a quick shower and changed into casual clothes. Next, he carefully checked the travel list, checked the batteries, memory cards, and ND filters in his camera bag, confirmed that his parents' regular medications (blood pressure medication, motion sickness patches) were packed, and loaded the SUV trunk with road trip meals such as ready-to-eat chicken breast salad, yogurt, and mineral water, as well as two light jackets. He set the optimal route to his parents' home on his phone's navigation app, confirmed his ETC balance was sufficient, and checked the vehicle's condition (tire pressure, engine oil, windshield washer fluid) to make sure everything was ready.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Pick up parents and set off
description: Feng Haoran drove from his residential community, along Lujing Road and Fenglin Third Road, arriving at his parents' home in about 25 minutes. Upstairs, he helped his parents carry the packed suitcases and his father's camera bag downstairs. After getting in the car, his father checked the day's weather in Zhangjiajie on his phone (18C-24C). Feng Haoran adjusted the driver's seat and rearview mirror, had his mother try the passenger seat, adjusted the seat angle and lumbar support, and handed her motion sickness patches. Everyone was excited and said 'Let's go!' to each other. His father suggested the first stop be Reshi Service Area to stretch their legs.
location: Downstairs of parents' home, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drive to Zhangjiajie.
description: Feng Haoran smoothly drove the SUV onto the Changsha-Zhangjiajie Expressway, activated adaptive cruise control, and kept a safe following distance. His father sat in the back seat using his new phone to capture the scenery along the way, while his mother gradually relaxed listening to Teresa Teng's songs. After about 2 hours and 46 minutes, the vehicle entered Reshi Service Area (Taoyuan County, Changde City) and stopped for about 20 minutes, allowing his mother to get out and stretch her legs, his father to smoke and relax, and Feng Haoran to check the tires and vehicle condition and update the navigation. During this time, the three enjoyed the ready-to-eat chicken breast salad, yogurt, and other road meals prepared in advance. After that, they continued the journey with smooth traffic throughout, and arrived at Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie at 11:50.
location: Chang-Zhang Expressway (passing through Reshi Service Area, Taoyuan County, Changde City, Hunan Province), arriving at Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City

name: Hotel check-in, lunch, and rest.
description: After arriving at the Pullman Zhangjiajie Jingwu Hotel, Feng Haoran checked in for his parents, booking two adjacent deluxe mountain-view rooms on the 5th floor, specifically choosing a room with a wide view for them. After parking the car, he helped carry the luggage to the rooms, demonstrated how to use the room cards, air conditioning, and TV, and informed them of the locations of the restaurant, gym, and swimming pool. Subsequently, the three had lunch at the hotel's Chinese restaurant, ordering Hunan-style stir-fried dishes and staple food. After the meal, his mother went back to the room for a nap, his father fiddled with his camera in the room, and Feng Haoran sorted photos in his own room and set an afternoon alarm, each fully resting and regaining energy.
location: Zhangjiajie Jingwu Pullman Hotel, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

name: Xibu Old Street tour and dinner
description: After resting, the three changed into comfortable shoes and walked about 21 minutes from the hotel to Xibu Old Street. The air was fresh and surrounded by mountains. Feng Haoran took many group photos for his parents, capturing the warm moment of his father telling his mother stories of his youth against the distant mountains. Considering that his mother was afraid of heights, they did not go far, mainly strolling in the street area to experience local customs. Around 16:00, sensing that his parents were a bit tired, they went early to the nearby highly rated Xiangjian Tujia Restaurant and ordered Tujia Sanxiaguo (smoked pork, pork tripe, and pork intestines), rock ear fungus stewed with free-range chicken, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. His father used his phone to shoot short videos of the dishes, and his mother also tried a few pieces of smoked pork, praising the authentic taste. After the meal, the three walked slowly back to the hotel along Xibu Old Street. The setting sun dyed the mountains gold, and Feng Haoran took a group photo of his parents in front of the iconic building.
location: Xibu Old Street, Wuling Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province, and the nearby Xiangjian Home-Style Restaurant (next to Xiangxiaowu Local Specialty Products)

name: Family time and itinerary planning
description: After returning to the hotel, the three gathered in the parents' room, flipping through the hundreds of photos taken that afternoon. The father was especially satisfied with one group photo. They discussed tomorrow's itinerary in detail: go to Yuanjiajie in the morning to see the Avatar filming location, let the mother have free time in the afternoon, and Feng Haoran would accompany his father to photograph Golden Whip Stream. Before leaving, Feng Haoran urged his parents to rest early and save energy for tomorrow.
location: Parents' room at Pullman Zhangjiajie, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province.

name: Personal organizing and social connections
description: After returning to his room, Feng Haoran opened his laptop, imported the day's photos into Lightroom for initial selection and color grading, and added watermarks. Then he replied to his running buddy Gao Yunfei's proposal to run a half marathon after returning to Changsha, agreeing to discuss the timing later. Before going to bed, he posted in the photography community, reminding everyone that his sharing session at tomorrow afternoon's 'Autumn Street Photography Event' at Xinyi Cafe.
location: Own room at Pullman Zhangjiajie Jingwu, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

Outside the window, the mountain shadows were quiet. He fell asleep contentedly, looking forward to exploring the core beauty of Zhangjiajie with his family tomorrow.
location: Own room at Pullman Zhangjiajie Jingwu, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

description: 07:10 alarm rang, Feng Haoran got up and looked out the window at the morning mist over Wulingyuan. He drank half a glass of warm water and checked the weather (partly cloudy, 17-23C). He decided to skip the morning run and instead take a brisk walk around the hotel to save energy. He put on running shoes and a quick-dry T-shirt, walked briskly along the garden flagstone path, breathing in the mountain air. He stopped to take three photos of the distant mountains in thin mist with his phone, sent them to the family group with the message "Zhangjiajie's morning, a fairyland." He continued walking briskly to wake up his body.
location: Room and garden trail at Pullman Zhangjiajie, 168 Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

At 08:00 he knocked on his parents' door next door; his mother had already fixed her hair, and his father had finished shaving. The three went together to the hotel's Chinese restaurant. Feng Haoran brought his father a bowl of beef noodles, served his mother millet porridge and steamed sweet potato, and took for himself a fried egg, whole-wheat toast, and black coffee. During the meal he casually talked about the day's itinerary: "In the morning we'll first take an eco-friendly shuttle, then experience the Bailong Elevator—it's like a vertical roller coaster." His mother smiled and gave him a playful eye-roll but didn't refuse.
location: Room and Chinese restaurant, Pullman Zhangjiajie Hotel, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province.

After his parents came downstairs, the three walked about 10 minutes to the Wulingyuan South Gate ticket office. Feng Haoran completed ticket purchase and real-name verification by scanning a QR code on his phone in advance, and the family quickly passed through the gates. He reminded his father to sit in the front to avoid motion sickness, and his father patted him on the shoulder and said not to worry.
location: Hunan Province, Zhangjiajie City, Wulingyuan District, Gaoyun Road, Jingwu Pullman Hotel parking lot and the south gate ticket office of Wulingyuan Scenic and Historic Area.

name: Take the eco-friendly shuttle to the Bailong Elevator.
description: The eco-shuttle drove along the winding mountain road, with peak forests coming into view outside the window. Feng Haoran sat beside his mother, pointing at a stone peak and teasing her that it looked like a hand-woven basket. His mother laughed and her attention shifted away from the cliff. His father, at the front of the car, excitedly recorded videos with his phone. About 20 minutes later, they arrived at the lower station of the Bailong Elevator.
location: Scenic area eco-bus in Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province (on the way to the lower station of Bailong Elevator)

Inside the elevator, he had his mother stand toward the inner side, while he lightly supported her shoulder. As the elevator ascended, his mother instinctively reached for the railing; he leaned close to her ear and guided her to look at the lion-like stone peak on the right to distract her, while his father filmed from behind. Three minutes later, they reached the summit. His mother let out a long sigh of relief, and Feng Haoran handed her a thermos cup.
location: Bailong Elevator (lower station to the summit), Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

Feng Haoran chose a photo spot for his parents, guiding his father to shoot from a low angle to frame both the people and the peaks, and took a half-length photo of his mother with his phone. In front of the "Hallelujah Mountain" marker stone, he asked a visitor to take a family photo. Along the way, his mother pointed to wildflowers on the cliff, and he opened an image recognition app to scan them as yellow corydalis. His father joked that they had brought a tour guide.
location: Yuanjiajie Scenic Area, Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province
