description: The three entered the Avatar Ecological Restaurant. Feng Haoran ordered Tujia smoked pork with dried tofu, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, tomato and egg soup, and rice. While waiting for the food, he checked his phone, drafted messages in the photography group and the “Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee” WeChat group, explaining that he couldn't attend due to family plans, @-mentioned Shen Xinyi to ask for help hosting, and said he would respond to group members online. At 12:00 the dishes were all served. He served his mother food, poured tea for his father, and the three ate and chatted about the morning's experience.
location: Avatar Ecological Restaurant, Yuanjiajie, Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie, Hunan Province

name: Descended the mountain and drove to Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon
description: After lunch, took the eco-friendly shuttle down the mountain and returned to the hotel parking lot to pick up the car. Feng Haoran set the navigation and drove to Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon, a drive of about 40–50 minutes. On the way, his mother felt drowsy. He quietly reminded his father to speak softly, and observed her condition through the rearview mirror while mentally planning how to handle the glass walkway.
location: Drove from the South Gate of Wulingyuan Scenic Area, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie, Hunan Province to Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon Scenic Area, Sanguansi Township, Cili County, Zhangjiajie, Hunan Province (via Wulingyuan Avenue and Zhangci Line).

name: Challenge the entire glass walkway.
description: After arriving at the Grand Canyon parking lot, Feng Haoran bought tickets and shoe covers for the glass walkway. At the entrance, his mother froze at the sight of the cliff-side walkway. He didn't urge her; instead, he led her to a bench, handed her a thermos to comfort her, and gestured for his father to walk ahead a few steps and record a video to prove it was safe. He gently took his mother's hand and promised to walk in front so she only had to look at his back. Once on the walkway, he stayed half a meter ahead of her, keeping his right hand extended backward for her to hold, and every dozen or so steps he turned back to distract her with the natural scenery. At the widest point in the middle, he stopped to let his mother rest against the railing for five minutes, pointing at a waterfall and describing scenes from *Journey to the West*. In the end, his mother successfully completed the entire walkway. As she set foot on solid ground, her eyes were reddened. He put his arm around her shoulders and praised her as 'the bravest heroine,' then asked a tourist to take a victory photo of the three of them with his father's phone.
location: Glass walkway, Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon Scenic Area, Sanguansi Township, Cili County, Zhangjiajie, Hunan Province

name: Rest and snack tasting at the end of the boardwalk
description: After walking off the glass skywalk, the three sat down in a pavilion in the downstream rest area. Feng Haoran bought fried small fish, glutinous rice cakes, and four cups of hot tea, and specially asked for an extra cup of brown sugar ginger tea for his mother to calm her nerves. His mother looked through the video his father had taken on his phone and couldn't help laughing at how nervous she looked. His father teased, "Haoran kept walking ahead of you like it was a red carpet." The three laughed continuously.
location: Rest area at the end of the tour in Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon Scenic Area, Sanguansi Township, Cili County, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

name: Drive back to the hotel
description: At 15:40, set off back to the hotel. Feng Haoran asked his parents to close their eyes and rest, playing light music throughout the journey. Through the rearview mirror, he observed his mother's steady breathing and his father's occasional light snoring. Arrived at the hotel parking lot about 40 minutes later, gently woke them up, and suggested going back to the room to freshen up and rest before arranging dinner.
location: Drove from Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon Scenic Area, Sanguansi Township, Cili County, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province, back to Jingwu Pullman Hotel, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province (via Zhangci Line and Wulingyuan Avenue).

name: Gym core training
description: After sending his parents back to their room, Feng Haoran changed into sportswear and went to the hotel gym for core strength training: three sets of planks (60 seconds each), three sets of elastic band anti-rotation exercises with 15 reps on each side, and three sets of 20 lying leg raises. He monitored his heart rate with his watch throughout, drank a sports drink after 30 minutes, and felt his core was effectively activated.
location: Gym, Pullman Zhangjiajie Hotel, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie, Hunan Province

name: Showering, organizing photos, and online interaction
description: After returning to the room, he took a cold shower and changed into clean shorts and a T-shirt. He opened his laptop, copied the day's photos from the camera and phone, and roughly selected 20 good shots for simple exposure and color temperature adjustments. At the same time, he checked the 'Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee' WeChat group, saw that Shen Xinyi had posted activity photos and the group members were discussing enthusiastically. He sent a voice message with comments and liked three photos.
location: Room at the Jingwu Pullman Hotel, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

name: Chatting with parents
description: After resting, Feng Haoran knocked on his parents' door. His father was looking at camera photos and his mother was brewing green tea. He pulled up a chair and sat down to chat. His mother said it was thanks to his constant talking during the rise up the sky ladder, and his father showed the video of mother and son walking hand in hand along the plank road. Feng Haoran suggested projecting the memories on the big screen in the evening, and his parents readily agreed.
location: Parents' room at Jingwu Pullman Hotel, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

name: Dinner at Old Street Flavor Local Restaurant.
description: The family of three walked to the Old Street Flavor Local Restaurant near the hotel, having booked a window seat in advance. Feng Haoran ordered rock-earing stewed local chicken, kudzu starch stir-fried with cured pork, sour radish stir-fried with shredded pork tripe, seasonal wild greens, and a pot of homemade rice wine. He picked cured meat for his mother; his mother praised the chicken soup as delicious; his father raised a toast, saying the trip was well arranged. Feng Haoran clinked glasses with tea instead of wine. The dinner atmosphere was pleasant. His mother brought up the return trip on her own, and his father said that having seen enough mountains, they could come again next time.
location: Laojie Weidao Local Restaurant, near Biaozhi Gate, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie, Hunan Province

name: Stroll on Xibu Old Street
description: After dinner, the three of them took a walk to aid digestion, strolling along the street to Xibu Old Street. At night, the Tujia stilted houses were hung with red lanterns, and the small shops were brightly lit. Mother stopped at a weaving stall, and Feng Haoran scanned a QR code to pay for the bamboo-woven flower basket she had liked yesterday as a souvenir. Mother said it was a waste of money but couldn't put it down. Father was attracted by a tea shop, and Feng Haoran bought him a bag of Zhangjiajie green tea. When they reached the old stage, a folk band was playing, and the three stood listening to a tune called Eighteen Bends of Mountain Road, with Mother humming softly.
location: Xibu Old Street, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie, Hunan Province

name: Family photo screen-cast review
description: After returning to the hotel, his parents went back to their room to rest first. Feng Haoran connected a portable projector to the TV and organized the selected photos of the day into a slideshow. At 21:00, he invited his parents to the room, where there were fruits and hot tea on the coffee table. The slideshow showed the misty mountains in the morning, his mother with eyes closed on the sky ladder, a selfie at Yuanjiajie, holding hands on the glass walkway, a victory group photo, and local dishes at dinner. At each photo, his mother smiled and recalled the memories, while his father added comments about the angles. When the tense photo on the glass walkway appeared, he said, 'Mom succeeded in today's challenge, you can brag about it when we visit relatives tomorrow.' His mother laughed until she cried. He also shared background stories of interactions in the photography group and finally presented a long-exposure night view of Xibu Old Street. It lasted about 1 hour and 10 minutes, warm and fulfilling.
location: Feng Haoran's room, Pullman Zhangjiajie Hotel, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province.

name: Pre-sleep planning, reading, and going to bed.
description: After his parents returned to their room, Feng Haoran washed up. He sat at his desk and planned the next day's return trip: wake up naturally in the morning, have brunch at the hotel, then set off around 10 a.m. on the Changsha–Zhangjiajie Expressway, planning to rest once at Cili Service Area, drop his parents off at their home, and then return to his own apartment. He set the alarm for 8:30 the next morning, sent a message to his running buddy Gao Yunfei asking to go running the day after tomorrow, and Gao Yunfei immediately replied yes. At 22:30 he turned off the light, read the chapter on recovery in Running Bible by the bedside, and wrote reading notes. At 22:50 he turned off the light, recalled the image of his mother smiling on the glass skywalk, and fell asleep quickly with satisfied fatigue. The whole day was about 21,000 steps and 30 minutes of core training.
location: Room at the Jingwu Pullman Hotel, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

name: Hotel breakfast and checkout
description: At 07:30, woke up naturally and on time, full of energy. After washing up, Feng Haoran accompanied his parents to the first-floor self-service restaurant for breakfast. He chose beef rice noodles, a fried egg, and yogurt for himself, and brought his father a jianbing and soy milk. After the meal, he quickly returned to the room, packed the luggage for all three, and confirmed nothing was left behind. At 08:15, he completed checkout at the first-floor lobby, paying the room rate and extra expenses with a credit card.
location: No. 168 Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province, Pullman Zhangjiajie Hotel

name: Purchasing Zhangjiajie specialty products
description: After checking out, Feng Haoran drove his parents to the well-known local specialty store he had noted during last night's research — Huahua Local Specialty Store. He helped his mother choose vacuum-packed rock ear, Eucommia tea, and kudzu root powder, and bought dried kiwifruit and cured meat for his father. His mother insisted on paying in cash, saying it was a gift for friends in Changsha. He smiled and didn't refuse.
location: Huahua Local Specialty Shop, Gaoyun Road, Wulingyuan District, Zhangjiajie City, Hunan Province

name: Drive back to Changsha
description: At 09:15, they departed from the hotel on time. Feng Haoran drove a black SUV, carrying his parents onto the Changsha-Zhangjiajie Expressway. He played the folk music "Liuyang River" that his father likes, and chatted with his mother about interesting things during the trip. At 11:00, he took a short 15-minute break at the Reshi Service Area, bought three bottles of mineral water and a pack of biscuits, and stretched his limbs. At 12:45, the vehicle smoothly entered the urban area of Changsha, and the dashboard showed a total trip of about 3.5 hours.
location: During the drive on the Chang-Zhang Expressway and through Yuelu District, Changsha

name: Settling parents back home
description: Feng Haoran drove directly to the building where his parents lived on Jinpenling Street, Yuelu District. He helped them carry two suitcases up to the third floor. His mother immediately offered him a glass of water and an apple. He politely declined, telling them he had work in the afternoon, urged them to rest well, and made a plan to have dinner together next week.
location: Feicui Garden, Jinpenling Street, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Light meal on the way back
description: After leaving his parents' home, Feng Haoran felt a bit hungry. Driving along Yinshan Road, he stopped his car at the KFC next to Jinlun Plaza to quickly have lunch. He ordered a spicy chicken burger and a Coca-Cola Zero, and while eating, he browsed the domestic financial news for the weekend on his phone.
location: KFC (Changsha Jinlun Store), Yinshan Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Put away luggage and clothes
description: Back in his cozy nest, Feng Haoran placed his suitcase and local specialty bags at the entrance. He quickly took off his coat, changed into comfortable athletic loungewear, and sorted dirty clothes into the washing machine. The ritual of returning from a trip made him feel completely back in his own rhythm.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Record travel expenses
description: He sat in front of the computer in his study and opened his personal finance management spreadsheet. He pulled out every payment receipt recorded in his phone over the past few days and entered them in detail, from hotel accommodations, meals, local specialties, and parking fees to gas. He carefully checked and found the total expense was about 11,000 yuan, within budget, and he was satisfied. Finally, he wrote in the remarks column: 'Zhangjiajie family trip, great value for money, family's happiness is the most important.'
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Build an electronic investment research database
description: This was the core task requiring the most focus today. Feng Haoran opened Notion and began building the framework for the long-conceived 'Investment Research Database.' He created four top-level sections: 'Industry Research,' 'Stock Analysis,' 'Macro Observation,' and 'Market Views.' Then, following his own logic, he imported dozens of PDF reports and Excel data sheets accumulated in folders such as 'Semiconductors,' 'AI,' 'New Energy,' and 'Consumer,' and tagged each item with labels such as 'Company, Industry, Date, Keywords, Importance.' He also used the automated kanban feature to track key research targets. In less than two and a half hours, a database with initial scale and clear structure was born, which made him extremely excited.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Light Dinner and Equipment Preparation
description: At 17:30, Feng Haoran felt hungry. He took out the ready-to-eat chicken breast salad and high-calcium milk he bought the day before yesterday from the fridge, ate two slices of whole wheat bread, and finished the meal in 15 minutes. Then he walked to the gear area in the entryway, checked his climbing shoes, chalk bag, and water bottle, and made sure nothing was left out of his sports backpack.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drive to the climbing gym.
description: Feng Haoran carried his gear bag, drove from home along the auxiliary road of the Second Ring Road, and arrived at the familiar climbing gym in 15 minutes.
location: Climber Climbing Gym (Meixihu Branch), Lujing Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Rock climbing training camp wraps up
description: He arrived 15 minutes before the scheduled class time and first did warm-up and stretching. It was the last class of the month, and he felt in excellent form. After warming up, he unhesitatingly challenged the V3 route planned by the coach. He focused on the transitions between handholds and footholds, controlled his core strength precisely, and completed the climb successfully on his second attempt, earning applause from the coach and the climbers present. In the final 10 minutes, he also tried another V3 route that required more dynamic power. Although he didn't complete it, he found the key moves and decided to make it his first goal for next month.
location: Climber Climbing Gym (Meixihu Branch), Lujing Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Drive home and relax.
description: After the training, Feng Haoran drove home. With the car window half open, the evening breeze gently blew in, carrying away the excitement and fatigue after climbing. He played a soothing piano piece through the car Bluetooth, feeling both body and mind fully released.
location: While driving in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Organizing photos, reading, and going to bed
description: After arriving home, Feng Haoran took a comfortable hot shower. Then he curled up on the living room sofa and briefly reviewed the photos from the trip on his phone. He specifically selected a group photo of his parents in front of Bailong Elevator, did basic color grading in Lightroom mobile, and shared it to a WeChat group for photography enthusiasts with the caption: "Hiking Zhangjiajie with family, every view is the best company." After replying to a few friends' likes, he put down his phone, turned off the main light, read "The Cycle" for half an hour in bed, and then fell asleep contentedly.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning exercise, breakfast, and commute preparation
description: The alarm went off at six in the morning. Feng Haoran got up quickly, changed into his sportswear, and went downstairs. He went for a 4 km recovery run along Lushan South Road in Yuelu District, Changsha, at a pace of 6 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer, feeling the cool morning breeze and fresh air. After returning home at 6:30, he did 15 minutes of core strength training on the yoga mat in the living room. While stretching, he used a mobile app to review the route completion records of this month's four climbing sessions, recorded his training insights by voice, and sent a WeChat message to his coach to book an in-person meeting for early next month to discuss a training plan for tackling V4 routes. Then he took a shower, put on a pressed shirt and trousers, heated a glass of milk in the kitchen, boiled two eggs, and had two slices of whole wheat bread for breakfast. While eating, he played a financial podcast aloud and took a screenshot when he heard a new perspective on cross-border REITs. After breakfast, he packed his backpack, checked that his laptop and the REITs proposal document were inside, and got ready for the commute.
location: Home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road and Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Commute and transition to morning work
description: Feng Haoran drove from Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community in Yuelu District to the Huatai Securities office building in Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District. Traffic was smooth along the way. He quickly answered a voice message from a potential client via car Bluetooth, briefly replied at a red light to confirm the afternoon meeting, then continued listening to a financial podcast to organize his thoughts for the upcoming discussion with Lin Zhihao. He arrived at the company at 8:15, brewed a cup of black coffee, opened the office system, quickly screened more than 30 accumulated emails during his leave, replied to 3 urgent business inquiries, then prepared a 3-minute outline of his Zhangjiajie observations for the department morning meeting, and printed the latest draft of Lin Zhihao's REITs proposal.
location: From Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, to the Huatai Securities office building and workstation, Section C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District

name: Monday department morning meeting.
description: The department morning meeting started on time in the Huatai Securities conference room, with attendees including Qian Yongqiang, Zheng Wenbo, and Sun Xiaoya who joined online. Feng Haoran first used several travel photos on a PPT to vividly share his experiences from the self-driving trip to Zhangjiajie and his observations of the local homestay economy, livening up the atmosphere. He then clearly reported the progress of the projects on hand before the vacation, emphasizing that the REITs project with Lin Zhihao had entered the solution refinement stage. Qian Yongqiang recognized his pace control and asked for his views on recent market fluctuations.
location: Huatai Securities meeting room, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Plan refinement and preparation for client communication
description: After the meeting, Feng Haoran entered the information of potential clients contacted by phone in the morning into the CRM system and established a preliminary risk assessment model for them. Then he focused on revising Lin Zhihao's cross-border REITs allocation plan, incorporating the new market views and competitor data heard in the morning, and at 11:50 sent the final version of the plan and the link for the afternoon video conference to Lin Zhihao's secretary.
location: Huatai Securities workstation, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Lunch and casual chat with colleagues
description: After the lunch break bell rang, Feng Haoran and his colleague Zheng Wenbo walked to the xiaolongbao restaurant in Zone C of Wanda Plaza, ordering a basket of fresh pork soup dumplings and a bowl of seaweed and egg drop soup. During the meal, they chatted about Zheng Wenbo's interesting experience taking his child to the provincial museum to see an exhibition over the weekend, and exchanged preliminary views on next week's market trends.
location: Xiaolongbao shop, Zone C, Wanda Plaza, 589 Zhongshan Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Video conferencing and meeting minutes organization
description: At 1 p.m., Feng Haoran had a video conference with client Lin Zhihao on time in the small video conference room of Huatai Securities, explained in detail the adjusted cross-border REITs portfolio plan, and demonstrated the effectiveness of the hedging strategy with data models to respond to Lin Zhihao's concerns about exchange rate risks. Lin Zhihao was satisfied with the logic and risk control of the plan, raised several technical questions about fund pooling, and Feng Haoran answered them one by one. Both parties agreed to proceed to the next signing process next week. After the meeting, Feng Haoran spent 15 minutes organizing the meeting content into a clear memo with key points, copied to Qian Yongqiang and Zheng Wenbo, then went to the pantry to refill coffee, chatted with colleagues for a few minutes to relax his eyes.
location: Small video conference room and workstation, Huatai Securities, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Prospective client engagement and market notes organization
description: Feng Haoran prepared the projector and roadshow materials in advance in the VIP reception room of Huatai Securities. A high-net-worth client introduced by a friend arrived as scheduled. He analyzed the current macro allocation environment using industry data and, taking into account the client's family business background, briefly discussed a framework proposal of 'cross-border + industrial investment'. The client showed strong interest, and they agreed to have a deeper discussion next week after providing more detailed financial data. After seeing the client off, Feng Haoran returned to his seat, opened his knowledge base, and compiled the investment trends discovered in his communication with the two clients today and the new REITs market data he saw this morning into a market observation note of about 600 words, as material for later column writing.
location: Huatai Securities VIP reception room and office space, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Handling daily tasks and preparing to leave work
description: At the end of the workday, Feng Haoran dealt with the last few emails, browsed the market briefing after the afternoon close, and prepared two simple analytical models for the internal strategy project to be discussed tomorrow. When it was almost time to leave, he saw his mother's photos of fresh lotus root shoots she had bought at the vegetable market in the family group chat. His heart warmed, and he replied with a thumbs-up emoji.
location: Huatai Securities workstation, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Commute after work and Hunan-style dinner
description: Feng Haoran left work on time and drove from Huatai Securities in Kaifu District back to Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community in Yuelu District. On the way, he listened to a podcast about "The Application of AI in Financial Compliance" to keep his knowledge sharp. After getting home, he changed into casual clothes and walked to his usual Manlao Shixiangli Local Restaurant, where he ordered a classic pepper-fried pork and a serving of garlicky water spinach, along with a bowl of rice. He enjoyed it quietly alone, feeling the satisfaction brought by the fresh and spicy Hunan cuisine, which relieved the fatigue of the day.
location: From Huatai Securities, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, to Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, and then walked to Manlaoshi Xiangli Tucaiguan, Property Building, Jianxin Resettlement Community, Second Management Area, Xihu Street.

name: Organizing travel memories and making a family video call
description: Back home, Feng Haoran imported over 400 travel photos and videos from his DSLR camera into his computer. In Lightroom and CapCut, he quickly selected 20 family photos with the best composition and expressions, applied a uniform filter and text template, and uploaded them to the family WeChat group. Then he made a video call to his parents, sharing untold funny stories from Zhangjiajie and the stories behind the photos. His mother showed off her newly bought ethnic-style scarf, and the family naturally discussed the next travel destination—his mother wanted to go to Guizhou to see the Huangguoshu Waterfall, while his father preferred Yunnan. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Evening study, review, and preparation for tomorrow
description: After the video ended, Feng Haoran went into the study, opened the professional knowledge platform, and went through the electronic research database on "Cross-Border Investment and REITs" built yesterday. He corrected two mixed keyword classification tags, added concise notes to a core PDF report, and encrypted the entire database before backing it up to two cloud drives. Then he switched to study mode, using XMind to systematically organize the core knowledge points from the first eight weeks of this semester's "FinTech" course, along with his insights from case analysis reviews, into a visual mind map on themes such as "Application of Blockchain in Asset Securitization". He felt confident about the week's coursework tasks. Finally, he turned off all electronic devices, took out his planner, quickly glanced at tomorrow's (Tuesday's) meetings and to-do items, confirmed nothing was missed, and laid out sportswear and running shoes for the next morning's jog.
location: Home study, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening relaxation and rest
description: After washing up, he returned to the bedroom. Feng Haoran read a paper financial magazine for a while to let his brain detach from the intense work, then put on the cervical traction device as usual for 15 minutes of relaxation, and turned off the lights at exactly 23:25 to fall asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning run and street photography at Yuelu Mountain
description: I woke up naturally, feeling refreshed. I changed into quick-dry clothes and running shoes, hung my Sony RX100 camera around my neck, and left the house at 6:25. I walked to the entrance of the neighborhood, taking deep breaths of the crisp autumn morning air. After entering the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain, I started a 5 km recovery run along the familiar route, at a pace of about 6:40 per kilometer. When I ran to Chuanshipo Lake, I was attracted by the sight of morning light penetrating the thin mist and spreading across the lake, so I stopped to capture the interplay of light and shadow with my camera, as well as the silhouette of an old man practicing tai chi by the lake, taking about 5 photos. At 7:10, I ran back to the entrance of the neighborhood, feeling extremely energized.
location: Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (enter from the East Gate, follow the Chuanshi Lake route)

name: Washing up, nutritious breakfast, and a quick news briefing
description: After returning home, he showered and freshened up, then changed into a comfortable home shirt. He took fresh milk, soft-boiled eggs, and whole-wheat toast out of the fridge, heated them briefly, and had breakfast. While eating, he opened a financial news app and Cailianshe, quickly browsing overnight U.S. and European market movements and important domestic morning policy updates, paying special attention to the latest developments in the REITs market and jotting down a few relevant summaries in his memo.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Column topic framework and publishing plan
description: Sat down at the desk in the study, opened the laptop. Based on his long-term observation of the financial markets, he listed 12 column topic directions on mind-mapping software, including industry analysis, company deep dives, investment strategies, etc., and set a publishing order and timeline framework for each topic, thinking efficiently throughout. He plans to publish the first article, The Underlying Logic of Asset Allocation, next week.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Write the initial draft of the column: Asset Allocation Logic.
description: Entered a deep work state. He put on noise-cancelling headphones, played white noise, and began writing the first draft of his column with full focus. He integrated fragmentary ideas accumulated daily into the article structure. When discussing his revised view of the 'Merrill Lynch Clock', he cited a promotional brochure for a local government urban investment bond fund seen at a service area during last week's self-driving trip to Zhangjiajie as a negative example, and the logical chain was clear. Midway, around 10:30, he felt eye strain and got up to do 5 minutes of eye massage and neck stretching. During this time, he briefly replied via WeChat voice to colleague Zheng Wenbo's discussion about an industry ETF.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Go to Wanda Plaza and have lunch.
description: The core part of the column draft was completed, and the ideas were still flowing. His stomach protested, so he decided to go to Wanda Plaza for a change of scenery and to have lunch. He took his keys and phone, walked 5 minutes to Jinxing Road subway station, took Line 4 for one stop to Liugoulong Station, transferred to Line 6 for two stops to Wenchangge Station, exited from Exit 4 and walked to the B1 level of Wanda Plaza, taking about 44 minutes in total. At B1, he found the Wanda Plaza xiaolongbao shop, ordered a serving of signature pork xiaolongbao, a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup, and a serving of Shanghai soy-braised duck leg. After finishing quickly, he added a portion of pumpkin porridge.
location: Wanda Plaza Xiaolongbao Shop, B1, Area C, Wanda Plaza, No. 589 Zhongshan Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: At Shangyin Coffee, chatting with good friend Shen Xinyi
description: Walked about 5 minutes from Wanda Plaza, through several old alleys, to Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street branch) run by good friend Shen Xinyi. There weren't many customers in the shop today, and the air was filled with the aroma of roasted coffee beans. Shen Xinyi greeted me warmly, and I ordered a hand-drip of the seasonal limited 'Ethiopian Gutiti' she recommended. While waiting for the coffee, I sat by the counter and chatted with her about how things were going after the opening. She happily said that because the lunch set had a good flavor pairing, the repurchase rate was higher than expected. description: Feng Haoran bought a sandwich and coffee at the convenience store downstairs from the company, then swiped his card at 7:55 to enter the Huatai Securities office in Block C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District. He first reviewed global market developments, focusing on crude oil and U.S. stock futures. He quickly pulled up the product information, analyzed the net value, redemption fee rate, and settlement time, and talked with Huang Siqi for 5 minutes to confirm the operational details, then suggested she pay attention to the subsequent allocation of money market funds. At 9:00 he attended the Monday department meeting. His supervisor Qian Yongqiang summarized the weekly report, emphasized a defensive and counterattacking strategy under the 'existing-market game', and required all advisors to proactively contact clients to adjust positions. description: At 12:50, Feng Haoran arrived at the second floor of Xinyi Pour-over Coffee. Shen Xinyi had already cleared the space. They laid the 20 framed works flat on the floor in order. Haoran used a level and tape measure to mark positions on the wall, with Shen Xinyi assisting. From 13:10, he worked at a speed of about one work every 7 minutes, drilling holes with an electric drill, hammering in invisible nails, hanging frames, and repeatedly calibrating with the level to ensure each picture was horizontal. After all the works were on the wall at 14:50, he replaced the lighting with 3000K track spotlights, carefully adjusting the angles to make the light soft and even without glare. At 15:00, satisfied with the overall effect, he arranged 4 candid shots of the stray cat "Baozi" in the corner by the window on the second floor, using a staggered hanging style. Shen Xinyi placed a notepad with cat paw prints and colored pens nearby, hoping guests would leave warm messages. Haoran took a few establishing shots as a memento.

He personally ground Ethiopian coffee beans and mixed samples with orange peel and a trace of cinnamon until he achieved the ideal taste of "old street in early spring". At 17:00, he set up an easel poster at the café entrance and laid out the sign-in message board. At 17:45, friends Gao Yunfei and Xie Yutong arrived with craft beer and flowers, helping to check the stability of tables and chairs and the projection equipment. At 18:00, the four of them went through the entire opening process and clarified each person's role. At 18:30, half an hour before the official opening, Haoran stood by the second-floor window, looking at the bustling crowd on Chaozong Street below, turning his nervousness into anticipation. Then he washed his face in the restroom, tidied his shirt and hair, and confirmed he was in good shape.

He then personally led the tour, focusing on the stories behind works such as the steam from the flatbread shop in 'Morning Light on Pozi Street,' the conversation with Old Chen in 'The Shoemaker on Xuegong Street,' and 'The Last Wok at the Night Snack Stall.' The audience responded enthusiastically, especially at the 'Baozi' corner, where they took photos and left messages. Client Huang Siqi came with friends, and after tasting the signature drink 'Street Corner,' praised that the works captured the city's pulse.
location: Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee Shop, Chaozong Street Historical and Cultural Block, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

He asked Xinyi to brew a pot of Huakui, and while tasting it, they chatted about the flavor of the newly arrived beans. He also mentioned that Xu Jianing would be coming. After finishing the coffee, he estimated that Jianing was almost there and walked to the door. A few minutes later, Xu Jianing, wearing a trench coat and carrying a camera, appeared with a transparent umbrella. The two hugged, and Feng Haoran led her into the café to introduce her to Shen Xinyi.

She lingered for a long time in front of a photo titled 'Shoemaker on Xuegong Street', commenting that it captured a moving moment and suggesting using a softer film preset to enhance the nostalgic feel. Then the three sat by the window and shared another pot of Mandheling coffee that Shen Xinyi had just brewed. Xu Jianing shared her photography project on urban village renovation in Shenzhen, and Feng Haoran also talked about his idea for a series on Changsha's night-shift workers. The two hit it off and chatted enthusiastically.

name: Take a taxi home

Then I took a taxi back to the Jinxing Residential Compound of the Yuelu District Government, and after arriving home, I boiled a pot of hot water.

name: Evening skincare routine and finger stretches

Carefully applied a new kinesiology tape, then did a 15-minute yin yoga session on the yoga mat, focusing on hand stretching sequences to relax the area strained yesterday.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Bedtime reading
description: Changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard and read Neuroscience: Authoritative Discourses for 40 minutes, focusing on chapters about pain neuroplasticity and motor recovery. Set a timer to play a soothing white noise track (rain sounds), set the alarm for 6:50 tomorrow, then turned off the light and got ready for sleep.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Turned off the light and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Getting up and morning wake-up
description: The alarm went off. I checked the weather on my phone: Changsha was overcast today and felt slightly cool. Lying in bed, I gently pressed the knuckles of my right hand with my left hand. After confirming there was no morning stiffness or soreness, I slowly opened the curtains. Gray-white daylight streamed in, and outside the window the north wind moved the branches, forming a peaceful scene. I got up and started a new day.
location: No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community (bedroom)

name: Hand rehabilitation exercises and morning stretching.
description: Wearing loose loungewear, I sat on the living room carpet. First, I did breathing relaxation exercises, then focused on finger rehabilitation: using professional rehab putty, I repeatedly did thumb-to-finger opposition and pinching/grasping exercises, 30 reps each. Then I slowly squeezed a small grip ball, 20 reps per set, completing 3 sets, all the while controlling so as not to burden the hand. Afterwards, I did 15 minutes of yin yoga poses, focusing on neck and core stretches, avoiding support with the right hand, feeling the body gradually open up.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (living room).

name: Washing up, preparing breakfast, and browsing financial news
description: While washing up, deliberately rinsed the hands a bit longer with warm water to help blood circulation. Then prepared breakfast: toasted whole wheat bread, boiled a soft-boiled egg, made a cup of black coffee, and paired it with a small plate of nuts. While sitting in the dining room enjoying breakfast, quickly browsed the global market movements from last night and this morning on the tablet: the three major U.S. stock indexes closed mixed, and the earnings of several growth stocks of interest met expectations; A50 futures edged higher; domestic public REITs products had new developments again. Entered key data and a draft of judgments into the phone memo.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (bathroom, kitchen, dining room)

name: Commuting to the company.

In the car, I did not use my phone, rested with my eyes closed, and finished listening to a podcast episode about the investment logic of the new energy industry, gathering energy for the day's work.
location: From Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province to Kaifu District Office Building Leasing Center, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

Feng Haoran was responsible for the accuracy of data sources, especially verifying the calculation logic in the bond returns section; Zheng Wenbo was responsible for charts and textual logic. The two had a brief but in-depth discussion over an assumption parameter about commodity prices in the report, finally reached an agreement by referring to the latest research report data and made the revision. location: Kaifu District Office Building Leasing Center, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (office space)

After eating quickly, went upstairs to the area of the personal photography exhibition 'The Temperature of the Street Corner' for a tour. Saw that more than a dozen new messages had been added to the message wall, and read a few of them carefully, such as 'In these photos, I saw the resilience of the city of Changsha.' Took photos of the entire message wall and close-ups using a mobile phone for reference. Found Shen Xinyi and asked about the visitor traffic data for the last week of the exhibition. Shen Xinyi pulled up the backend data, which showed that the average daily customer count had increased by about 35% compared with before the exhibition. The two briefly exchanged ideas about whether there were opportunities for other forms of cooperation in the future.

name: Returned to the company and organized family health records
description: Walked back to the company, taking only 2 minutes. On the way, while walking, he digested the feedback from the roadshow just now, and formed a clear evaluation and summary in his mind about the final effect of the exhibition. After returning to his workstation, he opened an encrypted Excel spreadsheet named 'Haoran Family Affairs' on his computer. He first called his father Feng Jianguo, telling him to find the vaccination record booklet issued by the community before and send photos of it. After hanging up, based on memory and previous chat records, he entered the vaccination records of his parents for hepatitis B, influenza, pneumonia, etc. into the spreadsheet by category, and noted the suggested next vaccination time.

description: Called the public phone number of Yinpenling Street Community Health Service Center, Yuelu District, Changsha. After it connected, he clearly described his parents' ages (father 65, mother 62) and his mother Li Xiuying's history of chronic gastritis. The doctor gave professional advice over the phone: the mother should receive the flu vaccine plus the 23-valent pneumococcal vaccine; the father only needed the flu vaccine. The doctor also said that appointments were available tomorrow morning from 9:00 to 10:30 and that vaccine stock was sufficient. After recording the key information, Feng Haoran hung up and successfully booked appointments for his parents on the community-designated health app for tomorrow 9:30-10:00, taking a screenshot and saving it to his phone.
location: Kaifu District Office Building Leasing Center, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (office space)

After formally submitting the leave request in the company's internal system, he shut down the computer.
location: Kaifu District Office Building Leasing Center, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (office space)

name: Commute to parents' home
description: He shouldered his bag and hailed a car with a ride-hailing app at the roadside. On the way, he chatted with the driver briefly about Changsha's weather and traffic, and arrived smoothly at the residential community where his parents lived after 20 minutes.

name: Initial discussion with parents about vaccination matters.
description: He knocked and entered. His mother, Li Xiuying, was trimming vegetables on the balcony, and his father, Feng Jianguo, was watching TV in the living room. Feng Haoran didn't bring up business directly. Instead, he first sat down, drank a cup of green tea his father had made, and chatted about today's weather and some small matters at work. Once the atmosphere relaxed, he took out the appointment screenshot on his phone and explained calmly to his parents: "Mom and Dad, tomorrow around 9:30 a.m., I'll take you to the Yinpenling Community Health Service Center at the street corner for a flu shot. Mom will also get a pneumonia vaccine. It's all booked. It's very close, just a ten-minute walk." He also explained tomorrow's schedule so his parents wouldn't feel uneasy.
location: Meilin Yingu International Community, No. 342 Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (living room)

name: Leisure and helping with household chores
description: Seeing his mother go to the balcony to hang clothes, Feng Haoran took the initiative to help and passed her the hangers. Afterward, he played a game of Chinese chess with his father in the living room. In the middle game, he set a clever 'horse at the trough' trap, while his father calmly defended with his rook. The game ended in a draw, and his father wore a rare smile. The family atmosphere was relaxed and warm.
location: Meilin Yingu International Community, No. 342 Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (living room, balcony)

name: Family dinner and vaccination details confirmation
description: Mother began preparing dinner; tonight's staple was her signature hot dry noodles. Feng Haoran rolled up his sleeves to help his mother by peeling garlic and chopping green onions. His father brought out the pork rib and lotus root soup he had slow-cooked in advance. The kitchen was filled with steam, the warm aroma of food, and the sound of family chatting and laughing. The three of them sat around the dining table, and Feng Haoran picked up a strand of hot dry noodles coated in sesame paste; the familiar fragrance made him feel at ease. Between bites, he clearly and slowly emphasized tomorrow's procedure again: 'Before leaving, bring your ID card and my phone. When you get to the community hospital, take a number first, then see the doctor to get the prescription form. After the injection, you need to sit there for half an hour for observation and cannot leave right away.' Father nodded in agreement, and Mother also said, 'Got it. We'll follow your arrangement.'
location: Meilin Yinggu International Community, No. 342 Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (kitchen, dining room)

name: Post-meal confirmation and tidying up.
description: After the meal, I proactively cleaned up the dishes and the kitchen. Then I sat on the living room sofa, opened the community health service center app again, confirmed that the appointment information for my parents and myself showed normal, and the vaccine stock status showed "sufficient", only then did I feel relieved and turn off my phone, feeling at ease.
location: Meilin Yingu International Community, No. 342 Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (kitchen, living room)

name: Leisure and Reading
description: Returned to the guest room and changed into comfortable loungewear. Instead of looking at his phone, he took out the paper book "Authoritative Treatise on Neuroscience" from his bag, leaned against the headboard, read the chapters planned for today as scheduled, and made pencil annotations in the book where it mentioned key theories about habit formation and neuroplasticity, immersing himself in deep study.
location: Guest room, Meilin Yingu International Community, No. 342 Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening stroll
description: He changed into sneakers, went downstairs alone, and walked briskly in the neighborhood. He felt the cool north wind at night and the quiet atmosphere of the community, moving his stiff legs, feet, and shoulders from sitting too long. He deliberately controlled the swing range of his right arm to avoid excessive stretching, relaxing his body while protecting his recovering hand.
location: Meilin Yingu International Community, No. 342 Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (community walking path)

name: Washing up, checking, and preparing for bed
description: Returned home, took a quick warm shower, and felt relaxed. Took a document folder out of the bag, put the ID cards and medical insurance cards of parents and myself, along with a handwritten vaccination procedure note, into the folder, and placed it in a prominent place on the living room coffee table to ensure it wouldn't be forgotten tomorrow morning, making full preparations for tomorrow's family health action.
location: Meilin Yingu International Community, 342 Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (bathroom, living room)

name: Evening review, reading, and preparation for rest
description: After drying my hair, I sat on the edge of the bed and used my phone's memo app to briefly review the day: high work efficiency, good feedback from the roadshow, household arrangements were handled well, and my parents' mood was stable. I then read for 20 minutes the latter half of "Authoritative Treatise on Neuroscience," on how to harness the power of habits. Afterward, I turned off the main light, leaving only a bedside lamp. Lying in bed, I moved my fingers a few times and confirmed there was no obvious discomfort. Thinking about how the whole family can act together tomorrow and take preventive measures for my parents, I felt a sense of groundedness and satisfaction. After setting the alarm for 8:30 tomorrow, I fell asleep peacefully.
location: Guest room, Meilin Yingu International Community, No. 342 Yinshuang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: In the morning, accompanied parents to get vaccinated and buy medicine
description: His biological clock woke him at exactly 7:15. He deliberately moved the middle finger of his right hand to confirm that the strain was painless, then did 5 minutes of hand stretching and 10 minutes of yin yoga. After washing up, he changed into athleisure clothes and put the prepared vaccination appointment QR codes for his parents, their ID cards, and medical insurance cards into his chest bag. At 7:50, he accompanied his parents from Shihua Residential Community and walked along the tree-lined avenue for about 15 minutes to Lugu Street Community Health Service Center, reciting the vaccination process to his parents again on the way. After arriving, he guided his parents through registration. His father received the flu vaccine, and his mother received both the flu vaccine and the 23-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccine. During the 30-minute observation period, he kept an eye on his parents for any discomfort and photographed the vaccination certificates with his phone, syncing them to the family album. After leaving the community health service center, he stopped by Yifeng Pharmacy (Lugu Street branch) on the way, bought liquid calcium and Centrum multivitamin as planned, and, following the pharmacist's advice, added a magnesium supplement for his mother. He also replenished band-aids, Yunnan Baiyao spray, and B-complex vitamins. His father praised him for being thoughtful.
location: No. 28 Tongzipo West Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan, Shihua Community; then went to Lugu Street Community Health Service Center (40 m north of the intersection of Luyun Road and Xinfeng Road) and Yifeng Pharmacy (No. 61 Lufeng Road).

name: Quality time with family and helping with household chores
description: After returning home, I helped my mother classify the newly purchased medicines into the medicine box and set a phone alarm to remind her when to take them. Then I taught her step by step how to use the 'Changsha Ren She' app to complete the pension qualification certification. My father brewed Biluochun tea, and I took the opportunity to analyze the recent trends of bank stocks with him, and helped him sort out the underlying assets and potential risks of the wealth management products from the community service center. He listened attentively and nodded frequently. Afterwards, seeing my mother preparing to go to the kitchen, I took the initiative to help pick vegetables and peel garlic, and while working, listened to my mother talk about the recent situation of her old sisters. Regarding the fluctuations of a few minor indicators in my mother's physical examination report, I used what I had learned to reassure her, telling her that they were all within controllable range and reminding her to take her medication on time. The kitchen was filled with a warm, homely atmosphere.
location: Parents' home, Petrochemical Community, No. 28 Tongzipu West Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: Mother carefully prepared home-style dishes such as tomato and egg rice soup, stir-fried bok choy, and smoked tofu twice-cooked pork. Father as usual poured a small glass of medicinal wine. Mother muttered a few words, and Feng Haoran smiled and mediated: “Today is a happy day, let Dad have a small sip.” The family enjoyed lunch harmoniously. After the meal, he took the initiative to clear the dishes and clean the kitchen.
location: Parents' home, Petrochemical Community, No. 28 Tongzipu West Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Heading to the café, final exhibition tour and dismantling review
description: Changed into a more formal casual shirt, checked the protective sleeves, cardboard tubes, and backpack for packing, confirmed the camera battery and spare SD cards were all there, then said goodbye to his parents, hailed a taxi by the roadside, and went to Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee on Chaozong Street, about a 25-minute drive. Upon arrival, he first had a brief exchange with the owner Shen Xinyi about the day's customer flow. Then he started the final round of exhibition patrol: carefully checked the hooks and frames of the 20 works, took close-up and exhibition ambiance photos one by one with the camera, and shot a 30-second time-lapse video on a tripod to record the café's cozy scene. After the patrol, he put on white cotton gloves, carefully took down the works from the wall with Shen Xinyi, cleaned them with an air blower and lens cloth, inserted them into protective sleeves, and put them into cardboard tubes. Then he organized the message wall, peeling off hundreds of sticky notes one by one, discussing interesting messages while sorting. In the end, about 20 of the most touching notes were kept as decoration for the café's "spirit wall", and the rest were collected into a binder. After the exhibition was taken down, he sat at the counter, tasted Shen Xinyi's hand-brewed "Huakui", and had a brief review of the increase in average daily orders and social media exposure from the photo exhibition, proposing to try "photography + coffee tasting" themed salons in the future. Shen Xinyi was very interested and gave him specially reserved natural-processed "Geisha" and "Yirgacheffe" green beans as souvenirs.
location: Xinyi Hand-Brewed Coffee Shop, No. 56 Chaozong Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Returning home, resting, and dinner
description: Carrying a backpack full of works and equipment, I took a taxi at the Chaozong Street intersection back to the Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community on Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District. On the way, I briefly tagged and categorized today's shooting materials. After arriving home, I first took the photography works out of the cardboard tube and laid them flat on the study floor in series order for fine archiving the next day, then put the gifted coffee beans into an airtight jar and stored it in a cool place. After changing into loose loungewear, I stepped on the electronic scale and weighed 76.2 kg, mentally planning tomorrow's morning run and diet. Then I went into the kitchen, cooked Japanese soba noodles, dressed them with a soft-boiled egg, cucumber shreds, and Japanese sesame dressing, brewed a cup of green tea, and finished a light and satisfying dinner.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Post-production organization of the photo exhibition and social media publishing
description: Imported today's exhibition materials into the computer, used Lightroom to quickly select 6 high-quality photos for basic color correction, and paired the 1-minute time-lapse video with light music. After repeatedly polishing the WeChat Moments caption, the final version was: “Thank you to everyone who stopped, making Changsha's street corner warm.” After posting, likes and comments poured in, and I replied to friends' sincere messages one by one. Then I used a mobile scanner app to photograph and archive all the remaining message sticky notes, then carefully placed them in a leather album for permanent collection. Finally, I recorded the insights and areas for improvement from this exhibition in my diary, such as “the lighting angle could be more deliberate next time.”
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Half marathon training plan and health management.
description: Opened the marathon registration website and browsed race information for next spring in Changsha, Wuhan, and other places. Based on current weight (76.2 kg) and finger recovery status, created a three-week running recovery plan in Excel: Week 1 combine running and walking with a target of 5 km, Week 2 recover to 8 km, Week 3 attempt 10 km, and set a weight control goal of reducing to 73 kg within three weeks.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Evening socializing, reading, and preparation for bed
description: Initiated a video call with photographer partner Xu Jianing in Shenzhen to share the results of the exhibition dismantling and the wrap-up video, and enthusiastically discussed the feasibility of jointly holding an online photography exhibition in the future. After hanging up, browsed the 'China Stamp Forum' app to check newly listed 'Dream of the Red Chamber' themed miniature sheets, and liked a post by fellow collector Luo Zhenyu. Before bed, persisted in reading 'Authoritative Treatise on Neuroscience' and made annotations, then applied a warm water ice compress to the middle finger of the right hand to promote recovery. After washing up, prepared the next morning's running clothes, running shoes, sports watch, phone armband, and Bluetooth earphones and placed them on the shoe cabinet, set the alarm for 6:30. Lying in bed, recalled the fulfilling day, felt content and grounded, and relaxed into sleep in the cool autumn night air.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Morning preparations and stretching, checking photography equipment
description: At exactly 5:00 a.m., three alarms rang on time. Without lingering in bed, you got up immediately. You first drank a glass of warm water. The scale showed 76.1 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday, making you more confident in the goal of reaching 73 kg in three weeks. After a quick wash, you put on quick-dry clothes, laid out a yoga mat in the living room, and did 15 minutes of hand stretches and yin yoga, focusing on the previously strained middle finger of your right hand to confirm it was in good condition. Then you opened your camera bag and checked the equipment: a Canon 5D4 body, a 70-200mm lens, a UV filter already attached, three fully charged batteries, and a row of 128G memory cards, all loaded one by one into the photography vest. Finally, you put on the volunteer vest from the organizing committee, filled your thermos with hot water, and stuffed a few energy bars into your pockets, making thorough preparations for the long day of shooting.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Drive to the marathon course aid station
description: At dawn, you drove out of the Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, opened the navigation app on your phone, and planned the best route from Yuelu District to the 17.5 km mark of the course, crossing the river via Houzishi Bridge. Road conditions were good. While driving, you mapped out the day's timeline in your mind—first spend about 2.5 hours taking photos at the aid station, and after fellow runner Gao Yunfei passes, you must move to the finish at Helong Sports Center within one hour. After about 35 minutes of driving, you arrived smoothly at the course aid station on Section 1 of Wanjiali Middle Road.
location: No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, near Houzishi Bridge, Xiangfu Road Bridge, and Section 1 of Wanjiali Middle Road, Yuhua District

name: Volunteer photography at the aid station, capturing moments of runners
description: You parked the car in the designated area, walked quickly to the aid station with your camera gear on your back, greeted the volunteer leader, and then quickly looked for the best camera position by the roadside—one that could capture both the runners' expressions and the course's receding perspective. You half-squatted, adjusted the camera settings (aperture priority, shutter speed 1/500 sec, ISO auto), and while handing water and energy gels to passing runners, you captured their moments through the viewfinder with your eyes. Sweat, gasps, determined looks, high-fives of encouragement—you kept pressing the shutter, recording the most enthusiastic atmosphere of the race. At around 7:40, you finally spotted your running friend Gao Yunfei. His steps were steady and his forehead was covered with beads of sweat. You immediately held your breath, concentrated, and took a burst of close-up shots of him gritting his teeth, leaning forward, and swinging his arms, capturing his tenacious expression as he pushed his limits.

The rise and fall of the Jia family and the interweaving of characters' fates in the play reminded him of cyclical patterns and risk management in the capital market. During the more than two-hour performance, he barely looked at his phone and was completely engaged.

Gao Yunfei remarked that the Jia mansion was like an asset pool without a stop-loss strategy, while Feng added that excellent investors know to build a buffer during prosperous times; the Jia family didn't, but one could achieve that in one's own portfolio. This cross-disciplinary exchange left both feeling the trip was worthwhile.
