After drinking a glass of warm water, started preparing meal prep ingredients for next week: washed and cut the pre-purchased broccoli and carrots into segments, marinated chicken breast with black pepper and sea salt, portioned out quinoa rice, and put them in the refrigerator for later. Then checked running gear, confirming running shoes, sports watch, energy gels, and water bottle were all ready. Ate a banana for energy, then did 15 minutes of dynamic stretching, focusing on activating hip joints and ankles, fully prepared for a long run.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning run training and commuting
description: At 6:50, he drove to Meixi Lake Park, and on the way contacted running partner Gao Yunfei via WeChat to confirm meeting at the East Gate. At 7:10, he started a 16 km long run along the rubber track around the lake, with a steady pace of 5:30/km, cadence 180, heart rate controlled at around 160, and finally finished in 1 hour 28 minutes, 2 minutes faster than expected. After the run, he did static stretching to relax the front and back of his thighs and calves, exchanged experiences with Gao Yunfei, and planned to challenge 18 km next week. At 8:55, he drove home, and on the way bought a bottle of electrolyte drink and a bottle of pure milk at the Meilin Yinggu International Community convenience store at No. 344 Yinshuang Road.
location: Meixi Lake Park lake-loop running track, Meixihu Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Shower, breakfast, and rest
description: After returning home, he took a shower and changed into dry loungewear. He prepared a high-protein breakfast: two slices of whole wheat toast toasted until slightly charred, paired with two soft-boiled eggs and half an avocado sliced, plus a homemade protein shake (protein powder + milk + banana). After resting for 20 minutes, he replied to a few WeChat messages from the weekend, checked the materials needed for the afternoon inventory at the coffee shop, including the cost analysis sheet and Q4 transaction printouts, and packed climbing shoes, a harness, and a chalk bag into his backpack.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Rock climbing training camp
description: Drove to Aoshiguang Gym, changed into climbing gear, and joined the training camp. Mainly consolidated V3 routes, successfully completed two V3 lines, and used the newly learned 'Drop Knee' footwork to try a V4 start route. Though not completing it, successfully grabbed the third hold, showing clear progress. Also completed the goal of 8 pull-ups.
location: Aoshiguang Gym, 80 meters southwest of the intersection of Jinxing Middle Road service road and Xiangjun Street, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Go to the coffee shop and have lunch
description: After the training, he did some simple stretching and drove 25 minutes to Shangyin Coffee at No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District. At the café, he ordered the signature chicken sandwich and vegetable salad, quickly finished lunch, and chatted briefly with his partner Shen Xinyi about the weekend business situation to prepare for the afternoon inventory check.
location: Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street Branch), No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Coffee shop year-end stocktake and celebration.
description: After the meal, she and Shen Xinyi formally took stock at the small table in the back kitchen and checked the year's income and expenditure accounts. Total revenue increased compared with last year, but because the initial renovation and equipment investment were too large, the cumulative net loss for the year was 20,000 yuan (Mr. Feng holds a 30% stake, corresponding to a loss of 6,000 yuan). However, in December, the business broke even for the first time on a monthly basis. After analyzing the cost structure, they found that the profit margin of the delivery channel was relatively low, and decided that in 2026 they would focus on optimizing the dine-in experience and launching a high-margin hand-drip coffee set meal. After the stocktaking, Shen Xinyi used the day's surplus to buy a small slice of cake and two cups of hand-drip Geisha coffee to celebrate. The two clinked glasses and reviewed the hardships and gains of the year. Mr. Feng wrote solemnly on the last page of the account book: "Slow business will eventually see the light." He felt elated.
location: Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street Branch), No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Photograph the new coffee bean packaging
description: Taking advantage of the afternoon sunlight streaming through the window onto the bar counter, I took out the Sony A7R5 camera and shot still-life close-ups of a new batch of Ethiopian Yirgacheffe coffee beans that Shen Xinyi had just received, capturing the packaging details and texture of the new product.
location: Shangyin Coffee (Chaozong Street Branch), No. 84 Fuqing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Urban street photography
description: After leaving the coffee shop, he drove to the foot of Yuelu Mountain. In an alley near Denggao Road, he used a 24-70mm lens to photograph the lazy winter afternoon sunlight filtering through branches and casting dappled shadows on the street. He captured a scene of an elderly woman basking in the sun and feeding a cat, full of everyday life.
location: Alley near the Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, No. 58 Denggao Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Organize photos
description: Returned home, imported the photos from the camera to the computer, quickly selected and color-corrected the 4 most satisfactory works, and posted them to WeChat Moments and the Xingcheng Photography Association group, with the caption: “Slow life under the warm winter sun.”
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Family contact.
description: At 17:00 had a video call with my parents, excitedly reporting today's 16-kilometer long-distance running results and feelings, as well as the good news that the coffee shop achieved its first monthly break-even. My father gave a thumbs-up and my mother was very happy. I asked about my father's blood pressure and was relieved to learn they will go for a follow-up next week. Afterwards, I sent a WeChat message to my sister Feng Xinran in Shanghai, sharing a screenshot of my run and photos of the coffee shop celebration. My sister congratulated me and chatted a bit about her latest web drama project progress.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Dinner preparation and dining.
description: In a good mood, he walked into the kitchen, stir-fried the pre-marinated chicken breast with broccoli, carrots, and wood ear mushrooms, and paired it with the extra brown rice cooked in the morning. While eating dinner, he browsed financial news on his iPad, noticing the central bank's statement over the weekend about maintaining stable liquidity at year-end, as well as the movements of U.S. tech stocks. After dinner, he cleaned up the dishes and rested for a while.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Evening self-improvement
description: Sat on the sofa and continued reading Chapter 5 of 'Man's Search for Meaning', deeply touched by the author's thoughts on 'the meaning of life' in the concentration camp. At 20:00, did 30 minutes of yin yoga on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on stretching the hips, inner and outer thighs, and calves, holding each pose for 3-5 minutes, the deep muscles gradually opening and fatigue dissipating. At 20:30, after showering, wrote in the diary, recording the feelings of the 16-kilometer run, the summary of the coffee shop inventory, and care for the family, completing the moment of self-dialogue today.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Bedtime routine
description: At 21:00, he organized the suit and briefcase for the next day, put the running shoes and climbing shoes back in the shoe cabinet, checked work phone emails to confirm there were no urgent matters, and set the alarm for 6:00 the next morning. At 21:30, he leaned against the bed and read a chapter of 'The Nature of Technology' as quiet reflection before sleep. At 22:30, he did a simple 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch, turned off his phone, and dimmed the bedside lamp. Reviewing the fulfilling day, he felt satisfied. At 23:00, he turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning recovery training
description: The alarm went off. Considering yesterday's 16 km long run and today's rainy weather, I gave up outdoor morning running. After getting up, I drank a glass of warm water, changed into workout clothes, and did 20 minutes of low-intensity aerobic recovery training in the living room, including joint mobility, dynamic stretching, and several sets of core activation exercises. Then I did 15 minutes of shoulder, neck, and leg stretches to relieve the muscle soreness from yesterday's long run.
location: Living room, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Breakfast and browsing the news.
description: After showering and changing, he prepared a high-protein breakfast for himself: two boiled eggs, a cup of unsweetened yogurt mixed with blueberries, and a slice of whole-wheat toast. While eating, he listened to the morning financial news from Wall Street News on his phone and quickly scanned overnight overseas market movements to prepare for the opening trade.
location: Canteen, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Commute by car
description: Carrying a briefcase and a folding umbrella, he drove to the company. Passing the Orange Isle Bridge, he turned down the radio volume and gave himself a few minutes to mentally prepare. Thinking of the morning department meeting, he felt a slight stirring inside, reminding himself to focus on the upcoming trading day rather than results he could not control.
location: From Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, to Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, driving via Orange Isle Bridge.

name: Pre-market preparation
description: He arrived at the company early and brewed a cup of drip-bag coffee for himself. He opened the Bloomberg Terminal and Wind, quickly browsing the trends of major global stock indices, foreign exchange, commodity futures, as well as important domestic financial policies released the night before. He wrote today's work keywords in his notebook: "acceptance, communication, focus," pulling his attention back to his professional field.
location: H3-05 workstation, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan

name: Department weekly meeting: promotion results announced.
description: The department weekly meeting began. Director Qian Yongqiang officially announced at the meeting that the annual promotion results would be postponed to January next year, and revealed that the vote gap with another colleague, Team Leader Wang, was less than 1%. The atmosphere in the meeting room was subtle. I kept a professional smile and recorded the information in my notebook. After the meeting, I took the initiative to find Director Qian, briefly expressed understanding and said I would continue to focus on work.
location: Conference room, 15th floor, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Work: emotional adjustment and client proposal revision.
description: After leaving the meeting room, he felt some tightness in his chest. Instead of going straight back to his desk, he walked to the window in the break room, gazed out at the Xiangjiang River in the light rain, stood still for five minutes, and took deep breaths. Returning to his desk, he opened Huang Siqi's client profile and began the quarterly review of her asset allocation plan. He focused on analyzing the impact of recent market fluctuations on existing REITs and ESG-themed funds, and drafted an options hedging strategy framework based on the new economic policy. He also browsed the latest Shenzhen Stock Exchange announcements to ensure compliance, summarized the key points into a document, and prepared for the afternoon phone conversation.
location: Pantry on the 15th floor and workstation H3-05, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: I invited my colleague Zheng Wenbo and walked to Yuloudong, a famous Hunan restaurant near the company. The rain had stopped, so we walked with umbrellas and chatted. We ordered a portion of the signature chopped pepper fish head, a serving of stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and rice. During the meal, Zheng Wenbo proactively comforted me about the promotion, saying, "Good wine needs no bush." I smiled in response and took the opportunity to ask his opinion on quantifying the 'S' (social) dimension in the ESG investment framework, looking for a case for the afternoon call with Huang Siqi. After the meal, I parted with Zheng Wenbo and walked back to the company alone to aid digestion and clear my thoughts.
location: Yulou Dong (Beizheng Street flagship store), Tongtai Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, and en route to/from the Huatai Securities Building.

name: Midday nap
description: Returned to the workstation, put on an eye mask, and rested with eyes closed on the chair for 20 minutes to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: H3-05 workstation, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan

name: Work: client communication
description: Started work with full energy. First, had a 15-minute phone call with internal client manager Sun Xiaoya to confirm tax compliance and risk disclosure details of Huang Siqi's new plan. Then, had a 35-minute phone conversation with Huang Siqi herself. Based on the framework prepared in the morning, I discussed the hedging strategy plan in detail and gave professional advice on the cash flow management issues she raised.
location: Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, workstation H3-05 (telephone communication)

name: Process the coffee shop's operating reports
description: I opened the December operating data of the co-run "Shangyin Coffee". Using Excel, I verified the month's purchasing costs, labor expenses, and daily revenue, and generated a draft monthly report containing gross profit, net profit, and core operating indicators. I found that due to many rainy days this month, the store's seat occupancy rate had declined. I sent the report to partner Shen Xinyi and discussed on WeChat the possibility of launching a "Warm Winter Sun" hot drink series next month, or a joint activity with nearby independent bookstores.
location: H3-05 workstation, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan

name: Work wrap-up and in-depth conversation with supervisor.
description: Tidy the desktop, archive the revised Huang Siqi proposal, coffee shop reports and other electronic files, confirm the work arrangements before the end of next week, and prepare in advance the materials that need the director's approval. There were still 15 minutes before the talk with Boss Qian. He did a brief meditation at his desk to clear his mind, then took the elevator to the 27th floor five minutes early with a notebook and pen. Boss Qian did not talk much about the promotion itself, but shared his own experience of missing out on a promotion many years ago, then settling down to hone his professional skills and ultimately achieving greater development. He emphasized that "being solid is more important than being fast." These words deeply touched him, and the last trace of frustration in his heart dissipated. He sincerely thanked him for his guidance.
location: Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province; workstation H3-05 and Director Qian Yongqiang's private office on the 27th floor

name: Drove home.
description: Drove home feeling suddenly enlightened. On the way, I played the audiobook 'Man's Search for Meaning' and happened to hear the passage about 'choosing one's attitude,' which coincided perfectly with Director Qian's advice. After arriving at the building, I sat in the car for an extra two minutes and wrote down a sentence in my phone's memo: 'An unresolved matter is precisely the whetstone.'
location: By car from Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Middle Xiangjiang Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province to Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Family dinner and video call with parents
description: After getting home, changed into loungewear, heated up the pork rib and lotus root soup that had been stewed the night before, and had a simple dinner. While eating, made a video call to my parents in Wuhan. Mom asked about my life, Dad asked about the weather. After hesitating for a moment, I chose, as usual, to chat about interesting things in Changsha and did not mention today's promotion delay, not wanting them to worry. My family's caring words warmed my heart.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, living room dining table (video call with parents in Wuhan)

name: Core strength and stretching training
description: After hanging up the phone, I changed into training clothes, opened the workout app, and did a 20-minute core and shoulder-neck workout: including 4 sets of planks (55 seconds each), 3 sets of side-lying leg raises, 2 sets of TRX rows, and neck stretches. The workout relaxed my body and mind, completely releasing my stress.
location: Living room yoga mat, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Reflection notes
description: After taking a shower, I sat at my desk, opened my pen and notebook, and solemnly wrote "What remains unresolved is precisely the whetstone" at the top of the page. Then I recorded in detail today's experiences and insights: including Boss Qian's advice, the warmth of video calling with my parents, and my new understanding of the word "solid".
location: Study desk, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Reading and meditation
description: Leaning against the headboard, I continued reading "Man's Search for Meaning." Deeply moved by the author's story of choosing a noble attitude even in extreme circumstances, I pulled away from work anxiety and reflected on bigger questions. After reading for half an hour, I turned off the light, did 10 minutes of mindful meditation, focused on my breath, and let my thoughts completely calm down.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Preparation and relaxation for tomorrow
description: Meditation ended, body and mind at peace. Took out his phone, added the work items that needed to be handled tomorrow to his memo, and checked the weather, confirming that it would still rain tomorrow. Neatly tidied the bed and picked out a warm business casual outfit for tomorrow.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Away from the phone, picked up a copy of The Nature of Technology and browsed through it, freeing the mind completely from financial and daily trivialities. While relaxing and absorbing knowledge, drowsiness crept in. At 23:00, turned off the light on time and fell asleep peacefully to the sound of rain.
location: Bedroom, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning routine and morning run.
description: At exactly 6:00 a.m., the alarm went off on time, waking him from a dream. He stepped onto the scale naked and recorded his morning weight of 75.5 kg, then drank a glass of warm water to wake up his stomach, and quickly changed into quick-dry clothes and running shoes. He set off at 6:10, jogged about 1 km to the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain, and completed a 5 km morning run along the classic winding highway loop, with a steady pace of around 6:20 per kilometer, breathing in the crisp air and feeling the tranquility of the mountains. He ran back to the residential compound before 7:00, did 5 minutes of static stretching downstairs, and took a photo of the TV tower looming through the morning mist as a keepsake.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, and Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area

name: Washing up and high-protein breakfast
description: Returned home at exactly 7:00, quickly took a shower, and changed into the pre-ironed dress shirt. Then I prepared breakfast, eating two boiled eggs, a slice of whole wheat toast, with a homemade protein shake and a small portion of blueberries. While eating, I quickly browsed last night's US stock market closing quotes and the domestic financial morning report on discussions about new ESG rating regulations.
location: Home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Commute and preparation for arrival at work
description: At 7:40, drove out of the residential community, going along Jinxing Road, Yinpen South Road, across the Yinpenling Bridge, and entering Middle Xiangjiang Road in Kaifu District, arriving at the company's underground parking lot about 15 minutes later. After buying a hot Americano at the convenience store, he swiped his card to go upstairs, sat down at his workstation, opened the Bloomberg Terminal and Wind, and browsed global stock indices, foreign exchange, and commodity futures in real time, confirming there were no black swan events. Then he quickly went through the draft framework of the afternoon's performance review PPT.
location: 8th-floor office area, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Department morning meeting and year-end appraisal pre-review meeting
description: Attended the department morning meeting at 8:30, where each team shared the day's strategy. As a core investment advisor, Mr. Feng integrated ESG investment trend observations into market analysis, emphasizing year-end policy-driven opportunities in the environmental protection and new energy sectors, which was recognized by Director Qian Yongqiang. Then the annual performance review pre-check session began. Mr. Feng reported key data such as the number of new clients, managed asset scale, and return on investment over the year, and presented special cases of clients Huang Siqi (tech company) and Lin Zhihao (real estate), elaborating on his vision of embedding ESG into the client service system next year. Director Qian offered constructive suggestions to add peer performance comparisons in the industry and strengthen risk profiling for high-risk clients.
location: Large conference room, 8th floor, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province.

name: Post-meeting immediate review
description: After the meeting, walked alone to the pantry to get coffee, took out the phone's memo app and quickly recorded Manager Qian's key suggestions for the work report PPT, especially adding comparisons with peer performance in the industry and strengthening the profile of high-risk clients, thinking about how to optimize the material in the afternoon.
location: Pantry, 8th Floor, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Lunch
description: At exactly 12 o'clock, I walked about 10 minutes to the Hunan restaurant Home-Style Flavor on Yingpan Road that I often go to, ordered a portion of pepper-fried pork and garlic water spinach, ate attentively without looking at my phone, and gave my mind a short break.
location: Home-Style Flavor Restaurant (Yingpan Road Branch), No. 81 Shouxing Street, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: ESG Course Module 6 Study
description: After the meal, he walked about 8 minutes to the Starbucks Reserve (Changsha Fuxing International Finance Center store), ordered an iced Americano, put on his AirPods Pro, and studied the final chapter of the ESG investing course, “Future Trends and Career Development,” in a quiet corner using his iPad Pro. The course's closing line, “Responsible investing starts today,” resonated deeply with him.
location: Starbucks Reserve (Changsha Fuxing International Financial Center Store), No. 303, Section 1, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

Sent the final version to Manager Qian's email before 16:00, and also handled 4 client emails during that time, including sending the latest Q4 asset allocation advice to Lin Zhihao.
location: 8th-floor office area, Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Go to Changsha South Railway Station to pick up my younger sister.
description: At 16:00, after confirming the PPT was sent, briefly packed the laptop bag. Considering the need to pick up his sister before 17:00, he left early to avoid the evening rush. After checking that the car had enough fuel, he drove out of the company's underground garage at 16:30, headed south along Middle Xiangjiang Road then turned onto the South Second Ring Road, arriving at the underground parking lot of Changsha South Railway Station's West Plaza in 35 minutes. He walked to the west exit hall, checked the electronic screen, confirmed that his sister's train G1355 had arrived on schedule, and waited at a conspicuous spot near the exit. At 17:15, he saw his sister Feng Xinran, who was pulling a silver suitcase and carrying a large canvas bag. He gave her a hug, took her luggage, and exchanged a few pleasantries.
location: From Huatai Securities Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province to West Square, Changsha South Railway Station, Huahou Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

On the way, his sister shared interesting stories about her work in Shanghai and the completion of her new media operation KPIs, while Mr. Feng shared the ease of just finishing the ESG course and the year-end performance review. After arriving home, he helped his sister put away her luggage, and she changed into indoor slippers. Then they called their parents in Wuhan via video, and asked his sister to let their parents know she was safe. Their mother told them to make dumplings in the evening and they would video-call to celebrate together.
location: From Changsha South Railway Station, Huahou Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province, to home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Family gathering: making dumplings and chatting
description: The brother and sister took over the kitchen. Mr. Feng was responsible for kneading the dough and rolling out wrappers, while his sister was responsible for chopping the fillings (pork and scallion, and chive and egg). While busy working and chatting, Mr. Feng showed photos of morning runs and street shots taken recently at Yuelu Mountain, and his sister took out her phone to show her recent self-media income. The two also discussed plans for next year's Spring Festival holiday.
location: In the kitchen and dining room of the home at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Post-meal rest and housework
description: After eating the steaming hot dumplings, his younger sister voluntarily cleared the table and washed the dishes, while Mr. Feng packed the leftover dumplings into fresh-keeping bags and put them in the freezer. Then the two peeled a tangerine in the living room and watched a short segment of local news while eating.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Yin yoga relaxation.
description: While his younger sister rested in the living room, Mr. Feng returned to the bedroom, changed into yoga clothes, unrolled the yoga mat, and did a 20-minute yin yoga practice, focusing on relaxing the hips, lower back, and neck and shoulders that were stiff from prolonged sitting, combined with abdominal breathing, to relieve the fatigue of year-end work.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Before-bed review and diary
description: After a warm shower, he sat at his desk, opened his diary and recorded the important moments of the day: the satisfaction of completing the ESG course, the solid feeling of being ready for the work report, and the warmth of reuniting with his younger sister. He also wrote down the reflection: 'Turning bonuses into knowledge is the real investment. The strength of family is my eternal support.' Then he read 'Man's Search for Meaning' and took notes.
location: At the desk in the bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Family evening conversation
description: After finishing the diary, I returned to the living room with a glass of hot milk. My younger sister was curled up on the sofa playing with her phone. We started talking about tomorrow's New Year's Eve plans. She shared several videos of well-known New Year's Eve events in Changsha, and we compared the pros and cons of a few venues, looking forward to getting together tomorrow evening.
location: Living room at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Complex, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading
description: At 22:55, after reminding my sister to rest early, I returned to the bedroom, set the alarm for 6:00 the next morning on my phone, and charged it. I opened the Kindle and read a few passages from 'How to Win Friends and Influence People'. After organizing my thoughts, I closed the book at 23:30, turned off the light and went to bed, falling asleep with anticipation for the new year.
location: Bedroom at home, Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Morning run and sunrise photography on Yuelu Mountain
description: I woke up on time at 6:00 a.m., changed into workout clothes, and walked to the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain. I started the year's last Fartlek training session with a target of 10 km: the first 2 km as a slow jogging warm-up, the middle 5 km alternating fast and slow rhythm running, and the last 3 km at a steady pace. Halfway up the mountain, the morning light penetrated the mist; I stopped to capture the light and shadows with my camera. I arrived at the summit viewing platform at 6:50, just in time for the sunrise, and pressed the shutter repeatedly to record the magnificent sunrise. After a short rest, I jogged down the mountain. The whole session took about 55 minutes, with a stable pace and excellent condition.
location: Yuelu Mountain, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, from the east gate entrance uphill to the summit observation platform

name: Return home, wash up, have breakfast, and prepare for the commute

Then in the kitchen, hand-brewed coffee with Yirgacheffe coffee beans, paired with whole wheat bread and hot milk as breakfast. While eating, quickly browsed financial morning news and A-share pre-market information on the phone, confirming no urgent client matters. Organized the commuting bag, brought a power bank and earphones, and got ready to go out for work.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Commuting to the company.
description: Left at 8:25, walked to Jinxing Road Station on Metro Line 2, and took the subway in the direction of Kaifu District. On the way, in the carriage, he used his phone to reply to two clients' late-night messages and confirmed the morning meeting time. At 9, he got out of the subway station, walked 5 minutes to the office building where his company is located, and on the way bought a bottle of water and mints at the convenience store.
location: From Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, via Jinxing Road Station on Metro Line 2, to the office building in Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District.

name: Work wrap-up and department year-end tea party
description: Arrived at my workstation at 9:10, and after turning on the computer, handled the client's final asset allocation contract, checked the terms for accuracy, completed the electronic signature, and filed it. At 10:00, the department's year-end tea party began; colleagues sat together in the rest area chatting casually. At the tea party, I chatted with colleagues about that evening's camping plan, and found Director Qian Yongqiang to formally ask for half a day off, while also briefly reporting the ESG course summary completed last night. The director readily approved and wished me a happy New Year. At 11:30, the tea party ended, we exchanged New Year greetings with colleagues, tidied the desk, and shut down the computer.
location: Huatai Securities Office, 16th Floor, Office Building, Zone C, Xiangjiang Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Lunch and shopping for New Year's Eve camping supplies
description: At 12 o'clock, I went alone to the usual xiaolongbao restaurant in Wanda Plaza, ordered a steamer of pork xiaolongbao and a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup for a quick lunch. Then I walked to the Hema Fresh supermarket on the basement level of the mall, and bought camping supplies according to the list: two 1.5-liter bottles of water, barbecue-flavored potato chips, mixed nuts, chocolate, band-aids, and mosquito repellent. At checkout, I sent a WeChat message to Shen Xinyi to confirm she had brought all the hand-brewing equipment. At 12:55, I walked back to the office carrying the shopping bags to pick up the car.
location: Xiaolongbao shop in Area C of Wanda Plaza, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, and Hema Fresh supermarket on the basement floor

name: Driving home and organizing camping gear and travel materials
description: At 13:00 set off by car from the company's underground garage and returned home via Yuelu Avenue. After arriving home at 13:20, moved the purchased supplies along with camping gear from the trunk—tent, sleeping bag, moisture-proof mat, headlamp, first-aid kit, etc.—into the living room, carefully checking and consolidating: inspected the tent poles and stakes, rolled up the sleeping bag, installed batteries in the headlamp, and placed the self-made "Family Simple Home Exercise Tips Card" into the side pocket of the backpack. At 14:00 opened a laptop in the study, organized the collected Dali and Lijiang travel guides, budget spreadsheets, and hotel screenshots into a folder and synced them to the phone. During this time, his sister Feng Xinran came out of the bedroom and reminded him to bring thick clothes. Feng Haoran confirmed that a shell jacket would be enough.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Afternoon rest and confirming the million-investment milestone
description: After packing my gear, I leaned back in the study recliner and rested with my eyes closed, keeping the stock trading app running in the background on my phone to wait for the 15:00 market close. I reviewed the morning's 10-kilometer running data and was satisfied with my pace. When the A-share market closed at 15:00, I checked my account on time. Total assets showed 1,002,700 yuan, reaching the million-yuan goal. I immediately took a screenshot and saved it, then sent it to my sister Feng Xinran via WeChat with the message: 'The 2025 goal is achieved!' Afterward, in the annual goal list app, I solemnly checked the 'Portfolio breaks through 1 million' item and noted the date, then silently deleted the WeChat Moments celebration post I had prepared to publish, deciding to turn the joy into forward momentum.
location: Study at Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Family gathering, driving to Yuelu Mountain, and hiking up
description: At 15:15, Feng Haoran put on his heavy hiking backpack, carried the camping gear bag, and met his parents and sister, who were already dressed in outdoor clothing, in the living room. His mother tried the weight of the backpack, and after checking the flashlights and thermos cups, the family went downstairs and set out at 15:30. After about 15 minutes of driving, they arrived at the East Gate parking lot of Yuelu Mountain. At 16:15, they started the heavily loaded hike up the mountain. As they walked, Feng Haoran told his family the historical stories of Yuelu Mountain, such as the origin of Aiwan Pavilion and the cultural lineage of Yuelu Academy. His mother was deeply absorbed, his father followed behind, and his sister used her phone to capture the winter mountain scenery and Feng Haoran's back.
location: From Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province, to the East Gate parking lot of Yuelu Mountain, along the hiking trail to the summit campsite.

name: Set up camp at the mountain top and meet up with community partners.
description: At 16:40, the family arrived at the mountaintop campsite. Friends from the photography association and climbing community were already setting up tents. Shen Xinyi was assembling a portable pour-over coffee kettle and warmly greeted Feng Haoran's family when she saw them. The family quickly worked together to set up their tent, and his father helped secure the guy lines. Around 17:00, the campsite roughly took shape. Shen Xinyi handed the family several cups of fragrant coffee. Feng Haoran introduced Shen Xinyi to his family as his 'designated coffee supplier', and everyone laughed.

participant.name: Community friends
participant.relation: Members of the photography association and rock climbing community

location: Designated camping area at the top of Yuelu Mountain, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (near the Sightseeing Corridor)

name: Bonfire party, home workout demonstration, and Yunnan travel plan approved.
description: At 17:30, night fell, and everyone lit a bonfire. Feng Haoran took out a laminated home workout tips card and explained in detail to his parents such movements as wall sits and planks. His mother joked that her child was more considerate than she was, his father nodded approvingly, and his sister took a photo and posted it on her social media: “A hardcore health lesson on the mountaintop on New Year's Eve.” At 18:30, using the bonfire light, Feng Haoran took out his phone to show his family pictures of Dali Ancient City, Erhai Lake, Lijiang Ancient City, and more, introducing the preliminary plan: “The trip is five days, with about 4,000 yuan per person for flights and accommodation, departing one week before the Spring Festival.” His mother was the first to agree, his sister responded with excitement, his father nodded with a smile, and the whole family unanimously approved the Yunnan travel plan. Feng Haoran wrote in his memo: “Spring Festival Yunnan trip plan approved.”
location: Beside the campfire at the campsite on the top of Yuelu Mountain, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

name: Camp socializing and star photography
description: After 19:30, the community friends sat together and chatted. Feng Haoran discussed spring climbing plans with climbing group friends, and Shen Xinyi shared her story of collecting coffee beans in Yunnan. Xu Jianing from the photography club set up an astronomical telescope and tripod, and Feng Haoran also tried to shoot the mountaintop starry sky with his camera, while his sister and friends played with light painting on their phones. Everyone talked about the gains of 2025 and outlook for 2026, and the camp atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Campsite at the summit of Yuelu Mountain, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Family bonfire chat and early return home down the mountain
description: After 22:00, some group members gradually went down the mountain. Feng Haoran's family sat around a small stove by the tent and talked. His mother recalled funny anecdotes from Feng Haoran's childhood, his father talked about the development and changes in Wuhan during the past year, and Feng Haoran sincerely shared his feelings about the delayed promotion at work, saying it made him see more clearly what he needed to improve. His sister played the song 'Tomorrow Will Be Better', and the whole family sang along softly. Feng Haoran's phone received New Year greetings sent in advance from relatives and friends, including his father's instruction to put health first, his mother's attached photo of braised pork, his sister's teasing that he shouldn't be so stubborn next year, his friend Peng Yuqing reporting the repayment progress, his boss Qian Yongqiang's expectation that he mentor new employees, and his photography partner Xu Jianing's invitation for spring shooting. Feng Haoran replied to each one. As the temperature at the mountaintop dropped, the family decided to pack up early and descend, returning home safely before 23:00.
location: Yuelu Mountain summit campsite, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province; then drove back to Jiguan Jinxing Residential Community, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District.

name: Washing up, annual diet review, writing diary, and reading before bed.
description: At 23:00 he returned home and first organized today's diet records: whole wheat bread and milk after the morning run, xiaolongbao for lunch, chocolate and nuts while camping. His takeaway was that the New Year's Eve diet control was acceptable, and from tomorrow he would resume the chicken breast pairing. Then he carefully used dental floss and brushed his teeth, and set a doctor's reminder for 'March 15, 2026, dental check-up'. At 23:15, under the desk lamp in the study, he opened his paper diary and wrote his year-end summary with a fountain pen: 'December 31, 2025. On this day, I completed my last fartlek run, achieved the million-yuan investment goal, and spent New Year's Eve with my family on the summit of Yuelu Mountain. I stumbled quite a bit this year, but every time I got up, I saw the ground under my feet more clearly. The million and the promotion candidacy are just milestones; next year I need to be even more down-to-earth. Sichuan-Tibet Highway, wait for me.' After writing, he let out a long breath, feeling calm and resolute. Then he tidied his desk, placed Man's Search for Meaning by his pillow, got into bed at 23:40, and quickly fell asleep amid sporadic firecrackers outside the window, building up energy for 2026.
location: Jiguan Jinxing Residential Area, No. 99 Shuangtang Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province
